jobs.description:
Your Opportunity

We are growing and actively seeking a Subcontract Administrator to support our US Federal program. Stantec’s US Federal Contracts Team (FCT) is responsible for ensuring compliance with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and supporting bvarious Federal auditing and reporting requirements. As a member of the FCT, you’ll work within our Federal subcontract team ensuring all procurement activities and operations are performed in accordance with company policy, while maintaining adherence to procedural and regulatory compliance.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Procurement of services, equipment, and supplies.
  • Prepare solicitations for bid and proposals from existing or new sources.
  • Evaluate terms and conditions to ensure prime contract clauses and provisions are appropriately flowed down to subcontractors.
  • Perform price analyses to determine if the selected vendor is offering a fair and reasonable price.
  • Award purchase orders, subcontracts, subconsultant agreements and task order subcontracts.
  • Prepare contract award summaries.
  • Perform sole source justification when applicable.
  • Manage the entire lifecycle of the subcontract, including change orders, modifications, insurance and closeout.
  • Update Federal Subcontract Awards tracking spreadsheet and various database systems with detailed agreement information.
  • Maintain reliable and competitive vendor resource lists, including small business and CMMC status.
  • Interact with project management and vendor personnel; respond to a variety of inquiries and provide innovative solutions.
  • Interpret and negotiate, with supervisor and Stantec Legal support, subcontractor/subconsultant exceptions to agreement terms and conditions.
  • Analyze contractual language ensuring proper solicitation and subcontract language is used.
  • Provide guidance to internal teams on subcontract issues, including providing Federal subcontracting requirements, identifying subcontract administrative problems, and developing corrective action plans and solutions.
  • Ensure that purchasing activities are carried out in accordance with company procurement policies and objectives.
  • Maintain a complete procurement file of all pertinent correspondence, documents, and data for each assigned award to satisfy company procurement policies and audits.
  • Maintain and optimize effective relations with subconsultants, project management and other staff.
  • Participate in Federal Contract Team activities on an assignment basis, as needed, such as procurement training provided to office and field staff.
  • Perform various other duties as assigned, such as small business plans and Government property inquiries.

Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Remote UM Medical Director/ Physician Advisor (UM MD/PA) reports to the Senior VP of Clinical Operations with accountably to Chief Financial Officer and Chief Medical Officer. The UM Medical Director/Physician Advisor works with UM licensed staff, Regional Medical Officers and Extensivists to develop and implement methods to optimize use of Institutional and Outpatient services for all patients while also ensuring the quality of care provided. · Serve as a Physician member of the utilization review team.

· Ensure appropriate service utilization by monitoring over- and underutilization

· Work with Interdisciplinary Team to develop AHC Utilization Management protocols, including auto-approvals and market specific protocols.

· Develop training material and assisting UM Manager to conduct Physicians' annual Interrater reliability testing

· Serve as a Subject Mater Expert (CME) to Regional Medical Officers and/or Extensivists during concurrent reviews.

· Serve as a Chairperson for Medical Quality Committee and provide Clinical Oversight of Quality Outcomes.

· Collaborates closely and assist Quality Director.

· Work with Provider Relation, Network Management and local Regional Medical Officers to ensure community Physician education on UM processes and regulations

· Assist the organization to challenge physician practices in order to achieve the organization's clinical outcomes and collaborates closely and assists Quality Director

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is in the business of improving the world’s health. We do this by providing a suite of biopharmaceutical services that help clients across the globe transform scientific discoveries into new treatments.

We are currently seeking a Medical Director with specialist expertise in Rheumatology to join our team in either Serbia, Czechia or Hungary.

The Medical Director is an experienced Rheumatologist with specialist clinical training in Rheumatology and current, up-to-date expertise across rheumatological diseases. Experience supporting clinical development programmes or clinical trials in areas such as rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, axial spondyloarthritis, lupus or other immune-mediated inflammatory diseases would be highly advantageous

You will initiate and maintain medical and consultative relationships with clients, contribute to early engagement and pre-award activities, and serve as a Medical Monitor for contracted clinical studies.


Key Accountabilities


Project Execution: Medical Monitoring Delivery & PV Support


  • Independently deliver the medical support required for the successful delivery of assigned projects in accordance with the contracted agreement with the sponsor and your assigned role as Global Lead Physician (GLP) or Regional Lead Physician (RLP).
  • Participate actively in study planning alongside feasibility leaders, solution consultants and cross-functional study teams.
  • Participate in project team and investigator meetings.
  • Provide training to study teams on rheumatology indications, disease areas, relevant clinical considerations and study protocols.
  • Communicate with relevant sponsor counterparts regarding medical matters, challenges, risks and accomplishments relating to assigned projects and studies.
  • Participate in the development and/or medical review of study documents, including clinical protocols, Medical Monitoring Plans (MMPs), integrated clinical and statistical summary reports, safety plans and Informed Consent Forms, in conjunction with clients/sponsors and other Parexel departments.
  • Deliver medical monitoring activities in accordance with the Medical Monitoring Plan throughout study conduct.
  • Provide medical leadership to projects in close coordination with the Project Leader and in accordance with the assigned GLP or RLP responsibilities.
  • Provide medical input into pharmacovigilance workflows and projects, including participation in safety processing and the medical review of serious adverse events.

Client Relationship Building & Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong medical and consultative relationships with clients and sponsor stakeholders.
  • Provide expert medical input and advice relating to rheumatology clinical development programmes and studies.
  • Act as a credible medical partner to clients throughout the lifecycle of assigned programmes.

Business Development & Medical Expertise

  • Support Business Development and early engagement activities by providing therapeutic and medical expertise.
  • Provide medical expertise to clients across multiple channels and interactions.
  • Provide consultancy on protocol development and/or broader drug development programmes.
  • Conduct medical review of clinical and regulatory documentation that may be subject to client or regulatory agency review.
  • Provide rheumatology expertise, guidance and training to colleagues across Parexel.
  • Contribute medical and therapeutic expertise to proposals, bid-defence activities and client discussions, where appropriate.

Knowledge & Experience


  • Medical qualification with relevant postgraduate clinical training and specialist expertise in Rheumatology.
  • Current and up-to-date knowledge of rheumatology and the management of relevant inflammatory, autoimmune and musculoskeletal diseases.
  • Clinical practice experience within Rheumatology.
  • A background in the clinical aspects of drug development, including experience with Medical Monitoring and clinical study design and/or execution.
  • Experience within rheumatology clinical research or clinical trials is highly desirable.
  • Good knowledge of the drug development process, including drug safety/pharmacovigilance, preferred.
  • Experience in Pharmaceutical Medicine is preferred.
  • Experience leading, mentoring and/or managing physicians or multidisciplinary teams is preferred.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Education


  • Medically qualified from a recognised medical school, with completion of appropriate postgraduate clinical training.
  • Postgraduate specialist training or recognised specialist qualification in Rheumatology is strongly preferred.

Skills


  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to build credible relationships with sponsor and client counterparts.
  • Strong client-focused approach to work.
  • Excellent time-management and organisational skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written medical communication skills.
  • Excellent standard of written and spoken English.
  • A flexible approach to work assignments and an enthusiasm for continued learning.
  • Ability to manage multiple and varied tasks, prioritise effectively and maintain a high level of attention to detail.
  • Ability and willingness to work effectively within a global, cross-functional matrix environment.
  • Strong appreciation of teamwork and collaboration across medical, clinical, safety and operational functions.

About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

10

Sales Compensation Analyst – Strategic Incentive Programs & Payee Lifecycle


The Team

We are a high-accountability, globally connected Sales Compensation team that values disciplined execution, a strong sense of urgency, and end-to-end ownership. We expect our people to understand the full lifecycle of their work, anticipate downstream impacts, and communicate outcomes with exceptional clarity, whether supporting our broad population of 1,500+ plan participants or partnering with C-level executives. We value precision, responsiveness, sound judgment, collaboration, and people who take ownership through to resolution.


Responsibilities and Impact

If you are at your best when problems are complex, the data is messy, and the stakes are real, this role was built for you. As the operational owner of global SPIFF programs and end-to-end payee lifecycle management at S&P Global Market Intelligence, you will work at the intersection of Commercial Strategy, People Operations, and Sales Finance — ensuring that every compensation event, from a seller's first day to their last commission payment, is calculated precisely, governed rigorously, and resolved with integrity. This is the function that handles what the standard monthly process cannot — and if that is where you do your best work, this role will give you the scope and the challenge to match.

  • Own end-to-end SPIFF operations — translate commercial campaign briefs into precise qualification criteria, crediting logic, and system rate tables; build automated tracking engines using SQL, Python, or Alteryx to monitor real-time attainment and prevent duplicate claims, eligibility mismatches, and off-policy spend; execute all calculations; deliver post-campaign ROI analytics and spend assessments in Power BI; and archive all eligibility criteria, budget sign-offs, and documentation for full audit-readiness.
  • Architect and execute active payee lifecycle workflows — manage system setup, prorated quota assignments, draw and guarantee schedules, and ramping accelerators for new hires; model and execute effective-dated target adjustments and split crediting rules for mid-year promotions and role changes; and calculate accurate quota relief, crediting freezes, and temporary account coverage allocations for leaves of absence, in line with regional labour policies and commercial guidelines.
  • Own departure and offboarding precision — compute final commission settlements, accelerated vesting, trailing pipeline revenue, and exit reconciliation packages for terminations; manage post-departure claw back reconciliations; and build automated script-based routines linking HRIS platforms, including Workday, with enterprise compensation engines to detect personnel changes, effective-date discrepancies, and reporting line anomalies ahead of payroll processing.
  • Conduct forensic financial investigations and resolve disputes — lead evidence-based technical investigations into high-value sales disputes, contested crediting splits, and payout grievances; model the exact net financial impact of deal cancellations, de-bookings, retroactive invoicing revisions, and claw back schedules; prepare objective, data-backed recalculation findings with clear step-by-step mathematical explanations for commercial representatives and sales leadership; and partner with Legal and People Partners on sensitive executive escalations requiring precise scenario modelling.
  • Serve as the operational governance and audit liaison — partner with the centralised Governance and Compliance team to operationalize compensation policies; compile audit-ready exception packages for manual overrides, custom draws, departure payouts, and non-standard SPIFF rewards; and supply calculation extracts, system logs, approval documentation, and payee lifecycle audit trails for internal and external SOX testing upon request.

Compensation and Benefits (US Candidates Only)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,817 to $125,091. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit:


What We Are Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in sales compensation administration, incentive program management, or sales operations within a multinational organisation.
  • Incentive Program and SPIFF Expertise: Proven track record designing, tracking, and executing tactical commercial incentive programs, SPIFFs, and accelerator campaigns with rigorous budget controls and full audit documentation.
  • Payee Lifecycle: Demonstrated experience managing payee lifecycle mechanics including quota proration, draw and guarantee accounting, effective-dated crediting, leave of absence adjustments, and final offboarding commission calculations.
  • SQL and Automation: Advanced SQL proficiency for querying multi-table databases, HRIS tables, and transaction ledgers, combined with hands-on experience using at least one automation or reconciliation tool — Python/Pandas, Alteryx, or Excel/VBA — to reconcile HR data against compensation engines.
  • Enterprise Platforms: Practical administration experience with at least one enterprise incentive platform — Varicent, Xactly, Anaplan, or SAP Commissions — and at least one HRIS platform, including Workday.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building automated SPIFF tracking engines or reconciliation routines that integrate HRIS data with enterprise compensation systems in real time.
  • Experience conducting post-campaign ROI analytics and spend assessments using Power BI, including presenting commercial velocity and incentive effectiveness insights to sales leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting technical, evidence-based financial investigations into high-value sales disputes, contested crediting splits, and payout grievances — including modelling the net financial impact of deal cancellations, de-bookings, and retroactive adjustments.
  • Experience compiling audit-ready exception packages and SOX documentation — including calculation extracts, system logs, approval records, and payee lifecycle audit trails — in support of internal and external audit testing.
  • Experience partnering with Legal and People Partners on sensitive executive compensation escalations and unique dispute resolution scenarios.
  • Experience translating complex commission calculations, SPIFF qualification criteria, and lifecycle adjustments into clear, non-technical explanations for sales representatives and commercial leadership.
  • Experience supporting compensation continuity during organizational changes — including corporate transactions, spinoffs, or workforce reductions — by mapping affected payee structures and ensuring accurate lifecycle adjustments throughout the transition.

Right to Work Requirements

This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States.


Return to Work — Restart

Have you taken time out for caring responsibilities and are now looking to return to work? As part of our Return to Work initiative, Restart, we are encouraging enthusiastic and talented returners to apply, and will actively support your return to the workplace.

What’s In It For You?

Our Mission:

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People:

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values:
Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Benefits:

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

  • Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.

  • Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.

  • Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.

  • Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

  • Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.

For more information on benefits by country visit:

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. About the Company

Optain is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking software and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we detect and manage eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through the introduction of AI and machine learning technology in frontline care settings at an accessible price. This not only promotes greater access to care, but promises to reduce the strains of overburdened healthcare systems.

Originally founded in Australia in 2019, Optain seeks to commercialize the inventions of Professor Mingguang He, a preeminent clinician-scientist and scholar in the field of ophthalmology. Optain has achieved regulatory approval and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, Europe, and more.

In 2025, Optain received US FDA clearance for its Resolve retinal camera. Optain also recently closed a Series A funding round led by Insight Partners with participation from seven leading U.S. health system investors, including Memorial Hermann Health System, Northwell Health, Novant Health, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and UPMC. These systems collectively deliver care to 28 million patients across 25 states and have begun deploying Optain's platform across their networks, rapidly accelerating the company's footprint and expanding screening access nationwide.

About the Job

As the Product Operations and Support Specialist, you will be the escalation point for customers using Optain’s robotic retinal camera and supporting software. Because our product is a tightly integrated hardware-software medical device deployed in live clinical settings, you will troubleshoot issues that span device hardware, image capture software, image quality, connectivity, EHR integrations, and downstream teleophthalmology grading workflows. In the U.S., Optain pairs its FDA-cleared Resolve camera with rapid teleophthalmology grading; in international markets, Optain offers AI-enabled Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) for screening common eye diseases and cardiovascular risk.

This is a high-ownership, U.S.-based remote role on a growing product team, reporting to the VP of Product. Beyond hands-on Tier 2 support, issue investigation, and medical device complaint handling, you will enable our Customer Support team, feed real-world signal back to the Product team, and own the internal operations, tooling, and projects that make the Product and Support teams more effective.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as Tier 2 support for customers who escalate device feedback, complaints, and semi-technical product issues; reproducing, diagnosing, and resolving problems across the hardware-software boundary, distinguishing camera or hardware faults from software, image-quality, connectivity, EHR-integration, or user technique issues.
  • Capture, document, and route device feedback and complaints in line with Optain’s quality management system and applicable regulations (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR), recognizing when feedback may constitute a reportable complaint or potential adverse event and escalating appropriately to Quality and Regulatory.
  • Support the Customer Success team with semi-technical product and onboarding questions, acting as the bridge between front-line CS and Engineering support. Contribute to knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and training resources that enable CS to resolve more issues independently.
  • Own internal operations and projects for the product team, including specifying requirements for internal support tooling, improving support and complaint-handling workflows, and coordinating cross-functional projects from intake to delivery.
  • Support Quality in tracking and analyzing support and complaint trends, translate recurring problems into prioritized product improvement recommendations, and serve as a voice of the customer within the product organization.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Customer Success to ensure issues are resolved quickly while meeting the documentation rigor required of a regulated medical device.

What You'll Need

  • 3+ years in technical support, product support, application support, or product operations for software as a medical device (SaMD), or combined hardware software medical device product.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across hardware-software boundaries, isolating whether a problem originates in a hardware device, software, image quality, connectivity, or user technique. Ability to reproduce issues occurring on equipment at a remote customer site.
  • Familiarity working within a quality management system and complaint-handling processes in a regulated environment (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR, ISO 13485, or EU MDR), including an understanding of when an issue may be a reportable complaint or adverse event.
  • Strong written communication, with a track record of building knowledge base articles, runbooks, or training that enables less-technical teammates to resolve issues independently. Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
  • Operational initiative and project ownership experience, including gathering requirements for internal tools or processes, prioritizing competing work, and driving cross-functional projects to completion with minimal oversight in a remote team setting.
  • Bonus: experience with imaging medical devices, telemedicine, EHR integrations, or clinical workflows in a primary care or point-of-care setting.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package, including a strong base salary, performance-based bonus, and the chance to earn equity upside in Optain.
  • This role is scoped to grow. As the US footprint expands, we expect the person in it to take on broader ownership of customer operations.
  • Top-tier health, vision, and dental benefits.
  • Generous monthly health and wellness reimbursement.
  • Unparalleled exposure to business scaling at the intersection of artificial intelligence and healthcare.
  • The opportunity to help solve difficult problems and collaborate with world-class experts from healthcare provider networks, academia, and industry.
  • A chance to work with a highly talented, close-knit team and world-leading mentors who can act as a support network and sounding board throughout your professional journey.

Why Optain?Make a real difference: Your work will help solve difficult problems as you collaborate with world-class experts from healthcare provider networks, academia, and industry. Join Optain in transforming healthcare with AI!

Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference

The Product Designer contributes to end-to-end digital experiences that support Care Access participants, members, and the internal teams who serve them. This role translates complex, evolving needs across health screenings, clinical research, participant engagement, recruitment, member services, and operational workflows into clear, accessible, and intuitive product experiences.

Working with the Principal Product Designer and cross-functional partners in product, engineering, research, and relevant business or operational teams, the Product Designer owns assigned design work from problem definition through delivery. Depending on priorities, the work may include participant-facing experiences or internal tools used by recruitment, member services, clinical research coordinators, and other teams that engage and support participants.

Day to day, this mid-level designer moves between discovery, workflow definition, hands-on interface design, prototyping, feedback, and implementation support. The role requires comfort shifting between products as priorities evolve, sharing work early, incorporating feedback, and partnering closely with developers to deliver practical, high-quality solutions.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Design and iterate on user flows, wireframes, low- and high-fidelity mockups, interactive prototypes, and final interface specifications, primarily using Figma or comparable tools.
    • Day-to-day work may include:

      • Incorporating stakeholder critique and user feedback;
      • Providing developers with clear behaviors, content, and visual details for implementation.

    • Typical activities include:

      • Asking clarifying questions to understand the user and business outcomes the design should support.

    • Responsibilities include:
      • Helping prepare research questions and prototypes;

      • Capturing themes, sharing findings, and translating insights into prioritized design changes.
  • Monitor and improve the quality and effectiveness of released product experiences.

jobs.title: Master Data Manager
jobs.excerpt: Salary - 120K - 136KLocation - Onsite or RemotePosition Summary:Nordic Naturals is seeking a strategic, collaborative, and process-oriented Master Data Manager to administer and operationalize the Company's enterprise Master Data operating model.
jobs.description:
Salary - 120K - 136K

Location - Onsite or Remote

Position Summary:

Nordic Naturals is seeking a strategic, collaborative, and process-oriented Master Data Manager to administer and operationalize the Company's enterprise Master Data operating model. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Accounting Operations, this role is responsible for day-to-day Master Data governance, standards, data quality, lifecycle controls, and continuous improvement across customer, vendor/business partner, material, pricing, hierarchy, and finance data domains.

This position serves as the central link among business data owners, Finance, Information Technology, SAP teams, and other enterprise stakeholders. Business functions remain accountable for the content and business decisions within their domains, while the Master Data Manager owns the governance process, workflow discipline, quality framework, documentation, and execution needed to create trusted, consistent, secure, and scalable Master Data. The role facilitates the Data Governance Council led by the Senior Manager, translates approved decisions into action, and helps ensure Master Data supports SAP S/4HANA, automation, analytics, operational excellence, compliance, and future growth.

Reasonable Accommodations Statement:

To accomplish this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation, each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Key Responsibilities/Essential Functions:

  • Master Data Strategy & Roadmap:Translate the enterprise Master Data design, strategy, vision, and priorities established by the Senior Manager and Data Governance Council into practical standards, procedures, controls, implementation plans, and a measurable roadmap.
  • Data Governance Council Facilitation: Facilitate the Data Governance Council led by the Senior Manager by preparing agendas, decision materials, recommendations, metrics, action registers, and follow-up. Administer approved decision rights, priorities, standards, and escalation paths across data domains.
  • Enterprise Standards & Policies: Develop, document, maintain, and enforce enterprise data definitions, naming conventions, validation rules, ownership requirements, approval standards, retention expectations, and operating procedures in alignment with approved governance policy.
  • Master Data Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end processes and workflows for creating, changing, extending, blocking, and retiring Master Data, including request intake, validation, approval, documentation, segregation of duties, change control, and service-level expectations.
  • Data Domain Governance: Administer governance across customer, vendor/business partner, bank, material, pricing, hierarchy, and finance Master Data, including the chart of accounts, cost centers, profit centers, internal orders, payment terms, and reason codes.
  • Data Quality Management: Establish data-quality rules, monitoring, dashboards, and remediation processes. Prevent and resolve duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent, inaccurate, or noncompliant data and coordinate root-cause corrective actions with business and technical owners.
  • Business Data Owner Partnership: Partner with data owners and stewards across Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Manufacturing, and other functions. Clarify accountability, support timely decisions, and ensure business owners remain responsible for data content within their domains.
  • SAP & Systems Partnership: Partner with Information Technology and SAP teams on configurations, integrations, enhancements, workflow automation, testing, releases, user acceptance testing, cutover, and stabilization activities affecting Master Data.
  • Issue Management & Escalation: Lead cross-functional investigation and resolution of enterprise Master Data issues, manage escalations according to the approved governance model, and identify preventive improvements that reduce rework, delays, and downstream business impact.
  • Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness: Ensure Master Data activities comply with Company policies, authorization requirements, security standards, internal controls, regulatory expectations, and audit requirements while maintaining complete and accurate supporting documentation.
  • Change Management & Enablement: Develop communications, training, process guidance, and adoption support for data owners, stewards, requestors, approvers, and system users. Promote consistent use of standards and build enterprise understanding of Master Data responsibilities.
  • Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Define, analyze, and report KPIs such as data quality, duplicate reduction, request cycle time, first-time-right processing, issue aging, business satisfaction, and compliance or audit results. Use insights to prioritize automation and process improvements.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead through influence across functions and levels, establish shared accountability, support enterprise initiatives, and act as the primary operational point of contact for Master Data governance and process questions.
  • Additional Responsibilities: Complete additional responsibilities, projects, and operational support activities as assigned.

Position Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in Master Data management, data governance, ERP-enabled business processes, business systems, Finance operations, Supply Chain operations, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional governance, process-design, data-quality, or enterprise change initiatives through influence and shared accountability.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA or a comparable enterprise ERP system; experience with SAP Business Partner, material, customer, vendor, or finance Master Data is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Master Data governance principles, lifecycle management, data ownership and stewardship models, workflow controls, data quality, metadata, and issue remediation.
  • Strong understanding of internal controls, segregation of duties, security, change management, compliance, documentation, and audit-readiness requirements.
  • Ability to translate complex business and system requirements into clear policies, procedures, standards, workflows, decision materials, and training.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify root causes, interpret data-quality and process metrics, prioritize risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and reporting or data-analysis tools; experience with workflow, data-quality, or governance tools is preferred.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to build alignment across technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain disciplined follow-through, and operate effectively in a changing environment.
  • Data-management, governance, project-management, or process-improvement certification (such as CDMP, PMP, or Lean Six Sigma) is preferred but not required.

Competency Statements

  • Strategic Leadership - Translates enterprise direction into clear Master Data priorities, standards, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
  • Integrity and Trust - Handles sensitive business data responsibly and builds confidence through transparency, consistency, sound judgment, and ethical decision-making.
  • Accountability - Establishes clear ownership, follows through on commitments, escalates risk appropriately, and drives decisions and actions to completion.
  • Critical Thinking - Evaluates complex business and system information, identifies root causes and downstream impacts, and recommends practical, risk-based solutions.
  • Communication and Facilitation - Communicates complex data and system topics clearly, facilitates productive governance discussions, and documents decisions and expectations.
  • Collaboration and Influence - Builds alignment across functions and levels, respects business ownership, and leads through influence in a shared-accountability environment.
  • Change Leadership - Guides stakeholders through new standards, systems, workflows, and responsibilities with clear communication, training, empathy, and disciplined follow-through.
  • Business Acumen - Understands how Master Data affects customers, vendors, supply chain, finance, reporting, controls, operational performance, and Company growth.
  • Attention to Detail and Data Stewardship - Maintains high standards for accuracy, completeness, documentation, security, and control while balancing enterprise needs and operational practicality.
  • Continuous Improvement - Uses metrics, stakeholder feedback, and root-cause analysis to prevent recurring issues, improve automation, reduce cycle time, and strengthen data quality.

About the Job:

The Principal, Talent Planning & Design leads the end-to-end design and continuous evolution of integrated workforce and talent ecosystem that help the enterprise anticipate future talent needs, understand talent supply, build critical skills, strengthen leadership pipelines and enable employee growth. The role connects Strategic Workforce Planning, skills, talent review, succession and career development to improve decisions about workforce capacity, talent readiness, development priorities and succession risk while creating clearer pathways for employees to grow and contribute.


This leader translates workforce and talent insights into practical, scalable processes, decision frameworks, governance, user experiences and enabling requirements that improve decisions about workforce capacity, skills, talent readiness, development priorities and succession risk.


Working across Talent, Finance, Technology, HR Technology, Talent Analytics, HR Business Partners and business leadership, the role translates complex workforce and talent needs into scalable, user-centered processes, decision frameworks and experiences. This is not a technology configuration role; its enduring purpose is to turn workforce insights into practical talent and workforce actions that strengthen organizational readiness.


Key outcomes driven by this role

  • An integrated skills intelligence and workforce planning ecosystem in which internal and external talent-market signals inform scenario modeling, workforce investment decisions, and build, buy, borrow, redeploy and automate strategies.
  • A clear, scalable Strategic Workforce Planning process and experience that supports enterprise strategy, operating and financial planning, scenario decisions and workforce investment tradeoffs.
  • Modernized talent review and succession practices that use workforce demand, talent supply and skills data to improve visibility to critical roles, talent readiness, pipeline depth, development priorities and emerging talent risks.
  • A skills-based talent experience that embeds skills into workforce planning, talent decisions, career growth and development, with measurable adoption by employees, leaders and HR.
  • Career and development experiences that help employees explore opportunities, build relevant skills, create meaningful development plans and make progress in the flow of work.
  • Consistent, data-informed and user-centered decisions supported by fit-for-purpose technology, clear governance, defined ownership and continuous improvement.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic Workforce Planning

  • Partner with Strategic Workforce Planning to design and continuously improve the processes, experiences, and enabling capabilities through which the enterprise SWP strategy is executed, connecting business strategy, operating plans, financial planning, workforce demand, talent supply, skills, capacity, cost, location, and timing.
  • Translate workforce planning needs into practical process designs, planning activities, decision points, user journeys, governance routines, data and reporting requirements, and adoption plans.
  • Design scenario-planning approaches and experience that enables leaders to assess workforce gaps and evaluate investment tradeoffs, including potential build, buy, borrow, redeploy, or automate actions.

Integrated Talent and Succession Planning

  • Design how workforce demand, talent supply, skills, talent review, succession, and development practices work together to support enterprise talent decisions.
  • Lead the design and continuous improvement of talent review, calibration, and succession processes, including approaches for identifying critical roles, evaluating readiness, assessing succession coverage (talent pools), and identifying talent risks.
  • Translate succession insights into enterprise risk visibility, including critical role coverage, depth of successor pools, readiness gaps, mobility constraints, and exposure in business-critical leadership roles.

Skills, Career, and Development Experience Design

  • Lead the integration and continuous evolution of skills across workforce planning and talent experiences, ensuring skills insights consistently inform talent decisions, career growth, internal mobility, and employee development.
  • Lead the design and evolution of career and development experiences, including career exploration, career & development conversations, and visibility to internal opportunities.
  • Translate employee and leader needs into requirements for enabling capabilities such as personalized learning suggestions, development plans, career navigation, opportunity marketplaces, gigs, internal networking, and other skills-enabled recommendations.
  • Create mechanisms to identify, track, and activate enterprise talent across business units, ensuring high-potential and succession-critical talent is visible beyond current reporting lines.

Process, Experience, and Technology Enablement

  • Apply user-centered design methods to understand business, employee, leader, and HR needs and translate them into scalable processes, decision frameworks, user experiences, and supporting resources.
  • Partner with HR Engineering, HR Technology, Business Finance, and Strategic Workforce Planning teams to define business requirements & priorities, data needs & reporting expectations that informs decisions, and experience considerations needed to design SWP and talent solutions.
  • Develop enablement, guidance, and adoption approaches that help users understand new processes and capabilities, incorporate them into their work, and apply them consistently.

Governance, Measurement, and Enterprise Partnership

  • Establish governance models that clarify enterprise standards, ownership, decision rights, cross-functional handoffs, operating rhythms, and approaches for managing exceptions.
  • Define success measures and use workforce data, experience insights, stakeholder feedback, and adoption indicators to identify friction, improve processes, and inform future design priorities.
  • Facilitate cross-functional discovery and decision-making, advise senior stakeholders, and communicate complex workforce and talent concepts clearly across executive, business, HR, and technical audiences.

What Experience You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Finance, Strategy, Design, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in Strategic Workforce Planning, workforce strategy, talent management, succession, career development, skills strategy, organizational effectiveness, talent management experience design, HR or Talent consulting or related disciplines.
  • Depth of experience in Strategic Workforce Planning, including scenario planning, talent demand and supply, workforce economics, skills-based planning, workforce strategy or labor investment decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience in integrating talent review, succession planning, career development and skills-based talent practices with workforce data and planning insights, rather than managing them as separate processes.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and evolving enterprise talent, workforce, organizational effectiveness, or planning solutions that are practical, scalable, user-centered, and connected to business outcomes.

jobs.title: Development Program Specialist
jobs.excerpt: What We Can Achieve Together: The Development Program Specialist will be an integral part of the Virginia Development team, whose goal is to secure funding and ensure financial sustainability for the conservation priorities of the Virginia Business Unit and beyond.
jobs.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:


The Development Program Specialist will be an integral part of the Virginia Development team, whose goal is to secure funding and ensure financial sustainability for the conservation priorities of the Virginia Business Unit and beyond. This is a remote position in the Eastern Standard Time zone and expected to work 9am – 5pm EST.

The Specialist will be responsible for all aspects of gift processing to ensure that donor gifts are received and acknowledged as per TNC’s best practices and compliance. They will manage gift coding, record gifts in the donor database and work with other philanthropy and finance staff to track donor commitments and associated documentation, as well as reporting requirements. The Specialist will prepare and update fundraising dashboards and track philanthropic contributions.

The Specialist, with the Development Operations Manager, will serve as subject matter expert for data management in the donor database (Blackbaud CRM). They will create, update, and maintain constituent records and perform data entry functions for the team as needed. They will produce reports and queries from the donor database in support of fundraising efforts including events, donor mailings, and pledge reminder letters. They may assist with special initiatives.

The Specialist will conduct research on prospective and current donors and support the writing of strategic internal and external facing documents.

The Specialist must maintain advanced skills with the systems in order to execute tasks and provide support to team members. They will implement processes and practices in order to improve effectiveness based on their in-depth understanding of related policies and procedures. The Specialist will effectively communicate and collaborate widely with internal stakeholders and assist staff in making decisions, solving problems, and improving workflows. They will maintain a robust peer network to stay up to date on best practice


We’re Looking for You:


Want to help save the planet? The Nature Conservancy’s Virginia program works to create a future where people and nature thrive together. Our innovative science-based solutions are designed to secure clean water in our rivers and bays, restore healthy forests from the Appalachians to the Atlantic, protect our oceans and coasts, and foster resilient communities. We are looking for a self-driven individual who is able to work independently in a fast-paced environment. Relationship building, project coordination and intellectual curiosity will be key to this role.


Responsibilities & Scope:


  • Process and manages all commitments (pledges and intentions), outright gift processing and any other contributions for Virginia Business Unit
  • Create financial and non-financial adjustments for all Virginia Business Unit
  • Create Grant ID requests, in collaboration with Finance
  • Development support for Virginia quarterly pledge reviews
  • Troubleshooting of delayed processing and uncommitted batches, in collaboration with Director of Development Operations
  • Ensure that all revenue coding adheres to SOP requirements and provides advice to team
  • Manage database maintenance
  • Conduct research on prospective and current donors, creating briefings and updating donor profiles in the database
  • Demonstrate sensitivity in handling confidential information
  • Assist in ad-hoc projects and tasks
  • Act independently on assigned tasks and exercise independent judgment based on analysis and experience
  • Coordinate a variety of complex projects, working within a defined timeline and budget
  • Ensure compliance with TNC policies and procedures, and external (donor/legal/IRS) requirements
  • Travel to Virginia or other TNC locations at least twice a year for TNC-related workshops or projects

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of experience in gift coding or database management or equivalent combination.
  • Experience working with CRM relational databases, including managing and tracking data.
  • Experience building relationships with staff, customers, or similar.
  • Strong organization skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.
  • Experience generating reports and interpreting data.
  • Experience in business writing, editing, and proofreading.
  • Experience working across teams.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience are appreciated.
  • Ability to analyze information for the purpose of coordinating or planning activities and solving problems.
  • Ability to work under pressure and perform repetitive data entry tasks.
  • Experience interpreting guidelines to achieve desired results.
  • Ability to communicate clearly about a variety of complex topics, verbally and in writing.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience, coursework, or other training in principles and practices of relevant field

Salary Information:


The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $60,000-$80,000 annually. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.


Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

Job Description

A bit about this role:


Our Member Services team has the opportunity to make a difference every single day in the complex world of healthcare. Devoted Health’s Guides are the primary point of support for our members — answering benefit questions, connecting them with care providers, enrolling them in clinical programs, and navigating the healthcare system alongside them. We aim to treat every member as we would our own family. As a Supervisor, you are the person who makes that possible at scale.


In this role, you will lead and develop a frontline team of Guides who deliver high-quality, compassionate service across inbound OR digital channels. Depending on your placement, your team may focus on direct member service in our inbound call center OR our digital call center (Chat, SMS, Portal) avenues — and you should be prepared to lead effectively across any of these contexts. What stays constant is your commitment: building a team where Guides can bring their authentic and caring selves to every interaction, and where every member feels genuinely supported.

This role requires sound professional judgment, a genuine passion for developing people, and the ability to balance member needs, operational goals, and compliance requirements in a fast-moving environment. You’ll succeed here if you lead with empathy, communicate with honesty, thrive in complexity, and approach every challenge with curiosity and a growth mindset.


Your responsibilities and impact will include:


People leadership and team development:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Guides through tailored plans and constructive feedback.
  • Conduct 1:1s, observations, and call reviews to ensure quality and drive improvement.
  • Assess individual strengths and adapt coaching styles to provide actionable feedback.
  • Foster a psychologically safe, transparent culture that values authenticity.
  • Act as a player-coach when necessary.
  • Guide the team through organizational changes with transparency.
  • Assist in talent acquisition by interviewing and recommending candidates.

Performance management and operational excellence:

  • Manage team metrics (quality, productivity, compliance, attendance) to drive improvement.
  • Communicate the "why" behind metrics to motivate Guides.
  • Address performance gaps promptly with clear paths forward.
  • Ensure consistent adherence to service levels, quality, and compliance standards.
  • Handle escalated interactions professionally, using them as coaching opportunities.
  • Maintain accountability for yourself and ensure fair, consistent expectations for your team.

Operations, innovation, and cross-functional collaboration:

  • Identify process gaps and improve workflows, tools, and member experience.
  • Champion AI and automation, piloting solutions and enabling your team to use them.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to enhance resolution.
  • Support broader Guide organization needs during peak seasons or volume surges.
  • Communicate effectively upward by providing context and actionable recommendations.
  • Advocate for resources and improvements that benefit both the team and members.

Required skills and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) with proven leadership in a metrics-driven call center environment/high volume customer service environment, and a demonstrated ability to translate operational data into motivating, actionable coaching.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, empathy, and professionalism to navigate sensitive situations while leading effectively as a hands-on player-coach.
  • Proactive ownership mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Adaptability, resilience, and a growth mindset in fast-moving environments.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience managing frontline teams in a contact center or healthcare.
  • Background in health insurance/operations (Medicare Advantage is a plus).
  • Strong analytical skills to spot trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with compliance and documentation in highly regulated environments.

Salary: $58,000 – $67,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. jobs.description:
Description

Operación a nivel binacional entre México y Estados Unidos, escalando operaciones B2B de alto valor (High-Ticket) mediante tecnología, sistemas predecibles e Inteligencia Artificial.

No somos una empresa tradicional, ni un corporativo lento y burocrático; somos una firma de alto rendimiento donde los datos, los sistemas y la automatización dictan las reglas del juego. Si buscas un entorno cómodo para hacer marketing de la vieja escuela, no sigas leyendo. Si buscas dinamismo y cambio constante, este lugar es para ti.

Misión del Puesto No buscamos a un mercadólogo tradicional, diseñador gráfico o creador de contenido manual. Buscamos a un operador técnico híbrido capaz de construir, operar y escalar sistemas de adquisición de clientes B2B utilizando infraestructura 100% automatizada (Zero-Human). Tu misión es transformar el presupuesto publicitario en reuniones de alto valor (High-Ticket) y escalar nuestra presencia digital ejecutando la visión estratégica mediante Inteligencia Artificial, dejando atrás la creación manual y las tareas repetitivas. Además construirás un evolución en el modelo de negocio de la compañía, automatizando y empaquetando tareas repetitivas, dejando a los humanos como arquitectos y optimizadores del sistema.

Responsabilidades Core

  • Content Ops & Generación con IA: Producción, edición y escalado de videos y creativos para redes sociales utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (HeyGen, CapCut Pro, ElevenLabs, Midjourney/DALL-E, entre muchas mas). Eres un operador que convierte directrices estratégicas en volumen de contenido mediante prompts y plantillas dinámicas a alta velocidad.
  • Ingeniería de Embudos (GoHighLevel): Arquitecturar y optimizar landing pages, muros de pago integrados con Stripe, calendarios de agendamiento y secuencias implacables de nutrición por correo y SMS. Todo prospecto debe ser calificado y enrutado sin intervención humana.
  • Orquestación de Datos (): Diseñar y mantener los webhooks y automatizaciones que conectan Meta Ads, GoHighLevel, bases de datos (Airtable/Softr) y APIs externas.
  • Media Buying Algorítmico: Gestionar pauta publicitaria en Meta y LinkedIn Ads enfocándose estrictamente en el Costo por Adquisición (CPA) y Retorno de Inversión (ROAS). Implementar reglas de apagado y escalado basadas en el rendimiento diario de los datos.
  • Prompt Engineering aplicado a Growth: Inyectar contexto estructurado en modelos LLM (Claude, GPT-4) para la generación masiva de copys para anuncios, correos de prospección hiper-personalizados y extracción de datos.

El Perfil que NO Buscamos (Red Flags)

  • Diseñadores o editores manuales que tardan días en entregar un video en Premiere/Illustrator y se resisten a utilizar IA para multiplicar su velocidad.
  • Community Managers enfocados en "likes", paletas de colores o estética por encima de la conversión y los sistemas.
  • Perfiles teóricos que necesitan que un desarrollador externo les conecte una API, estructure un JSON o les configure un webhook.

Requisitos Técnicos Innegociables

  • Dominio operativo de herramientas de IA generativa para video, audio y texto.
  • Dominio avanzado de (o nivel experto en Zapier) para manipulación de JSON, iteradores, enrutadores y lógica condicional.
  • Experiencia demostrable operando GoHighLevel (workflows, pipelines, triggers, automatización de calendarios).
  • Dominio del Business Manager de Meta enfocado en conversión a embudos externos (Pixel, API de conversiones, eventos personalizados).

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS — GROWTH AUTOMATION & AI CONTENT ENGINEER

  • 3+ years of experience in Growth Marketing, Marketing Automation, Performance Marketing, or Marketing Technology.
  • Proven experience building and scaling automated B2B customer acquisition systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI tools for video, audio, image, and text production.
  • Advanced proficiency in Make.com (or expert-level Zapier experience), including webhooks, JSON manipulation, iterators, routers, and conditional logic.
  • Demonstrated experience operating GoHighLevel (GHL), including workflows, pipelines, triggers, calendars, and marketing automation.
  • Strong experience managing Meta Ads campaigns, focused on lead generation and conversion through external funnels.
  • Technical knowledge of Meta Business Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and custom conversion events.
  • Experience building and optimizing landing pages, sales funnels, booking calendars, and automated lead nurturing sequences.
  • Experience integrating platforms such as Meta Ads, GoHighLevel, Airtable, Softr, Stripe, and external APIs.
  • Ability to design, implement, and troubleshoot webhooks, API integrations, and automated data flows.
  • Experience developing AI-powered content at scale using tools such as HeyGen, CapCut Pro, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, DALL-E, or similar platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Prompt Engineering and practical experience using LLMs such as ChatGPT, Claude, or GPT-based models.
  • Experience generating and optimizing ad copy, personalized outreach emails, and automated content using AI.
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing metrics, including CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, and lead acquisition costs.
  • Ability to manage and optimize multiple campaigns, automation workflows, and acquisition systems simultaneously.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose API integrations, webhook failures, JSON structures, and data synchronization issues.
  • Bilingual communication skills (English/Spanish) are desirable, given the company's binational operations.
  • Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills.
  • High level of autonomy, ownership, adaptability, and execution speed.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment with constantly evolving priorities.
  • Results-driven mindset, prioritizing automation, scalability, efficiency, and revenue generation over vanity metrics.

IDEAL PROFILE

3+ years of experience + Growth Marketing / Marketing Automation background + Advanced Make.com + GoHighLevel expertise + Meta Ads + API integrations + AI-powered content production + Prompt Engineering + B2B lead generation funnels + CPA/ROAS optimization + strong technical execution and ownership.

jobs.title: Senior Global Technical Consultant - Personal Care
jobs.excerpt: At Ecolab, making the world a cleaner, safer place is our business.
jobs.description:
At Ecolab, making the world a cleaner, safer place is our business. In the Life Sciences division, we are committed to providing complete solutions for the Personal Care industry. We achieve this by providing comprehensive solutions and technical know-how focused on ensuring product quality and safety in cleaning, sanitation and contamination control while improving operational efficiency.


Ecolab is a company committed to growth and we believe that the role of Senior Global Technical Consultant is one of the keys to our success in the Life Sciences division. As leaders in cleaning and disinfection, we are committed to driving business growth while providing individuals with a range of developmental career opportunities. The members of our team have an opportunity to help customers meet their goals, differentiate Ecolab from competition and impact achievement of growth targets.

Position Purpose:

The Senior Global Technical Consultant (GTC) role is designed to work alongside customers at their facilities to identify improvement opportunities related to cleaning, disinfection, plant hygiene, driving value through improved product quality, employee and operational efficiency while ensuring regulatory compliance. This service is a key differentiator for Ecolab’s existing and potential customers.


The candidate will be expected to provide support/input for customers in the Personal Care, Cosmetics, and Dietary Supplement sectors related to cleaning and disinfection, application of Ecolab products and industry best practices. They will provide clean-in-place and clean-out-of-place optimization through technical visits and site surveys. They will provide cleaning validation guidance and training to customers to ensure compliant cleaning processes once implemented. The role will also provide guidance to internal and external customers on “best practice” processes and products which can support these activities. The role is responsible for technically supporting the implementation of improvements and providing a link between customers and the internal sales teams.


This role will be US-based but responsibilities may include liaising with customers and the sales team and traveling to international customer sites as needed.

This is a remote role. Candidates can reside anywhere in the US near a major airport. Preference is Midwest or Southeast US regions.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical expertise to resolve complex customer problems related to cleaning and hygiene across a broad base of Personal Care manufacturing applications.
  • Conduct customer technical visits and site surveys, reviewing customer contamination control practices and the cleaning/disinfection products in place to ensure they are both compliant and efficient. Provide documented recommendations and support recommended improvements.
  • Assist the customer in their change control process, which may include project management support, SOP guidance, and validation consultation.
  • Conduct internal trainings and customer-facing seminars on cGMPs, cleaning & disinfection best practices, cleaning technologies, and cleaning validation principles
  • Assist in communicating best practices and key learnings to the greater field sales organization
  • Provide leadership on unique customer projects which are beyond the expected technical ability of Account Managers or Regional Managers
  • Ensure brand standards and awareness, accuracy and completion of final reports in a timely manner

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Life Sciences, preferably with operations or engineering focus
  • 10 years of practical experience in relevant industry
  • Experience in understanding/troubleshooting of cleaning and CIP operations
  • Experience in executing or supporting cleaning validation programs
  • Ability to travel 50%+ of time based on customer needs
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Valid drivers license
  • Ability to obtain Visas for International travel
  • No immigration sponsorship available for this opportunity

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Life Sciences field, preferably in Operations or Engineering
  • Experience or familiarity with the Life Sciences industry (Pharmaceutical and/or Personal Care)
  • Demonstrated proficiency with internal or external auditing
  • Demonstrated project leadership and understanding of change control processes
  • Ability to take initiative, work independently and prioritize multiple projects with strong follow-through
  • Flexibility to work on and control different projects at the same time while still meeting deadlines
  • Previous experience in GMP production sites
  • Understanding regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g. MHRA, FDA, HPRA)

Annual or Hourly Compensation Range

The total Compensation range for this position is $128,600-$193,000 which includes base pay and target incentive based on performance, per plan terms. Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws.

Benefits

Ecolab strives to provide comprehensive and market-competitive benefits to meet the needs of our associates and their families. Click here to see our benefits.

If you are viewing this posting on a site other than our Ecolab Career website, view our benefits at jobs.ecolab.com/working-here.


Potential Customer Requirements Notice

To meet customer requirements and comply with local or state regulations, applicants for certain customer-facing roles may need to:

- Undergo additional background screens and/or drug/alcohol testing for customer credentialing.

Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)

Ecolab will provide reasonable accommodation (such as a qualified sign language interpreter or other personal assistance) with our application process upon request as required to comply with applicable laws. Cross-Functional Collaboration

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of relevant legal experience, with a significant focus on product, technology, or commercial matters.
  • Experience supporting enterprise software, cloud services, or developer-focused products.
  • Strong working knowledge of:
    • Software licensing and SaaS models
    • Open-source licensing concepts
    • Privacy and data protection frameworks

Description

About the role
Finch is a performance marketing agency. We run digital advertising and SEO for e-commerce and B2B brands. We’re looking for an agency-side Account Manager to be the main strategic contact for a portfolio of our clients, the companies that hire Finch to run their marketing. You’ll lead each relationship and its strategy, and work with our channel specialists (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic/DSP, SEO, Creative, Analytics) to deliver on each client’s business goals.

What you’ll do

  • Own the strategy for each client account: goals, KPIs and quarterly roadmaps.
  • Run recurring client meetings, manage stakeholders and document next steps.
  • Read performance against business metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC vs. LTV, organic growth) and coordinate actions with Finch’s specialists.
  • Find and scope growth opportunities: new channels, tests and budget expansions.
  • Flag retention risks early and build mitigation plans across your portfolio.

Why Finch

  • Work globally, stay flexible: Join a fully distributed team across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC.
  • Meaningful impact from day one: Your work directly influences client outcomes and how Finch grows.
  • A culture built on curiosity, transparency, and ownership: We share context and empower people to make decisions.
  • High-caliber teammates: Collaborate with specialists in Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics, and more.
  • Learning as a default: We encourage experimentation, cross-training, and growth as the company scales.
  • Real work-life balance: We value high performance, not overwork.

Requirements

You’ll be a great match if you have

  • 5+ years as an Account Manager or Account Director at a marketing agency (performance or digital).
  • Experience owning several B2B client accounts at the same time: managing the client relationship, growing the account, and running the project management behind it.
  • Experience as the Account Manager on advertising-driven accounts (Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic/DSP), coordinating the specialists who run each channel, with a solid grasp of attribution, KPIs and optimization logic.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, and comfort leading strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders.
  • A base in Latin America or Africa (or anywhere up to UTC+2), with availability to work roughly 9am–5pm US Central/Mountain time.

This role is not the right next step if most of your experience is in

  • Customer service or support, or customer success for consumers (B2C) or for a software product, even if the title was “Account Manager” or “Customer Success Manager”.
  • Working at an ad platform or affiliate network, managing advertisers on its behalf.
  • Managing a brand’s own e-commerce store or marketplace channels.
  • In-house marketing for a single company, without an agency client portfolio.
  • Sales or business development, without ongoing account management after the sale.
  • Account management at a branding, PR or creative agency, without performance accounts.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SEO-driven accounts.
  • Experience with US or international clients.
