Description du poste

Alphanumeric recrute un Spécialiste bilingue du service client dans le secteur pharmaceutique (anglais/français) - CDI à temps plein (télétravail au Canada)pour travailler à distance et soutenir l’une des plus grandes sociétés pharmaceutiques au monde. Vous fournirez du soutien relativement à des produits liés au diabète, à l’obésité, aux maladies rares ainsi qu’à la santé cardiovasculaire et hépatique.

Il s’agit d’un centre de contact à volume élevé, et les candidats sont sélectionnés pour offrir une expérience de service à la clientèle optimisée et personnalisée. Ce poste joue un rôle essentiel dans le soutien aux patients, aux professionnels de la santé et aux parties prenantes internes, en fournissant des réponses exactes, rapides et empathiques, tout en respectant les normes les plus élevées en matière de qualité, de conformité et d’éthique.

La personne retenue répondra aux questions fréquemment posées et fournira des renseignements généraux conformes à l’indication approuvée. Elle devra également reconnaître les demandes d’information médicale et les acheminer au service approprié. Le poste exige également de savoir reconnaître les événements indésirables (EI) potentiels et les plaintes potentielles relatives à la qualité des produits (PQP), aux fins de documentation et de signalement.

Veuillez noter que nous ne pouvons embaucher que des personnes résidant déjà au Canada et disposant de documents entièrement légaux et valides les autorisant à y travailler.

Veuillez soumettre votre CV en anglais, puisque les gestionnaires responsables de l’embauche ne sont pas établis au Québec. En plus du français, la personne titulaire du poste doit maîtriser l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit, car elle communiquera avec des parties prenantes, des gestionnaires et des clients situés à l’extérieur du Québec, dans un environnement qui exige l’usage de l’anglais. Une préférence sera accordée aux personnes résidant dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est ou dans un fuseau similaire.

Conditions/offre:

  • Emploi: poste permanent à temps plein
  • Mode de travail: entièrement à distance au Canada, de préférence dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est ou un fuseau voisin.
  • Salaire : 50 000 $CA brut par année
  • Heures de travail: 40h par semaine
  • Quarts de travail: du lundi au vendredi, entre 9:00 et 20:00 dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est — quarts de 8 h comprenant une pause-repas d’une heure
  • Avantages sociaux : assurance maladie, soins dentaires et assurance vie après la période d’essai
  • Formation: 3 semaines de formation + 1 semaine de certification, soit 4 semaines
  • Horaires de formation: du lundi au vendredi 8:00-17:00 EST
  • Vacances: 2 semaines de vacances payées
  • Équipement: entièrement fourni par l’entreprise; aucun achat d’équipement n’est requis.
  • Il est obligatoire de résider au Canada et de disposer de documents entièrement légaux et valides (permis de travail, résidence permanente et NAS). Veuillez noter que nous n’offrons pas de parrainage.

Exigences:

  • Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais et du français (il est obligatoire de parler couramment les deux langues)
  • Une préférence sera accordée aux personnes possédant au moins 2 ans d’expérience dans le soutien de centres d’appels pharmaceutiques ou biotechnologiques, ou dans un environnement médical ou commercial
  • Une expérience préalable avec des produits pharmaceutiques dans un centre d’appels pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique est souhaitée
  • Une expérience préalable avec Salesforce et Vonage est souhaitée
  • Une expérience antérieure en centre de contact constitue un atout
  • Passion pour le service à la clientèle, excellentes aptitudes relationnelles au téléphone et volonté d’exceller
  • Capacité à s’épanouir dans un environnement innovant et au rythme soutenu, tout en faisant preuve de souplesse, d’initiative, d’ingéniosité et d’efficacité

Qualités clés et responsabilités:

  • Répondre aux appels entrants généraux, aux clavardages et aux courriels des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des parties prenantes internes, de manière professionnelle et empathique
  • Répondre aux demandes générales des consommateurs et/ou des professionnels de la santé
  • Naviguer sur les sites et aider les utilisateurs à y naviguer
  • Utiliser différents sites et contenus afin que le consommateur ou le professionnel de la santé reçoive un service à la clientèle rapide, complet et professionnel
  • Traiter les demandes et les mises à jour concernant les excursions de température (p. ex., origine de l’excursion de température)
  • Reconnaître et signaler les événements indésirables (EI) potentiels et les plaintes relatives à la qualité des produits (PQP)
  • Consigner les notes de dossier dans le système de gestion de la relation client (CRM)
  • Soutenir le contrat, agir comme agent de liaison et représenter le client
  • Possibilité de quarts rotatifs et de soutien en dehors des heures normales

Compétences et aptitudes requises:

  • Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et capacité à établir et à maintenir des relations importantes avec les principales parties prenantes, par téléphone, clavardage ou courriel.
  • Excellente capacité d’écoute et empathie manifeste envers la personne aidée.
  • Capacité démontrée à communiquer et à distinguer différents types de questions liées aux demandes commerciales
  • Volonté d’apprendre à reconnaître les événements indésirables ou les plaintes relatives aux produits, ainsi qu’à les documenter et à les signaler
  • Capacité à traiter tous les canaux de travail : appels, clavardages et courriels
  • Capacité démontrée à résoudre des problèmes
  • Esprit d’équipe, approche axée sur le service à la clientèle et orientation vers les solutions
  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement à utiliser de nouveaux systèmes et de nouvelles technologies

Compétences techniques:

  • Systèmes d’exploitation : Windows, jusqu’à la version actuelle
  • Outils Microsoft Office
  • Environnement matériel informatique : ordinateurs portables, ordinateurs de bureau et imprimantes
  • Outils de téléphonie, de courriel et de clavardage pour centre de contact — souhaité
  • Connaissance d’un système de gestion de la relation client — souhaitée

Autres exigences:

  • Capacité à rester assis pendant de longues périodes
  • Connaissances informatiques et matérielles de base permettant d’installer un poste de travail à distance
  • Connexion Internet filaire offrant une vitesse minimale de 15 Mbit/s en téléversement et de 15 Mbit/s en téléchargement
  • Disposer d’un espace de bureau privé et calme, sans interruptions, afin de mener des appels professionnels au nom d’un client.
Salary: $50,000 / year

Job title: Principle Regulatory Affairs Specialist – DACH

Department: Regulatory Affairs

Location: This role can be based remotely in Germany, with occasional travel to our Darmstadt office

A brighter future awaits you

CooperVision is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of soft contact lenses with a presence in over 100 countries. Being part of CooperVision means helping improve the way people see each day. It’s more than making contact lenses, it’s about giving lens wearers freedom and confidence to move about their daily lives. We’re all about bright futures – for our people and those who wear our contact lenses.

Job summary – What to expect:

The Principal Regulatory Affairs Specialist will provide expert level regulatory support and direction across our D-A-CH cluster ( including some Eastern Europe locations), for products from concept to launch, and beyond into post market, as well as regulatory processes. This role is responsible for delivering high‑quality regulatory partnership and ensuring market access across a the cluster. Operating as a strategic regulatory partner to Cluster Leadership Teams, the Principal Regulatory Affairs Specialist drives regulatory strategies that enable business growth and safeguard CooperVision’s license to operate. This role is accountable for developing and executing regulatory strategies, driving high‑quality regional submissions, ensuring compliance with EU MDR and regional regulations, and maintaining accurate, audit‑ready regulatory documentation.

Responsibilities include:

1. Regulatory Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute regulatory strategies for assigned cluster markets aligned to commercial priorities and lifecycle needs.
  • Serve as the primary regulatory partner to Cluster Leadership Teams, providing expert, actionable guidance.
  • Lead creation and improvement of regional regulatory processes, SOPs and best practices.
  • Represent RA in cross‑functional meetings, providing clear regulatory direction and risk‑based decision‑making.

2. Cluster Partnership & Commercial Collaboration

  • Participate in Cluster Leadership Team activities, influencing commercial planning, forecasting, and launch decisions.
  • Provide regulatory impact assessments for cluster business strategies, promotions, NPLCOs and private label initiatives.
  • Partner with Global Packaging/Labelling to ensure compliant labelling aligned to market needs.

3. Registration & Market Access

  • Prepare, review and approve regulatory submissions for assigned EMEA markets, covering new registrations, renewals, amendments, and notifications.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and audit‑ready submission documentation and databases
  • Support interactions with Competent Authorities, Notified Bodies and regulatory agencies.

4. Monitoring & Intelligence

  • Monitor regional and national regulatory changes and assess business impact.
  • Communicate relevant regulatory intelligence to cluster and regional leadership promptly.
  • Establish and maintain productive relationships with government, industry groups and regulatory bodies.

5. Labelling, Advertising & Product Compliance

  • Review and approve product labelling and cluster‑specific artwork.
  • Provide RA input into Regulatory Affairs Impact Documents (RAIDs).
  • Ensure adherence to MDR, market‑specific requirements, and CooperVision policies.
  • Support Own Brand/Private Label customers and associated regulatory obligations.

6. Technical Documentation & Audit Activities

  • Review and assess technical documentation for compliance with MDR and other applicable regulations.
  • Contribute to technical audits and inspection readiness within assigned markets.
  • Support responses to Notified Body queries, audit findings, and corrective actions.

7. Cross‑Functional & Regional Contribution

  • Mentor and guide junior specialists working on cluster‑related submissions or activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across EMEA RA.

A full job description is available upon request.

About you:

Skills & Abilities

  • Understanding of ISO 13485, MDR, and regional EMEA regulations.
  • Ability to analyse technical information and develop robust regulatory strategies.
  • Excellent organisation, prioritisation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to partner effectively across commercial and technical functions.
  • Skilled in regulatory submissions, technical documentation, and labelling review.
  • Comfortable operating in multicultural and matrixed environments.
  • Skilled at influencing stakeholders and leading without authority.

Experience & Education:

Required:

  • 6–10 years regulatory experience within the medical device industry.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and submitting regulatory filings in EMEA.
  • Experience supporting audits and technical documentation reviews.
  • Track record of high‑quality stakeholder partnership, ideally with commercial teams.

  • Experience in electronic document management systems.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree and/or Regulatory Affairs Certification desirable.

What we offer:

You’ll receive competitive compensation and a fantastic benefits package and access to our Wellness Platform to support you in mental health and wellbeing, a discounted contact lens scheme and much more!

We are committed to our employees’ personal and professional development and offer extensive training to support your career growth and help every individual to reach their full potential. To help us achieve our goals, we’ll give you everything you need to help you achieve yours.

We also provide access to LinkedIn Learning to help you develop in your career and grow with CooperVision.

What you can expect:

As a CooperVision employee, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse and progressive global business. We appreciate how important fostering an inclusive culture is and how different perspectives add value and contribute to our success.

If you like what you see, take the first step towards your Brighter Future and apply today! All suitably qualified applicants will receive equal consideration and opportunities from CooperVision.

Position Summary

The evolv Consulting team is seeking an accomplished FS&I Leader (Managing Director) to own and grow our Financial Services & Insurance vertical. This is a senior commercial leadership role with full accountability for the vertical’s strategy, revenue, P&L, and client portfolio.

The FS&I Leader expands relationships with existing clients, partners with Business Development to bring on new clients, and leads a team of Client Partners aligned to FS&I accounts. The ideal candidate is a seasoned consulting executive with deep financial services and insurance expertise, a record of profitable growth, and the executive presence to advise clients at the C-suite level.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused leadership role that requires a leader who is willing to get into the details and take an active role in building and growing the business. We are seeking someone who can operate at both strategic and tactical levels, drive business development, establish scalable processes, and remove obstacles to accelerate growth. Success requires a leader who takes full ownership, leads from the front, and executes with urgency, accountability, and a relentless focus on aggressively driving revenue growth and establishing FS&I as evolv’s flagship vertical.

Key Responsibilities

Vertical Ownership & Growth

  • Set and execute the FS&I vertical strategy across banking, insurance, capital markets, and fintech, in alignment with firm leadership.
  • Expand existing client relationships by identifying new needs, increasing account penetration, and pursuing add-on work within active engagements.
  • Partner with Business Development to target, pursue, and onboard new FS&I clients.
  • Define the vertical’s service offerings and industry point of view, drawing on evolv’s data, AI, and cloud capabilities.
  • Represent evolv at industry events, executive forums, and through published thought leadership to build brand visibility and pipeline.

P&L Accountability

  • Own the full P&L for the FS&I vertical, including revenue, gross margin, and contribution targets.
  • Build the annual plan and forecast in partnership with Finance, and report performance to executive leadership.
  • Drive pricing, rate, and staffing decisions that balance growth with profitability.
  • Monitor account-level financial health and act early on margin, utilization, or delivery risk.

Sales Leadership

  • Own the FS&I pipeline and annual bookings targets, from opportunity identification through proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Lead executive-level pursuits and coach Client Partners on deal strategy and account growth.
  • Shape proposals and solutions with delivery and practice leaders to win complex, multi-year engagements.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and accurate forecasting.

Client Partner Leadership

Client Partners report directly to the FS&I Leader. Each is aligned to one or more FS&I clients and is accountable for revenue and margin, the client relationship, and high-level oversight of client delivery.

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of Client Partners.
  • Set clear revenue, margin, and client-satisfaction goals for each Client Partner and hold the team accountable.
  • Serve as executive sponsor on key accounts and step in on escalations.
  • Run a consistent operating cadence across the portfolio, including account, pipeline, and financial reviews.
  • Partner with delivery leadership to ensure quality, measurable client outcomes, and the right talent on every engagement.

*Other duties as assigned.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a revenue-driven leader who is passionate about building the FS&I vertical and holds a high bar for performance. The ideal candidate is:

  • Revenue-driven:Motivated by growth, with a clear commitment to meeting and exceeding the vertical’s revenue goals.
  • Strategic and hands-on:Equally comfortable setting long-term direction and rolling up their sleeves to close deals and solve problems.
  • Focused and adaptable:Able to prioritize effectively and balance vertical ownership, P&L, sales, and team leadership at the same time.
  • A hunter and a coach:Leads new business development alongside Business Development, while coaching Client Partners on how to show up at client sites and grow existing accounts.
  • A decisive leader:Sets clear direction, communicates expectations, and holds the team accountable for results.

Qualifications

Required

  • 12+ years of consulting experience serving financial services clients, including meaningful time in a strategic leadership role.
  • Deep domain expertise in financial services and insurance, with the credibility to advise C-suite stakeholders.
  • Proven P&L ownership of a practice, vertical, or business unit, with a record of growing revenue while protecting margin.
  • Track record of originating and closing complex, multi-year engagements and expanding existing client accounts.
  • Experience leading senior client-facing leaders (Client Partners, Account Leads, or equivalent), including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
  • Experience with data, AI, or cloud strategy in a financial services context.
  • Executive presence and exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence internally and externally.
  • Thrives operating in a fast-paced, matrixed, entrepreneurial environment.

Preferred

  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Dallas–Fort Worth area.
  • Established executive network within the FS&I market.
  • Background at a top-tier consulting firm (Big 4, MBB, or equivalent) and/or operator-side experience at a major financial institution or insurer.
  • Experience growing a vertical within a mid-market consulting firm.

jobs.description:
Grip is changing how global brands produce content - from manual, tool-driven workflows to intelligent systems that generate high-quality visual output at scale.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you build the intelligence behind that shift: LLM agents that understand what a brand looks like, retrieval systems that ground every generation in real brand knowledge, and automated pipelines that turn messy client material into structure machines can work with.

The hard problem in generative AI is no longer generation. It's control, consistency, and trust — making unpredictable models behave reliably for brands that care deeply about how they show up in the world. That's the problem you'll own.

What You'll Work On

  • LLM agents - designing focused, reliable agents that translate brand intent into precise creative direction

  • Prompt engineering & orchestration - crafting, testing, and versioning the prompts that steer agents and generation, and building the system that assembles them - prompting as an engineering discipline, not trial and error

  • Retrieval & RAG - grounding generation in each brand's rules, assets, and visual language, with strict isolation between clients

  • Evaluation & experimentation - systematic measurement (RAGAS or similar), A/B testing, and regression gates, so quality is proven rather than assumed

  • Data extraction & OCR - pipelines that pull structure out of documents, decks, scans, and imagery; OCR and vision models for reading, understanding, and tagging whatever a client hands us

  • Automation - end-to-end pipelines that run without babysitting: classify, extract, propose, verify - humans review outcomes instead of doing the work by hand

  • Model training - fine-tuning LLMs and neural networks where prompting hits its ceiling, running models locally or hosted depending on what the job needs

  • Client-facing impact - your pipelines run against real client data and real production volume, and the results are visible in everything that ships

Requirements

Who You Are

You build systems that make AI predictable, controllable, and production-ready — especially in visual domains.

You Have:

  • Strong experience with LLM-based systems in production (agents, RAG, orchestration)

  • Hands-on work with evaluation frameworks and structured experimentation — quality you can prove, not claim

  • Solid programming skills across TypeScript and Python, with experience shipping working systems

  • Experience training or fine-tuning models and managing their lifecycle

  • Exposure to generative image pipelines and what it takes to make their output usable (not theoretical interest — actual contact)

You Think:

  • In systems, not prompts — how components interact, fail, and scale

  • In constraints — how to guide models toward predictable outputs

  • In data — extraction, classification, and structure as the foundation everything else stands on

  • Pragmatically — you ship working solutions and refine based on results

Your Skills Are:

  • Translating abstract creative direction into structured AI workflows

  • Turning messy, unstructured material into clean, reliable data pipelines

  • Debugging LLM and retrieval behavior across multiple layers of a pipeline

  • Communicating across engineering and creative teams

Why Join Grip?

The Platform Position.
Grip is infrastructure for enterprise creative production—powering global brands to generate content at scale with control and consistency.

The Market Timing.
AI-generated content is moving from experimentation to production. The challenge is no longer generation—it’s control, reliability, and scale.

The Technical Moat.
You’ll work with ComfyUI-based workflows, multi-tenant architecture, and a stack spanning TypeScript, Python, Elixir, and C#—built for production, not demos.

The Work.
You will define how AI is actually used in real-world creative systems—turning unpredictable models into dependable pipelines.

The procedure

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.
This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a growth mindset, be inclusive and win as a team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
  • Bilingual (Spanish and English) is required
  • Strong spoken and written language skills for working with multiple teams and publishing documentation
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
  • Candidate must be based in Monterrey, N.L., or willing to relocate

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Experience facilitating workshops with senior stakeholders and operational teams.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence cross-functional leaders.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: Executives, Day-to-day users of our software
  • Experience serving a large and complex customer base in B2B SaaS

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

About Barrena Branding & Marketing

Barrena Branding & Marketing is a full-service marketing and branding agency focused on helping companies build world-class brands and scalable marketing strategies. We provide strategic guidance and execution support across brand, content, and demand generation, often acting as an extension of our clients’ teams.

Our work spans brand strategy and positioning, website design and development, content creation, email marketing, paid media, SEO, and lead generation. We primarily partner with B2B companies in industries like technology and healthcare, while also supporting select consumer brands.

At Barrena, we believe great brands are built by passionate, creative, and driven people. We value strong communication, attention to detail, and a collaborative approach, and we’re always excited to connect with individuals who are eager to make an impact.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced B2B Copywriter & Messaging Strategist to develop strategic messaging and high-quality copy for our clients, with a strong focus on B2B technology companies and website projects.

This role combines copywriting with strategic positioning and messaging. You will be responsible for understanding complex businesses, products, and audiences and translating them into clear, compelling messaging that differentiates the brand and drives action.

A significant portion of this role will involve writing copy for B2B websites, including companies in technology, SaaS, cybersecurity, AI, healthcare, and other complex industries.

This is not just a content writing role. You should be comfortable developing the strategy behind the messaging, not simply writing from an existing brief or messaging framework.

What You’ll Do

  • Write website copy for B2B companies, including homepages, product and service pages, industry pages, solution pages, landing pages, and other website content
  • Develop brand positioning and strategic messaging frameworks
  • Create value propositions, messaging pillars, differentiators, key messages, and audience-specific messaging
  • Translate complex technical products and services into clear, compelling, benefit-driven copy
  • Participate in client discovery and stakeholder interviews to understand the business, audience, competitive landscape, and objectives
  • Conduct competitive and messaging research to identify opportunities for differentiation
  • Develop messaging for different buyer personas and stages of the buying journey
  • Write headlines, calls to action, and conversion-focused website copy
  • Collaborate with strategists, designers, developers, SEO specialists, and other members of our team
  • Incorporate SEO strategy and target keywords naturally into website copy when appropriate
  • Edit and strengthen existing copy for clarity, consistency, differentiation, and brand voice
  • Ensure all copy is polished, accurate, on-brand, and ready for client delivery

Who We’re Looking For

B2B Copywriting Experience

  • 5+ years of professional copywriting, content, or messaging experience
  • Demonstrated experience writing website copy for B2B companies
  • Strong preference for experience with technology, SaaS, cybersecurity, AI, healthcare, professional services, or other complex industries
  • Ability to translate sophisticated or technical subject matter into clear, engaging copy
  • Strong understanding of how B2B messaging differs from consumer-focused copy

Website Copywriting Experience

  • Demonstrated experience writing complete, multi-page B2B websites
  • Strong understanding of website hierarchy, user journeys, calls to action, and conversion
  • Ability to develop consistent messaging across an entire website
  • Experience collaborating with designers, strategists, SEO specialists, and developers

Positioning & Messaging Experience

  • Hands-on experience developing brand positioning and strategic messaging
  • Experience developing value propositions, messaging pillars, differentiators, audience messaging, and brand narratives
  • Ability to identify what meaningfully differentiates a company from its competitors
  • Comfortable conducting client discovery and turning research into a clear messaging framework

Strategic & Creative Thinker

You don't simply take a brief and start writing. You ask questions, understand the audience and business objectives, identify messaging gaps, and think strategically about what the company needs to communicate and why.

Strong Editorial Judgment

You have an exceptional command of grammar, structure, tone, and storytelling and can recognize when messaging is generic, overly technical, or unclear.

Client-Facing Communication

You are comfortable participating in client discovery calls, asking thoughtful questions, presenting messaging recommendations, and incorporating feedback.

Collaborative & Detail-Oriented

You work effectively with remote teams, communicate proactively, manage deadlines, and consistently deliver polished work that is ready for client review.

AI-Aware, Human-Led

You understand how to use AI tools appropriately for research, ideation, and efficiency while maintaining original thinking, strategic judgment, and high-quality human-written copy.

Compensation

  • Hourly or project-based compensation, depending on experience and scope
  • We are committed to fair compensation based on your skill level and the value you bring
  • This is a contractor role with the potential to evolve into a longer-term or full-time opportunity based on performance and business needs

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your resume
  • A brief note about your experience writing for B2B companies
  • Examples of B2B website copy you have written, preferably for technology companies
  • At least one example of a complete or multi-page website where you were responsible for the copy
  • Examples of positioning, messaging frameworks, value propositions, or strategic messaging work you have developed
  • A brief explanation of your role in the examples provided, including whether you developed the underlying messaging strategy or worked from an existing framework

jobs.excerpt: Estamos à procura de um(a) Designer de Interiores experiente para colaborar, em regime remoto e dedicação praticamente exclusiva, no desenvolvimento integral de um projeto de interiores para um espaço corporativo.
jobs.description:
Estamos à procura de um(a) Designer de Interiores experiente para colaborar, em regime remoto e dedicação praticamente exclusiva, no desenvolvimento integral de um projeto de interiores para um espaço corporativo.

Trata-se de um projeto com duração prevista entre 1 e 2 meses, cujo objetivo é criar um conceito de design contemporâneo, funcional e diferenciador, desenvolvendo toda a documentação necessária para a sua implementação.

Procuramos um profissional criativo, com forte capacidade técnica e atenção ao detalhe, capaz de transformar uma ideia num projeto completo e preparado para execução.

Principais Responsabilidades

O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento integral do projeto de interiores, incluindo:

Estudo e Planeamento do Espaço

  • Análise funcional do espaço;
  • Estudo da circulação e organização das diferentes áreas;
  • Definição de layouts;
  • Propostas de otimização do espaço;
  • Desenvolvimento do conceito de design.

Projeto de Design de Interiores

Desenvolvimento completo do projeto, incluindo:

  • Seleção de mobiliário;
  • Iluminação;
  • Materiais;
  • Pavimentos;
  • Revestimentos;
  • Carpintarias;
  • Elementos decorativos;
  • Soluções de armazenamento;
  • Elementos acústicos;
  • Cores e acabamentos;
  • Ambientes e identidade visual do espaço.

Modelação e Visualização 3D

Desenvolvimento de modelos tridimensionais e imagens realistas de todas as áreas do projeto, incluindo:

  • Modelação 3D;
  • Renderizações fotorrealistas;
  • Diferentes perspetivas dos espaços;
  • Ajustes e iterações sempre que necessário.

Especificação Técnica

Preparação de toda a documentação necessária para implementação do projeto, incluindo:

  • Identificação detalhada de todos os produtos utilizados;
  • Marcas e fabricantes;
  • Modelos;
  • Referências;
  • Cores;
  • Materiais;
  • Quantidades;
  • Valores estimados de aquisição;
  • Sugestão de fornecedores e alternativas quando aplicável.

O objetivo é entregar um projeto que permita posteriormente solicitar orçamentos e negociar diretamente com fornecedores e fabricantes.

Entregáveis

No final do projeto deverão ser entregues:

  • Layout final do espaço;
  • Modelo 3D completo;
  • Imagens fotorrealistas de todos os ambientes;
  • Manual de especificações dos materiais e produtos;
  • Lista completa de mobiliário, iluminação, decoração e restantes elementos utilizados;
  • Documento com marcas, modelos, referências e valores estimados;
  • Organização de todos os ficheiros editáveis e documentação técnica.

Requisitos

Obrigatórios

  • Formação em Design de Interiores, Arquitetura de Interiores ou área equivalente;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de interiores corporativos, comerciais ou residenciais de elevada qualidade;
  • Excelente capacidade de organização e atenção ao detalhe;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de modelação e visualização 3D;
  • Capacidade para trabalhar de forma autónoma e cumprir prazos.

Valorizamos

  • SketchUp;
  • 3ds Max;
  • V-Ray;
  • Corona Renderer;
  • Enscape;
  • Lumion;
  • AutoCAD;
  • Revit;
  • Photoshop;
  • Illustrator.

Regime de Trabalho

  • Trabalho 100% remoto;
  • Dedicação praticamente exclusiva durante 1 a 2 meses;
  • Horário compatível com Portugal;
  • Reuniões periódicas através de Google Meet;
  • Comunicação diária com a equipa do projeto;
  • Partilha de documentação através de Google Drive.

Perfil Procurado

Procuramos um(a) profissional apaixonado(a) por design de interiores, com forte sentido estético e capacidade para desenvolver projetos completos, bem documentados e preparados para implementação.

Valorizamos profissionais que consigam equilibrar criatividade, funcionalidade e rigor técnico, apresentando soluções inovadoras e exequíveis, sempre com atenção aos custos e à qualidade dos materiais especificados.

Se gosta de criar espaços únicos, domina ferramentas de modelação 3D e tem experiência na seleção criteriosa de materiais, mobiliário e iluminação, gostaríamos de conhecer o seu trabalho.

Processo de Seleção

Os candidatos pré-selecionados poderão ser convidados a realizar um pequeno desafio técnico remunerado, que permitirá avaliar a qualidade das propostas, o nível de detalhe da documentação produzida e a capacidade de transformar um briefing num projeto de interiores completo e pronto para execução.

jobs.title: Senior RevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About ImprovadoImprovado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.
jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

jobs.title: Sr Business Analyst (Pharmacovigilance & AI Systems)
jobs.excerpt: ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESRequirements Engineering• Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
jobs.description:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Requirements Engineering

  • Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
  • Produce the supporting artefacts: as-is and to-be process maps, data-flow diagrams, user stories with acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, interface specifications and non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security, auditability, data retention).
  • Build and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix from URS to FRS to design, test cases and validation evidence, so every requirement can be implemented and tested.
  • Run requirement reviews with PV operations, Quality, IT Security, Data Privacy and Engineering; manage change control on approved requirements.
  • Prioritize with the Product Owner, write release-level scope statements and support sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Domain coverage

You will specify requirements across the following modules, working with the respective PV subject-matter experts:

  • Global and local literature search strategy management, database connectors (MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase and others), de-duplication, AI-assisted relevance screening and ICSR identification, full-text handling, reviewer workflow, hit-level audit trail, reconciliation and KPIs; alignment with GVP Module VI and local literature requirements.
  • Multi-channel intake (email, portal, call centre, partner feeds, literature, social media), duplicate detection, AI-assisted data extraction from unstructured sources, MedDRA and WHODrug coding support, seriousness and expectedness assessment, narrative generation with human review, E2B(R3) submission, follow-up management, and integration with safety databases (e.g. Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety).
  • Data sources (safety database, EudraVigilance, FAERS, literature), disproportionality and signal detection methods, signal validation, prioritisation, assessment and tracking workflows, signal-to-risk linkage, and documentation aligned to GVP Module IX.
  • Data retrieval and reconciliation, line listings and summary tabulations, AI-assisted section drafting with locked source-to-text traceability, author and reviewer workflow, version control, schedule and submission tracking, aligned to 21 CFR 314.80 and ICH E2C(R2).
  • Source and channel configuration, listening rules, AI classification of posts for potential adverse events, identifiability and validity criteria, PII handling, reviewer workflow and conversion to case intake, aligned to GVP Module VI and FDA guidance on internet and social media.
  • PSMF support, audit-trail reporting and query, compliance dashboards (timeliness, quality, backlog), deviation and CAPA linkage, document and training evidence retrieval, and the ability to reproduce any AI-assisted decision on request.

Agentic AI specifics

  • Define, for every agent in the platform, its role, inputs, tools, permitted actions and decision authority, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a qualified person must review, approve or override.
  • Specify AI output acceptance criteria with the SMEs: target precision and recall for screening and classification tasks, confidence thresholds for auto-routing versus human review, and how performance is measured and monitored in production.
  • Write requirements for explainability and auditability of AI decisions: rationale capture, source citation, prompt and model version logging, reproducibility, and retention of the evidence an inspector would ask for.
  • Specify guardrails: what agents must never do without human approval (e.g. submit an ICSR, close a signal, finalise a report), handling of low-confidence or out-of-distribution inputs, and fallback behaviour when a model or tool is unavailable.
  • Define requirements for model lifecycle governance: evaluation datasets, change control for prompts and models, regression testing, periodic review, and restrictions on use of client data for model training.

Regulatory, quality and privacy compliance

  • Translate the following into explicit, testable requirements and work with Quality on validation strategy:
    • 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11: electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access control, data integrity (ALCOA+), system security, record retention and retrieval.
    • GDPR and other applicable data-protection laws: lawful basis, data minimisation, pseudonymisation, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, retention and deletion, privacy by design; support Data Protection Impact Assessments.
    • GVP Modules (notably I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX) and ICH E2B(R3), E2C(R2), E2D, E2E as they apply to each module.
    • Computerised system validation: GAMP 5 (second edition), risk-based and Computer Software Assurance approaches; author or contribute to validation plans, functional risk assessments, test strategies and traceability.
    • Quality Management System requirements for product development: SDLC procedures, change control, deviation and CAPA management, supplier qualification, documentation standards; alignment with ISO 9001 and information-security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
    • Emerging AI-specific regulation and guidance (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA positions on AI in pharmacovigilance and GxP): assess applicability, track developments and reflect them in requirements.
  • Act as the requirements-side point of contact during internal audits and client or regulatory inspections of the platform.

Stakeholder and delivery

  • Work day-to-day with PV operations leads, medical reviewers, Quality Assurance, Data Privacy, IT Security, product management, UX, data scientists and engineers.
  • Support UAT: author or review test scripts against the FRS, coordinate business testers, triage defects and confirm requirement coverage.
  • Prepare release notes, user-facing functional documentation and training inputs for operations teams.
  • Contribute to client-facing material describing how the platform meets regulatory expectations.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, computer science or a related field.
  • 6+ years in pharmacovigilance or PV systems, with at least 3 years in a business analyst, systems analyst or product requirements role on GxP software.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring URS and FRS (and ideally validation documentation) for PV or other regulated life-sciences systems.
  • Working knowledge of at least four of the six domain areas above, gained in operations, a safety-system implementation or a technology vendor; hands-on familiarity with at least one commercial safety database (Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety or equivalent).
  • Solid understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, data-integrity principles and GDPR, and of how they translate into system requirements.
  • Experience working within a QMS and formal SDLC (change control, CSV/CSA, traceability, deviation handling).
  • Practical understanding of how LLMs and AI agents work, their failure modes, and what it takes to make their output acceptable in a regulated setting. Prior involvement in an AI or automation project in PV is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical writing: you can produce a requirement that an engineer can build, a tester can test and an auditor can verify, without ambiguity.
  • Comfortable with Agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.

Preferred

  • Experience with E2B(R3) implementation, MedDRA and WHODrug coding, and EudraVigilance or FAERS data.
  • Experience specifying NLP, machine-learning or GenAI features (classification, extraction, summarisation) including evaluation metrics and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with GAMP 5 second edition and the FDA Computer Software Assurance approach.
  • Awareness of the EU AI Act and of EMA/FDA reflection papers on AI in the medicinal-product lifecycle.
  • Prior participation in regulatory inspections or client audits of PV systems.
  • Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or ISPE/GAMP training.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.
Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.
Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.
Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.
Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

jobs.title: Art Lead
jobs.excerpt: We are a plucky, independent, fully remote video game studio primarily based in the UK, and makers of the widely praised and highly rated Galacticare and War for the Overworld.
jobs.description:
We are a plucky, independent, fully remote video game studio primarily based in the UK, and makers of the widely praised and highly rated Galacticare and War for the Overworld. The core team has joined together from all over the world because of a shared passion for building brighter universes. Our goal is to continue creating genre-twisting 3D simulation and management games; and if we can do it with a quirkily British sense of humour, then all the better!

Role Overview

We're looking for an Art Lead to own the visual identity of Brightrock Games, with immediate focus on our current production, Kaiju Cleanup.

You'll be joining a small, tight knit team of developers helping us push and blend the boundaries of traditional game genres. As an Art Lead, you're responsible for leading art across every discipline - concept, character, environment, VFX, UI/UX and technical art and for making sure that direction holds up against a real production schedule.

We're looking for someone who has led art on a shipped title, can build a visual language from scratch, is comfortable mentoring artists across disciplines and seniority levels, and knows composition, colour and lighting well enough to also know what's realistic on an indie budget.

Key Responsibilities

1 - Define and Own the Art Vision

Success looks like:

  • Set the visual style for Brightrock's titles: art bibles, mood boards, and reference standards that keep every discipline pointed the same direction.
  • Keep concept art, characters, environments, VFX, and UI reading as one world, not five.
  • Sign off on key art milestones, and say no when quality and schedule are actually in conflict.

2 - Lead and Develop the Art Team

Success looks like:

  • Direct and mentor artists across disciplines, with feedback specific enough to act on.
  • Hire and onboard as the team grows, and shape the art pipeline and tools as you go.
  • Keep the team collaborative: craft matters more than title here, same as everywhere else at the studio.

3 - Liaise Across the Studio

Success looks like:

  • Work with Creative and Game Design to turn concepts and gameplay needs into a visual direction that reads clearly on screen.
  • Work with Production on scheduling and priority calls, flagging risk early rather than at the deadline.
  • Work with the Technical team to keep the art performant, and with Marketing/Community on trailers, store pages, and other external art.

Requirements

  • A portfolio showing art direction on at least one shipped PC/console title, with a visual language you can point to and explain.
  • Working knowledge across concept, character, and environment art and VFX. You don't need to be the best in the studio at each, but you need to be able to critique and guide all of them.
  • Comfortable with Photoshop and either Blender or 3ds Max, plus the Substance suite; enough Unity knowledge to know what's technically realistic.
  • A strong eye for composition, colour, and lighting, and the ability to say why something works, not just that it does.
  • Experience managing or mentoring artists, with feedback that improves the work without wrecking morale.
  • A fit for a small indie team, where collaboration counts for more than a title.

Desirable:

  • Happy to jump in and fix or build an asset yourself, not just direct from a distance.
  • Understands performance limits: draw calls, LODs, lighting budgets - and how they shape art decisions.
  • Knows Houdini or similar, and likes building modular/trim-sheet workflows that save the team time.
  • Has a keen interest in emergent technologies and their potential applications.
  • Has produced or directed key art, trailers, or store assets before.

Please Note: This is a full-time, remote-working position, open to anyone within the UK & Europe.

Benefits

Our benefits include a 2-week company summer break and a 2-week winter break to rest and recharge, in addition to your normal holiday allowance.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Security - Mexico
jobs.excerpt: All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.
jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the role:

JumpCloud is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to operate the Security organization's program management function. This is a hands-on role for a classically trained program manager who has already integrated AI deeply into their working life and uses it to operate at a higher level than traditional PM scale allows. You will own the day-to-day program management of the security organization's projects and run a hybrid program management capability where AI handles continuous structured work, while you provide the judgment, prioritization and relationship work where humans excel.

About the team:

Our Security organization spans SecOps, GRC, and DevSecOps. As our scope grows, we are actively investing in modern, AI-augmented operations. As the Senior TPM reporting to the Director of Security, you will own program management across the entire org. You will partner closely with security leadership, engineers, and our AI team, collaborating to design, refine, and drive the AI-assisted program management systems that power our daily work.

What you will be doing:

  • Operating Standard Enforcement: Apply a single operating standard across every security project. Drive project hygiene at scale: ownership, dates, scope, plans, status. Review and act on AI-generated drafts that flag gaps, propose fixes and surface stale work to project owners.

  • Intake and Triage: Own the front door for security requests across Slack channels, ticket forms and direct asks. Classify, route, set expectations with requestors and capture demand as data. Train the AI classification system through your corrections and feedback.

  • Status and Reporting: Produce per-person, per-project and program-level status briefs and the reports the security org commits to (weekly operating reviews, monthly engineering-relevant metrics, quarterly roadmap progress). Edit AI-drafted reports for narrative, framing and the relationship context the data does not capture.

  • Capacity and Commitment: Maintain a working model of team capacity and project commitments. Flag slippage early. Surface overcommitment to leadership before dates slip. Apply judgment for factors the data does not see (team morale, growth needs, strategic context).

  • Interruption Work Tracking: Inventory and measure the categories of interruption work the team handles (elevation requests, threat model processing, team requests, secret rotations, vulnerability alerts and others). Propose new projects to reduce unplanned work and improve processing efficiency.

  • Prioritization: Place new work in the priority queue using stated criteria of impact, urgency, dependencies and capacity. Apply judgment for political and strategic context.

  • AI System Partnership: Work directly with the AI engineering function as an internal customer. File feature requests, validate output quality, define what good looks like and shape the system over time. You are the product owner for the program management capability that supports your work.

  • Operating Standard Evolution: Refine the operating standard as edge cases surface. Propose updates, build team buy-in and roll out changes consistently.

  • Cross-Company Representation: Represent the security organization's program management practice to peers, stakeholders, and leadership across the company. Ensure all program reporting provides an accurate, transparent, and objective view of current progress and risks.

Necessary skills:

  • 6 years of program or project management experience, ideally including time in technical or engineering organizations

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to scale your program management practice. You can describe specific examples of how AI has saved time, reduced cost, automated routine work or enabled you to operate at a higher level

  • Deep fluency with Jira and Confluence, including epic and project structure, JQL, dashboards and reporting

  • Excellent written communication. You can draft a clear executive update, a precise project brief and an honest status report

  • Comfort working without complete information. You exercise judgment and make calls without waiting for permission

  • Ability to push back constructively, including upward, when commitments are at risk or scope is creeping

  • Experience operating in a remote-first organization

  • Bonus: prior experience in security, infrastructure or platform engineering organizations

Personal characteristics we are looking for:

  • Passionate about AI as a force multiplier, not the primary focus. You have already integrated AI into how you work and can describe what it has and has not done for you

  • Operates from first principles. You understand what actually needs to get done and you do not let tooling distract from the work

  • Emotionally mature. You can hold a high standard, deliver honest feedback and stay constructive when commitments slip or decisions are contested

  • High level of integrity. You report what is true, not what is flattering

  • Ownership and accountability. The program is yours

  • Clear, direct communication

  • Creative problem solver

  • Service-minded. You understand program management is a service function and the team you support is the customer

  • Bonus: passionate about security

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role.

Language:

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud®?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. jobs.description:
Department: Marketing

Reports To: Head of Growth

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Base Salary: $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

About Bask & Lather

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

About the Role

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Creative strategy and testing: Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.
  • Production and delivery: Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.
  • Creative learning and iteration: Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.
  • Creators and partners: Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.
  • Team and resources: Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

Cross Functional Collaboration

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

Creative Operations and Accountability

  • Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.
  • Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.
  • Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.
  • Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.
  • Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

How Success Will Be Measured

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

  • Creative effectiveness: The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.
  • Testing and learning: Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.
  • Operating performance: Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.
  • Diagnostic metrics: Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

Required Experience and Capabilities

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.
  • A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.
  • Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.
  • Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.
  • Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

Portfolio and Results Standard

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Bask & Lather is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for other legally protected needs. Applicants who need an accommodation during the hiring process may request assistance from our recruiting team.

The Senior Lead Marketing Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving Lumen's marketing data platform architecture. This role provides technical leadership for the design and implementation of scalable data products, modern analytics capabilities, AI-ready data structures, and agentic operational frameworks that support the organization's marketing strategy.

As the lead architect for the marketing data ecosystem, this individual will establish the long-term platform vision, define architectural standards, and guide modernization initiatives that enable advanced analytics, personalization, audience activation, measurement, and AI-driven decision-making. The role requires close partnership with engineering, analytics, Adobe, Salesforce, and business stakeholders to ensure the platform remains scalable, governed, secure, and aligned with evolving business needs.

This position is ideal for a forward-thinking architect who is passionate about building AI-native data platforms, enabling intelligent automation, and creating modern data foundations capable of supporting both current and future marketing use cases.

The Main Responsibilities

    • Experience designing AI-driven or AI-native data solutions and implementing automation, testing, quality controls, and deployment practices.

jobs.description:
Kinetic, a business unit of Uniti (NASDAQ: UNIT), is a premier insurgent provider of multi-gigabit fiber internet, whole-home Wi-Fi, internet security, and voice services in 1,400 markets across 18 states in across the U.S.  Additional information about Kinetic is available at www.GoKinetic.com

About the Role:

The Manager – Held Order Management leads a team that manages consumer fiber orders returned from the field when issues prevent the installation team from completing the install. This is an order management and resolution role, not an inbound customer-care or call-center role. The manager ensures every held order is categorized and entered in the system within a 48-hour SLA, then project manages each order to the correct disposition—released to the field, completed, or cancelled. Expert, hands-on knowledge of order visibility and modification in DCRIS and Kinetic Salesforce is essential.

Work in this role moves across several connected systems every day. The manager and team use DCRIS and Kinetic Salesforce as the primary tools to research, view, modify, and re-sequence orders, and MIROR to track workforce and order activity. They review OFS dispatch results and not-done reasons to understand why an install failed, check EPM for build status, notes, and forecast dates, and confirm completed construction or outstanding field work in Jobtrac. Status, aging, and trend data are pulled from Snowflake and Power BI and shared through Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams. The manager makes sure the information in each system matches before an order is released, completed, or cancelled, and escalates conflicts between systems to the right owner. This position can be filled remotely anywhere within the country.

What You’ll Do:

  • Intake & SLA: Own daily intake of returned orders; ensure each is reviewed, categorized by root cause, and accurately entered in DCRIS/Salesforce within 48 hours
  • Order Resolution: Project manage held orders through disposition and closure; prioritize and escalate aging orders; keep customers informed of order status
  • Cross-Functional Accountability: Partner with Field Operations, Construction, Engineering, contractors, and the Operations Control Center to clear blockers
  • Reporting & Improvement: Report held-order volume, aging, and SLA results; identify repeat causes and build standard procedures to reduce held orders
  • People Leadership: Hire, coach, schedule, and develop the team; manage performance, attendance, timekeeping, and policy compliance with HR

Do You Have?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; 5+ years in telecom order management or service delivery; 2+ years leading people
  • Expert, hands-on knowledge of order visibility and modification in DCRIS and Kinetic Salesforce
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and order management/workforce systems such as DCRIS, Kinetic Salesforce and MIROR
  • Strong organization, problem-solving, and communication skills; able to manage high volume against strict SLAs

Even Better:

  • Familiarity with OFS, EPM, and Jobtrac (can be learned on the job); reporting tools such as Snowflake and Power BI
  • Fiber-to-the-home, buried drop, or MDU delivery experience; PMP or Lean Six Sigma certification

Performance Measures:

  • 48-hour SLA attainment
  • Held order volume and aging
  • Time to resolution
  • Order accuracy
  • Employee engagement and retention
  • Future-state (to be established): release-to-field, completion, repeat-hold, and cancellation rates.

Working Conditions:

Primarily office/remote-based with extended computer use; occasional travel and after-hours support during volume spikes. Uniti provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees.

Minimum Requirements:

College degree and 4-6 years professional level experience with 1-3 years supervisory experience; or 8+ years professional level related experience with 1-3 years supervisory experience; or an equivalent combination of education and professional level related experience required.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Director, Corporate Partnership Engagement position is responsible for sourcing, structuring, and executing offtake opportunities with corporate and industrial (C&I) energy buyers. As part of this role, you will work in cross-functional teams to formulate comprehensive energy solutions that leverage the expansive range of products and services the Hanwha Group can provide, including solar, battery energy storage, energy trading, and gas generation.

Origination and Relationship Management

  • Identify, originate, and cultivate relationships with C&I energy buyers.
