  • Engage power-intensive corporate customers through bilateral approaches to understand their energy, environmental, and infrastructure needs both near and long-term.

Solution Design and Structuring

  • Develop and structure commercial frameworks that go beyond traditional PPA structures and address complex needs of customers including speed to power, resource diversity, decarbonization, and cost optimization.
  • Lead cross-functional teams through contract negotiations and execution, developing solutions to commercially and technically complex challenges.
  • Prepare investment memoranda and supporting material for senior management.

Market & Policy Development

  • Work in tandem with the Government Relations and Market Development teams to monitor and influence changes in interconnection, tariffs, market products and other relevant matters.
  • Engage in industry groups and monitor regulatory developments to identify new opportunities, risks, and market solutions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience in power marketing, origination, or procuring energy on behalf of corporate energy buyers.
  • Deep and actionable network of relationships with C&I buyers and in at least one target region.
  • Direct transaction experience in ERCOT, PJM, or CAISO, across a variety of deal structures.
  • Expert-level knowledge of offtake structuring instruments including VPPAs, financial hedges, tolling agreements, and emerging structures.
  • Advanced understanding of U.S. utility-scale solar development, power markets, project finance, and customer segments.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in business, engineering, sustainability, finance, or related field.
  • Ability to quickly step into new tasks and adapt to new circumstances in a dynamic environment.

  • Excellent interpersonal, time management, communication, and relationship building skills.
  • Willing to travel up to 40% of the time in North America.

About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

About the Role:

Sales Compensation Analyst – Commercial Modelling & Governance Automation


The Team

We are a high-accountability, globally connected Sales Compensation team that values disciplined execution, a strong sense of urgency, and end-to-end ownership. We expect our people to understand the full lifecycle of their work, anticipate downstream impacts, and communicate outcomes with exceptional clarity, whether supporting our broad population of 1,500+ plan participants or partnering with C-level executives. We value precision, responsiveness, sound judgment, collaboration, and people who take ownership through to resolution.


Responsibilities and Impact

This is a role for someone who sees a manual compensation process and immediately knows how to automate it. As the analytical and engineering engine behind S&P Global Market Intelligence's sales compensation function, you will convert complex commercial deal structures, multi-tier incentive plans, and governance controls into automated, audit-ready data models — building the infrastructure that makes accuracy scalable and compliance systematic. If you combine deep technical fluency in SQL, Python, and Power BI with a genuine understanding of how enterprise compensation works, this role offers the scope, the complexity, and the leadership exposure to match.

  • Translate and engineer complex commercial deal structures — including multi-year enterprise agreements, joint-production credit splits, co-selling models, and overlay allocations — into structured algorithmic logic and standardised business rules within the compensation calculation engine, eliminating manual offline adjustments and ensuring downstream calculation readiness.
  • Model and simulate the financial impact of proposed changes to compensation plans and crediting rules — running Python and SQL scenario analyses on historical payout data and partnering with Revenue Operations and Legal/Deal Desk to evaluate non-standard transaction structures for data feasibility and commercial accuracy.
  • Build and maintain automated reconciliation engines using Python, Alteryx, and SQL — cross-comparing ledger revenues, CRM bookings, and calculated commissionable revenue, and engineering variance detection models that automatically surface anomalies including revenue double-counting, territory misalignment, unassigned account credits, and clawback mismatches.
  • Design and maintain governance control frameworks — building systematic tracking mechanisms for all manual adjustments with full origin, justification, and approval trails; directing comprehensive quarterly and annual SOX audit documentation; and running automated control test queries to demonstrate end-to-end calculation traceability.
  • Architect and maintain enterprise Power BI reporting suites — developing advanced data models using DAX and Power Query M to visualise sales performance, attainment distributions, and compensation trends; building real-time Data Health and Anomaly monitoring dashboards; and presenting variance summaries, root cause analyses, and actionable insights directly to Finance and Commercial leadership.
  • Standardise operations and advise stakeholders — converting fragmented legacy workflows into structured SOPs with clear SLAs; serving as the senior technical point of contact for Commercial and Finance stakeholders by translating complex data logic and calculation outcomes into plain-English explanations; and conducting technical peer reviews of queries, code updates, and configuration changes prior to production deployment.

Compensation and Benefits (US Candidates Only)

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $70,817 to $125,091. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit:


What We Are Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in sales compensation analytics, financial modelling, or commercial data governance within a multinational organisation.
  • SQL and Data Modelling: Advanced SQL proficiency for data modelling, validation, and complex multi-table reconciliation across ledger revenues, CRM systems, and compensation engines.
  • Automation and Scripting: Hands-on experience using Python/Pandas or Alteryx to build automated reconciliation workflows, variance detection models, and data pipeline scripts.
  • Power BI Development: Advanced Power BI expertise including data modelling, star schema design, complex DAX measures, and Power Query M transformations for enterprise-level reporting suites.
  • Governance and SOX Controls: Proven experience operating within SOX-compliance frameworks — designing audit-ready controls, running automated control test queries, and producing end-to-end calculation traceability documentation.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within B2B SaaS or subscription-based sales compensation environments, including enterprise crediting rules, quota structures, and multi-tier incentive plan mechanics.
  • Demonstrated experience presenting complex data logic, calculation methodologies, and compensation model outcomes to Finance and Commercial executive leadership in clear, non-technical language.
  • Experience translating complex commercial contract mechanics — including multi-year enterprise agreements, joint-production credit splits, co-selling models, and overlay allocations — into structured algorithmic logic within enterprise compensation calculation engines.
  • Experience partnering with Revenue Operations and Legal/Deal Desk to evaluate non-standard transaction structures for data feasibility and downstream compensation calculation readiness.
  • Experience building real-time data health and anomaly monitoring dashboards that surface unmapped accounts, missing credit assignments, adjustment volume trends, and pipeline integrity issues.
  • Experience designing and maintaining standardised adjustment protocols with systematic approval trail tracking for manual compensation overrides.
  • Proven experience conducting technical peer reviews of SQL queries, automation scripts, and configuration changes prior to deployment in production compensation environments.

This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States.

jobs.excerpt: As a Cost Consultant at Turner & Townsend, you will be responsible for delivering cost planning and commercial management services across a range of workplace, retail, manufacturing, and technical projects for leading enterprise clients.
jobs.description:
As a Cost Consultant at Turner & Townsend, you will be responsible for delivering cost planning and commercial management services across a range of workplace, retail, manufacturing, and technical projects for leading enterprise clients. Drawing on your contractor-side experience in estimating, bid evaluation, and change management, you will provide an informed owner’s perspective, establishing robust cost positions, challenging commercial assumptions, and delivering clear, evidence-based advice that supports effective decision-making. Working under the guidance of a Senior Cost Consultant or Director, you will progressively take ownership of project cost plans and commercial strategies, developing the expertise and confidence to manage the commercial position throughout the full project lifecycle.


Responsibilities:

  • Prepare cost estimates and cost plans from concept through close-out for tenant improvement, remodel, and new build projects, including quantity takeoffs in Bluebeam and pricing in CSI MasterFormat structures.
  • Build and maintain parametric and hybrid cost models under senior direction, contributing clean, consistently coded data to the team's benchmarking library.
  • Lead bid leveling and GC and subcontractor bid analysis: qualify scope, normalize exclusions and allowances, and present a clear recommendation with the basis stated.
  • Test contractor pricing against takeoff-based estimates, historical data, and market intelligence, and explain variances rather than accept them.
  • Support value engineering by identifying scope and specification alternatives with quantified cost and schedule impact.
  • Administer the commercial position on assigned projects: review change orders for entitlement, scope, and pricing against the contract documents and field conditions, and recommend approve, reject, or negotiate.
  • Maintain the change, purchase order, and pay application registers, and reconcile pay applications to approved values and work in place.
  • Prepare cashflow, accrual, and estimate-at-completion forecasts aligned to the project schedule, and flag commercial exposure early.
  • Form and state a view on cost and risk with the reasoning visible: what the data supports, what it does not, and what you would need to be more certain.
  • Present cost and risk positions to client project teams in an observational, evidence-first voice, and escalate to senior colleagues when a position needs to be held under challenge.
  • Contribute project-level data and insight to portfolio capital planning and program reporting.
  • Keep register-driven templates, WBS, and cost code structures clean and consistent so program-level reporting and AI tooling can rely on them.
  • Identify repeatable analysis in your own work and, with senior colleagues, turn it into reusable templates and checklists.
  • Document methods, assumptions, and lessons so your outputs are reproducible by others.
  • Support onboarding and review for analysts, and model disciplined, well-organized delivery.
  • Apply client contract provisions and financial policies consistently, including SOX controls where applicable.
  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, architectural engineering, quantity surveying, or a related field preferred, with three to six years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Hands-on experience in construction estimating and commercial administration, including quantity takeoffs, subcontractor bid leveling, subcontract and change order review, and submittal and procurement log management. Contractor-side experience on tenant improvement and renovation projects is directly relevant.
  • Working knowledge of CSI MasterFormat, change order mechanics, contingency, and basic cashflow forecasting; willingness to develop fluency in GMP reconciliation, escalation, and AACE estimate classification.
  • Ability to read and apply contract documents, including subcontract and general contractor contract provisions, and to verify proposed changes against drawings, specifications, and field conditions.
  • Proficiency in Bluebeam and Excel, including formula-driven estimates; familiarity with construction management platforms such as Viewpoint, Building Connected, or Procore. Interest in Python, BI tools, or AI-assisted analysis is a plus.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable leading meetings and driving follow-up actions with project stakeholders.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the judgment to know when to bring a question or exposure to a senior colleague.
  • Progress toward a professional designation such as CCP, MRICS, or PMP is encouraged.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

The base salary range for this role is $120,000-$150,000 USD. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Ethos is looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to serve as a technical leader for our SRE organization in the US. In this role, you will help set the technical direction for how Ethos builds, runs, and scales production systems, from our core AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure to the internal platforms and toolchains that power our AI initiatives.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role with organization-wide scope. You will design and build critical infrastructure yourself, lead cross-team initiatives from conception to delivery, and raise the reliability bar across engineering by partnering closely with product teams, up to and including submitting PRs to their codebases. You will work alongside SRE leadership in the US and Bangalore to shape the roadmap, and you will be a go-to technical authority for reliability, scalability, security, and cost-efficiency.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Set Direction: Define and drive the multi-quarter technical strategy for reliability, infrastructure, and platform tooling, in partnership with SRE and engineering leadership and aligned with company OKRs.
  • Architecture: Lead the design of complex, cross-cutting infrastructure systems. Author and review technical specifications and architecture proposals to ensure consistency, resilience, and long-term maintainability.
  • Influence Without Authority: Motivate product engineering teams to adopt reliability best practices, and act as a trusted advisor on production readiness when new services are designed and brought online.
  • Mentorship: Grow the technical skills of SREs across our US and Bangalore teams through design reviews, pairing, and code review, and help raise the hiring bar by participating in interviews.

Reliability & Performance Engineering

  • Service Standards: Establish the framework for how teams define, measure, and act on SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets. Help teams instrument and monitor them.
  • Incident Excellence: Serve as a senior technical leader during high-severity incidents. Drive a culture of rigorous, blameless post-mortems and ensure follow-up work actually reduces recurrence.
  • Resilience: Lead capacity planning, disaster recovery, and failure-mode testing so our systems degrade gracefully and recover quickly.
  • Observability: Evolve our monitoring and alerting strategy so failures are detected before they impact customers and on-call is sustainable.

Infrastructure & AI Platform Tooling

  • Scalable Systems: Design, build, and operate our AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Atlantis).
  • AI Gateway & Governance: Architect and build governed gateways for AI model routing, including model access controls, audit trails, and secure data connectors (such as MCP) that prevent sensitive data exposure.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure infrastructure, including AI prototyping environments, meets security and regulatory requirements through automated scanning, PII guardrails, and scoped data access.

Efficiency & Cost Optimization

  • FinOps: Lead initiatives to optimize cloud spend across the organization, including right-sizing, spot instance utilization, and cost attribution.
  • AI Cost Management: Design metering and budgeting for LLM token usage, and build cost-aware routing so workloads use the most efficient model for the job.
  • Visibility: Establish clear cost metrics and partner with engineering teams on architectures that are both performant and cost-effective.

Developer Productivity

  • Paved Roads: Build internal tools, CI/CD pipelines, and self-service platforms that make the reliable path the easy path for product engineering teams.
  • Toil Elimination: Identify systemic sources of toil across engineering and automate them away.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience: 10+ years of full-time software engineering experience in relevant roles (SRE, Infrastructure, Platform, DevOps, or Backend SWE), including significant time operating production systems at scale.
  • Staff-Level Impact: A track record of leading complex, multi-team infrastructure or reliability initiatives from ambiguity to delivery, and of influencing technical direction beyond your immediate team.
  • Software Engineering: Strong coding skills in Golang, Python, or TypeScript, and a commitment to engineering best practices: design patterns, code reviews, and testing.
  • Cloud & Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform. Experience building Kubernetes operators is a plus.
  • Systems Knowledge: Strong understanding of distributed systems, PostgreSQL, CI/CD systems, and observability tooling such as DataDog.
  • Reliability Practice: Hands-on experience implementing SLIs/SLOs, leading incident response, and running effective post-mortems.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write a clear design doc, explain trade-offs to executives, and build consensus across teams.
  • Mindset: A strong desire to remove toil from systems, and the judgment to balance reliability, velocity, and cost.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or operating LLM toolchains, such as AI gateways, model routing (e.g., Bedrock, Anthropic), and governance frameworks, including PII scanning and audit trails for model interactions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cloud cost optimization or building usage metering systems.
  • Experience in regulated industries (insurance, fintech, healthcare) or with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2.
  • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams.

Our Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Golang, Python
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Atlantis
  • Observability & Tools: DataDog, GitHub Actions, PostgreSQL
  • AI Platform: Anthropic, Bedrock, MCP

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Role Summary

The Provider Support Coordinator supports the Practice Access Management (PAM) team at the intersection of data quality and provider engagement. This role is equally operational and customer-facing: Provider Support Coordinators execute data and administrative workflows in Salesforce in addition to conducting structured outbound outreach to provider offices on behalf of BlinkRx.

PSCs are often the first point of contact a provider office has with BlinkRx, and play a critical role in establishing the foundation for PAM-led growth. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and process-driven, with strong communication skills and confidence engaging professionally with provider offices.

Responsibilities

Data Quality & Account Management

  • Create, update, and maintain provider accounts and contacts in Salesforce following standardized processes to keep practice records accurate and complete.
  • Clean up records by fixing duplicate accounts and contacts, correcting associations, reassigning holding-account contacts, and ensuring proper account hierarchy.
  • Complete and validate required account and contact fields so downstream workflows and automation function as expected.
  • Monitor automated workflows and alerts; investigate and resolve issues flagged by systems or the PAM team.
  • Flag recurring issues, data inconsistencies, or process gaps and share them with the appropriate partners for follow-up.

Provider Engagement & Outreach

  • Make outbound calls to provider offices to support marketing opt-ins, confirm communication consent, and verify key practice and contact details.
  • Conduct introductory outreach to new accounts — introduce BlinkRx, gather key office and workflow information needed for PA processes, and lay the groundwork for PAM-led growth efforts.
  • Recognize when a provider shows interest or requires follow-up during outreach and document relevant context.
  • Ensure clear, timely handoffs to the PAM team with accurate notes to support successful engagement.
  • Reach out to existing accounts at key points in the relationship lifecycle to surface growth opportunities and keep account data current ahead of PAM follow-up.
  • Triage and resolve inbound requests from the pharmacy team that require direct outreach to HCP offices.

Qualifications

Required

  • 1–3 years of experience in operations, administrative support, data entry, or sales operations
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred)
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable conducting efficient, professional outreach with provider offices
  • Strong organizational and multitasking ability

Preferred

  • Healthcare operations or provider data experience
  • Familiarity with Salesforce

Why Join Us:It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

About Donorbox

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to raise over $4 billion in donations. 🚀

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.

The Team

You will be joining the Fundraising Team, one of the most highly visible and client-facing parts of our application. We are responsible for the Omnigive donation form—the absolute bread and butter of our company. Because this form is highly interactive and critical to our non-profits' success, we rely heavily on vanilla JavaScript on the frontend, powered by a robust Ruby on Rails backend. We operate with a flat hierarchy, a fully remote team, and a deliberate choice to keep our tech stack simple, reliable, and powerful.

The Role: Engineer II — The "Task Finder"

At Donorbox, our engineers in this role are what we call "Task Finders." At the Engineer II level, you own a feature end-to-end under review, surfacing the work the ticket didn't spell out — as we put it internally: "Given I was asked to do this, I'll also need to do that." We don't just hand you a ticket and expect you to act as a pure order-taker — you directly contribute to our team's goals for the year.

What You Will Do

  • Drive the Omnigive Form: Build and maintain complex, highly interactive UI components using vanilla JavaScript, while seamlessly connecting them to our Rails backend.

  • Apply the "Omakase" Mindset: Solve problems with the framework rather than around it. You will write idiomatic Ruby on Rails code using ActiveRecord, controllers, and ViewComponents.

  • Champion Product Sense: Analyze requirements through a "Jobs-to-be-Done" lens. Before writing new code, you will ask, "Can the user already do this?" and actively consider edge cases and error states.

  • Collaborate and Ship: Balance the desire to ship quickly with the need to ship quality. You will review peers' pull requests with care, communicate blockers proactively in async channels, and default to safely shipping value to users.

  • Steward our Knowledge: Help maintain our institutional memory by writing clear PR descriptions, logging non-obvious decisions in commit messages, and updating internal documentation when you spot something stale.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong JavaScript Skills: Deep comfort with vanilla JavaScript, as it is critical for our main donation form.

  • Rails & PostgreSQL Proficiency: Ability to ship features in Rails without close supervision, including writing SQL beyond simple queries (joins, aggregations, and catching N+1 problems in PostgreSQL).

  • Quality & Testing: A strong habit of writing useful automated tests (we use Minitest) by default, including tests that would catch the specific bugs you just fixed.

  • Pragmatic Frontend Focus: Experience using semantic HTML, global CSS (via design tokens), and Hotwire (Turbo, Stimulus) to build out interfaces where custom JavaScript isn't strictly required.

  • Independent Problem Solving: A track record of taking a well-scoped feature and driving it to completion, surfacing the adjacent work needed for a polished final product.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Ruby, Ruby on Rails

  • Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript, Hotwire (Turbo/Stimulus), Semantic HTML, CSS (Design Tokens)

  • Database: PostgreSQL, Relational Databases, SQL

  • Testing: Minitest, Fixtures

  • Mindset: "Omakase" Rails, MVC, Object-Oriented Programming

Details

  • Fully remote based in Latin America
  • Salary: $52,200-$58,000 USD, depending on experience and location
  • This is an Engineer II role on our internal career framework — leveling here reflects scope and impact, not tenure

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote work from the comfort of your home
  • Eligibility for employee equity plan (stock options)
  • Reimbursement package for home office expenses and professional development, up to $1.5k
  • Generous time off policy of 21 days (birthday included 🎉), 8 holidays of your choice, and 2 paid volunteer days
  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes
  • Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

The Application Process

We have 5 stages:

  1. Apply here and fill out our questions to tell us about you!
  2. Prescreen Call with the Talent Team
  3. Technical Interview with Hiring Manager
  4. Panel/Final Interview
  5. Background & Reference Checks

If this sounds like the right role for you, please apply today and let us know why. We look forward to hearing from you!

Through hands-on practice using recorded resources and a demo environment, you'll become proficient in Unanet Time & Expense and begin contributing to client implementation activities under the guidance of senior team members.

In your first 90 days, you'll expand your expertise in Unanet Financials, take ownership of portions of live client implementations, and confidently support customers through key implementation milestones. Your Differentiators

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field
  • Strong accounting foundation with practical experience in general ledger, revenue recognition, cost accounting, project accounting, and financial reporting

Our Values

  • We are a Team. Employees, customers, and partners working together.

  • We Own our Success. Every employee has a stake in our company.

jobs.description:
Chief Operating & Financial Officer (COFO)

Backpack Healthcare | Hybrid/Remote | Preferred: MD, GA, IL, MI, or VA

Build the Operating and Financial Engine Behind the Future of Behavioral Healthcare

Backpack Healthcare is on a mission to make high-quality mental healthcare more accessible to children, adolescents, young adults, and families who have historically been left out of the system.

We are a Medicaid-first, venture-backed behavioral health company delivering whole-family telehealth care across Maryland, Virginia, Georgia, Michigan, and Illinois. With 170+ clinicians, 219 employees, and more than 100 payer relationships, we are growing quickly while building a clear path to profitability.

We are looking for a Chief Operating & Financial Officer (COFO) who is ready to help build what comes next.

This is not a role for someone who wants to sit on the sidelines, analyze what happened, and prepare reports.

You will run the operating and financial engine of Backpack Healthcare.

You will own the numbers, own the outcomes, and lead the teams responsible for delivering both. You will work directly with our CEO and leadership team to turn data into decisions, decisions into execution, and execution into measurable results.

If you are energized by complexity, move quickly, love solving hard problems, and want to have a direct impact on the trajectory of a growing healthcare company, this could be the opportunity for you.

What You'll Do

💰 Own Financial Performance & Profitability

You will be accountable for Backpack's financial performance and the plan that gets us to sustainable profitability.

  • Own budgeting, forecasting, monthly close, financial reporting, and GAAP-compliant financial operations.

  • Build and manage the company's operating model, unit economics, and financial planning processes.

  • Translate financial data into clear operating decisions and actionable priorities.

  • Establish the financial discipline, visibility, and accountability required to scale.

  • Serve as a primary financial voice to our board and investors.

  • Present company performance, forecasts, risks, opportunities, and the path to profitability with confidence.

  • Partner with the CEO on fundraising, including financial modeling, investor materials, diligence, and financing negotiations.

💵 Own Revenue Cycle & Payer Economics

Revenue cycle isn't something you'll review from a distance. You'll own the results.

  • Take executive ownership of billing, collections, and revenue cycle performance across all states and payers.

  • Drive measurable improvements in clean claims, denials, days in A/R, and cash collections.

  • Analyze payer performance, reimbursement trends, and operational leakage.

  • Partner with Growth and Partnerships on Medicaid and MCO pricing, bids, and rate negotiations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve reimbursement, margin, and cash flow.

🤝 Make Every Direct Contract Work

Every contract needs to make business sense.

  • Model the economics and expected margin of direct contracts before they are signed.

  • Build the operational and financial plan required for successful implementation.

  • Establish staffing, onboarding, billing, and KPI requirements before launch.

  • Track actual performance against projected economics after launch.

  • Conduct post-launch reviews and take action when contracts miss targets — whether that means fixing operations, repricing, or renegotiating.

⚙️ Lead Business Operations

You will connect the dots across the organization and ensure our systems actually work together.

Your scope will include business operations, PMO, strategy and operations, credentialing, and care coordination.

  • Establish clear KPIs for each function and review performance on a consistent cadence.

  • Hold leaders accountable for measurable outcomes.

  • Build scalable processes that support multi-state growth.

  • Help prepare the organization for new market launches and expansion.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and eliminate them at the system level.

  • Ensure that referrals, hiring, credentialing, scheduling, billing, contracts, and cash work together as one operating system.

👥 Lead People & Administration

  • Provide executive oversight of the HR function, including talent, compensation, benefits, and workforce planning.

  • Partner with leadership to ensure we have the right people, structure, and accountability to support growth.

  • Manage critical vendor relationships and contracts.

  • Build an environment where leaders understand their numbers, own their outcomes, and follow through.

🛡️ Own Compliance & Risk

  • Ensure operational and financial compliance with Medicaid requirements, state regulations, HIPAA, and applicable accounting standards.

  • Identify risks before they become problems.

  • Bring solutions and action plans — not simply flags.

  • Build processes that make compliance sustainable as Backpack scales.

The Kind of Leader Who Will Thrive Here

We are looking for an operator, not simply an executive with an impressive résumé.

You act.

You see a problem on Monday and have a plan moving by Tuesday. You don't wait for perfect information or endless consensus.

You hold people accountable.

You establish clear expectations, inspect results, have direct conversations when targets are missed, and follow through until the issue is resolved.

You live in the KPIs.

You know the daily, weekly, and monthly metrics that drive the business. You use them to make decisions — not decorate PowerPoint slides.

You operate with urgency.

You're relentlessly curious.

You don't make assumptions. You ask why until you understand the root cause.

You are willing to get into the claims data, understand payer mix, examine workflows, and pressure-test the economics of a contract yourself before making a recommendation.

You think in systems.

This is a requirement.

You understand how referrals connect to intake, how hiring connects to capacity, how credentialing connects to revenue, how scheduling connects to utilization, and how billing connects to cash.

You don't patch symptoms. You fix systems.

You are an AI-native operator.

You see technology and AI as force multipliers.

Your first instinct is to ask:

Can we automate this? Can we build it? Can AI do this faster or better?

You use AI yourself to move faster, analyze information, and make better decisions. Backpack is building an AI-enabled data environment where leaders can access and interrogate company data through simple prompts — and we expect this role to take full advantage of it.

You can move between the weeds and the big picture.

You'll work alongside a CEO who understands clinical operations, recruiting, forecasting, revenue cycle, growth, and the data connecting them.

You will be expected to bring answers, challenge assumptions, move quickly, and continuously raise the bar.

You are comfortable in the investor room.

You can confidently represent the business to our board and investors.

You know the numbers. You understand the story behind them. You can defend the plan, answer difficult questions, communicate risks honestly, and build confidence in where the company is going.

You don't take direct feedback personally.

This is a high-accountability environment.

You will receive direct feedback and be expected to give it in return. You can separate ego from outcomes, absorb tough feedback without becoming defensive, push back thoughtfully with data, and keep moving forward.

Remote, U.S.-based · $90,000 OTE ($60,000 base + $30,000 variable) · Launch your sales career

Most sales calls sell software. Yours will help protect students. The Securly safetyOS™ keeps 20M+ students safe across 20,000+ schools and is credited with helping save 2,400+ student lives, and every district we reach starts with a conversation a BDR opened. If you love the phone, thrive on activity, and want work that matters, this is the role.

Why you'll love this role

  • Real impact: you'll connect schools with the platform that keeps their students safe online, in class, and in the halls
  • A real ramp: structured onboarding and weekly coaching, built for experienced SDRs and career-changers alike
  • Room to grow: we promote from within, and many of our Sales, Customer Success, and GTM leaders started as BDRs
  • Strong pay and benefits: $90,000 OTE, top-tier health coverage, unlimited PTO, and a $1,000 learning stipend
  • Fully remote: work from anywhere in the U.S. with a team that's 82% engaged

The role

You'll own the top of our sales funnel: finding, qualifying, and starting conversations with school districts through cold calls, email, and LinkedIn. You'll introduce district leaders to the Securly safetyOS™, the gold standard for K-12 digital safety and critical IT infrastructure, and hand qualified opportunities to our Account Executives.

You'll report to the Director of Business Development and work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and RevOps.

What you'll do:

  • Reach out: run high-volume, multi-touch outreach by phone, email, and LinkedIn to K-12 decision-makers
  • Qualify: assess inbound and outbound leads for interest, urgency, and fit
  • Tell the story: share outcomes, customer stories, and market data that show why safetyOS matters
  • Handle objections: listen first and tailor each conversation to what the district cares about
  • Keep it clean: track your work in Salesforce and Outreach.io, using GovSpend and AI Gems for research
  • Hand off well: pass qualified meetings to Sales smoothly, in partnership with Marketing and RevOps
  • Keep improving: use coaching, data, and your peers to get sharper every week

What success looks like

You'll get a structured ramp with coaching at every stage. The milestones below show what the work typically looks like as you build up.

First 30 days

  • Learn the Securly safetyOS™, who we sell to, and how we talk about it, with hands-on coaching
  • Start daily outreach: typically 50–100 calls and 50–200 emails
  • Research your territory and add new prospects to Salesforce every week

Days 60–90

  • Hold 10–25+ meaningful conversations a week with K-12 decision-makers, such as Directors of Technology, IT leaders, superintendents, and district and school administrators
  • Book qualified meetings consistently each month as your pipeline builds
  • Create 8–15+ new sales opportunities a month

By the 6-month mark

  • Run and sharpen outbound prospecting across phone, email, and LinkedIn
  • Use coaching, peer feedback, and your own metrics to keep improving

12 months

  • Consistently meet or exceed your pipeline ($) and quota goals
  • Share what works and help onboard new BDRs
  • Start mapping your next step toward AE or another role in Sales, Customer Success, or adjacent teams

Milestones are typical examples, not fixed requirements. Specific goals are set by your manager and may change based on territory, season, and business needs.

Who we're looking for

Great backgrounds for this role include:

  • Early-career sales: you've worked as an SDR/BDR or in another high-activity outbound role and want to grow in K-12 EdTech. SaaS or EdTech experience is preferred.
  • K-12 educators moving into sales: you're a teacher or school staff member who wants to learn sales and has done sales or sales-like work, ideally with high-volume phone outreach.

Whatever your background, you'll bring:

  • Comfort with high-volume phone calls and outreach, and the drive to keep going after a no
  • Active listening and the ability to ask good questions to engage and qualify prospects
  • The organization to manage a daily cadence and keep clean records (Salesforce and Outreach.io experience is a plus)
  • Curiosity to research prospects and personalize your outreach
  • K-12 education and/or EdTech experience, strongly preferred

What sets you apart:

  • Communication: clear, confident, and adaptive, both verbal and written
  • Growth mindset: you're coachable and treat every call as a chance to get better
  • Prioritization: strong time management and focus on what moves pipeline
  • Rapport: the ability to build trust with IT leaders and K-12 educators
  • AI fluency: comfort using AI tools to research prospects and personalize outreach
  • Mission: a passion for student safety and wellness

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. If you have the drive and the core skills, we want to hear from you.

A realistic look at the job

This is a high-volume, phone-first role. Most days are a steady rhythm of calls, emails, and LinkedIn touches, and many of those won't connect or will end in a no. The reps who thrive here treat that as part of the game, track their numbers, and use coaching to get a little sharper every week. When it clicks, you're booking meetings with district leaders who make decisions about keeping students safe.

This role is fully remote and U.S.-based, No Travel, not offering Visa sponsorship

Where this role leads

We promote from within, and many of our Sales, Customer Success, and GTM leaders started as BDRs. From here, the typical path is Account Executive, with options in Customer Success and other adjacent teams.

Compensation and benefits

Total compensation: $60,000 base + $30,000 variable = $90,000 OTE

  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO plus a paid year-end shutdown
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Free 24/7 confidential mental health counseling and wellness tools
  • $1,000 annual learning stipend
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching

About Securly

Securly is the market leader in AI-powered student safety and wellness, trusted by 20M+ students across 20,000+ schools. We launched the first cloud-based K-12 web filter in 2013. Today, we've grown into the Securly safetyOS™: the gold standard for global K-12 digital safety and critical IT infrastructure.

safetyOS is one platform for every part of student safety: content filtering, AI governance, 24/7 student wellness monitoring with human-verified alerts, classroom management, digital hall passes, family engagement, and district-wide insights.

The safetyOS™ impact is scaled and trusted:

  • 20% of US K-12 internet traffic is filtered by Securly Filter
  • 1B online activities scanned, generating 50,000 alerts weekly
  • 2M digital hall passes created and managed daily
  • 85K teachers managing 800,000 class sessions weekly

The Securly safetyOS™ is credited with helping save 2,400+ student lives. TIME named us one of America's Top EdTech Companies 2026, and we're a GSV 150 honoree and an EdTech Top 40 “Most Used Product.”

Our people-first culture shows in the numbers (Source: Securly Qualtrics Employee Survey; WSA Global Benchmark):

  • 82% employee engagement, vs. a 73% global benchmark
  • 94% of employees are proud to work here
  • 91% rate manager effectiveness above benchmark

How to apply

Applications close November 3, 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply early.

Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

Overview

The Senior Director of AI will be a pivotal leader within our cutting-edge humanoid robotics company, driving the strategic direction and execution of all artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives. This role requires a knowledgeable technologist and a skilled manager capable of championing and leading our existing high-performing team to develop the AI foundation for the next generation of humanoid robots. The successful candidate will be instrumental in defining the AI architecture, ensuring ethical implementation, and delivering robust, real-time AI capabilities that enable our robots to interact intelligently and safely with the world.

Core Responsibilities and Deliverables

Strategic Leadership and Vision

  • Define and champion the overall AI strategy and roadmap in alignment with the company's product vision and business goals.
  • Lead the selection and integration of advanced machine learning models, algorithms, and deep learning techniques relevant to embodied AI (e.g., perception, manipulation, natural language understanding).
  • Foster a culture of innovation, rigorous research, and responsible AI development that supports the team's ongoing success.
  • Ensure that all AI systems adhere to the highest standards of safety, privacy, and ethical guidelines.
  • Partner with Hardware and Robot Software leadership to ensure the sensor suite and embedded compute are optimized for current and future AI model architectures.

Technical Execution and Development

  • Oversee the design, development, and deployment of on-robot and cloud-based AI systems, leveraging the existing team's expertise.
  • Establish MLOps best practices for efficient model training, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Drive research into novel AI solutions for complex robotics challenges, such as real-time planning, human-robot interaction, and adaptive motor control.
  • Deliver production-ready AI models that meet performance, latency, and reliability requirements for commercial deployment.
  • Spearhead the Sim2Real strategy, utilizing physics-based simulation (e.g., MuJoCo, Isaac Sim) to train robust policies that transfer seamlessly to hardware.
  • Accelerate our data flywheel strategy to combine teleoperation, synthetic data, and fleet learning to expand the fleet performance and reliability.

Team Building and Hiring

  • Champion the existing team's talent and represent their needs to senior leadership.
  • Develop a comprehensive hiring plan to staff and scale the AI team, including defining required roles (e.g., ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Researchers).
  • Lead recruitment, mentorship, and career development for all members of the AI team.
  • Manage the budget allocated for team salaries, equipment, and necessary infrastructure.

Resourcing and Budgeting

  • Forecast and manage the budget for cloud computing resources (GPUs, TPUs) necessary for large-scale model training and experimentation.
  • Secure and allocate funding for specialized datasets and data annotation services.
  • Evaluate and procure necessary software licenses and tools for AI development and simulation.
  • Regularly report on expenditure and resource utilization to senior leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in AI/ML, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or directorial role.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying real-time AI solutions for robotics, autonomous systems, or other mission-critical applications.
  • Strong expertise in core AI domains, including computer vision, reinforcement learning, and large language models (LLMs) applied to robotics.
  • Proven track record of managing significant technical budgets and scaling high-performance engineering and research teams.
  • Experience deploying models on resource-constrained edge devices, balancing inference speed, power consumption, and thermal limits.

This is a fully remote role with the option to work hybrid if a commutable distance from our Salem, OR, Pittsburgh, PA, or Fremont, CA offices.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to: market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This range may change based on geographical location and may be modified in the future.

As a senior member of the Mark43 team, you’ll take ownership of projects and features from start to finish and be a knowledgeable resource to your teammates. You’ll build robust server-side solutions to our unique problems of scale, security, and reliability. We heavily leverage technologies like Java, MySQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch and enjoy participating in the open source community. As an engineer here, you'll have the freedom to implement your own solutions and have a meaningful impact on our product. We will depend on your strong systems architecture design and technical decision-making in building our products from the ground up. This role offers tremendous career growth opportunities on either a management or Technical Lead track.

  • Tested a new technology or took some action to improve our codebase and engineering practices

The Data & Analytics team is building Life360's next-generation data platform — powering real-time decision-making, experimentation, ML, and large-scale analytics. We operate at significant scale and complexity in a high-ambiguity environment, and we expect engineers to own problems, drive clarity, and raise the bar across the org.

We're looking for a high-intensity engineer who wants to envision, design, and build high-impact data products with cutting-edge tools — all while keeping our members ahead of the metrics. You'll become the go-to person for data products across the business, joining a collaborative team that communicates openly, celebrates wins together, and is committed to helping everyone do their best work.

About the Job

At Life360, we collect a lot of data: tens of billions of unique location points, tens of billions of user actions, billions of miles driven every single month, and so much more. As a Senior Data Engineer II, you will enhance and maintain our data processing and storage pipelines for a robust and secure data lakehouse. We're looking for a strong engineering background — and just as important, a genuine desire to take ownership and make our data systems world class.

The US-based salary range for this position is $148,000 to $216,500. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, distributed data pipelines and systems — from ingestion through ELT to storage — supporting streaming and batch processing for real-time analytics, ML, and experimentation.
  • Automate, test, and harden data workflows to ensure reliability at scale.
  • Architect logical and physical data models that meet evolving business needs.
  • Build and maintain features for ML models.
  • Collaborate with product, analytics, and data science teams to turn data into value.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience working with high volume data infrastructure.
  • Deep expertise with a modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse platform (Databricks preferred; Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar also considered) on a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Hands-on experience with dbt.
  • Experience with large-scale data processing using Spark and/or Presto/Trino.

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured).

  • Clear, confident communication that brings internal teams and external partners into alignment.

  • Exposure to AI ecosystems, MCP, AI agents, or LLM tooling (helpful, not required).

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

About the job

Neo4j Technical Onboarding Engineers play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. As a Technical Onboarding Engineer, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.

Sitting at the heart of our customer-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For our fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., Solution Architect, Solution Engineer, Onboarding Engineering, Customer Success Engineering, or Technical Consulting).
  • Hands-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
  • Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.
  • Hands-on experience and technical proficiency in SQL or NoSQL databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with ETL/CDC platforms and data ingestion.
  • Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
  • Hands-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j).
  • Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk).
  • Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.

Responsibilities

  • Drive customer value by translating complex business requirements into tailored technical solutions that solve core business challenges and accelerate cloud adoption.
  • Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
  • Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
  • Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
  • Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.
  • Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools for logs and metrics, while delivering best-practice workshops on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
  • Produce high-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and a next-step backlog—to seamlessly transition customers to Professional Services and Cloud Operations teams.
  • Synthesise field insights and lessons learned to continuously iterate and optimise Neo4j’s global technical onboarding methodology and frameworks.

Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues.

One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.

The Opportunity

OPSWAT is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the development and growth of the Secure File Gateway, a strategic product designed to complement our established ICAP Server solution, which today is deployed by organizations operating in critical infrastructure and high-security environments.

ICAP Server sits directly in the path of sensitive file flows, enforcing security policy, inspecting content in real time, and enabling safe access to web and internal systems. The Secure File Gateway will build on these core inspection and policy enforcement capabilities while addressing new customer needs, architectures, and deployment models.

In this role, you will own the Secure File Gateway from inception through scale, while working closely with the ICAP Server product to ensure strong alignment, interoperability, and a cohesive platform strategy. This is a rare opportunity to help define a new product category at OPSWAT while partnering with a mature, revenue-generating product used in the most demanding environments.

  • Lead market and competitive analysis across ICAP, proxy, secure web gateway, and inline inspection technologies to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Translate customer feedback, field insights, and usage data into clear requirements and prioritize initiatives.
  • Partner deeply with engineering to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable capabilities—balancing innovation with operational excellence.

What We Need From You

Product Leadership & Execution

Customer & Market Orientation

Go-To-Market Partnership

Communication & Influence

Experience

What Sets You Apart

You’ll join a fast-growing cybersecurity company where product managers have real ownership, visibility, and impact. This role offers the opportunity to influence a critical product line, work alongside deeply technical teams, and help shape the future of secure web gateway and proxy technology.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Ads Auction and Measurements (Remote - Canada)
jobs.excerpt: SummaryYelp connects people with great local businesses.
jobs.description:
Summary

Yelp connects people with great local businesses. Our platform is powered by a vibrant community contributing reviews and engaging with local businesses daily. We monetize primarily through advertising, helping millions of businesses connect with high-intent consumers. The Ads Auction system sits at the heart of this exchange, determining which ads are shown for every opportunity.

The Ads Marketplace team is responsible for the core engine that drives Yelp's advertising business. We develop and optimize the sophisticated auction, bidding, and pacing systems that balance advertiser value (ROI), consumer experience, and Yelp's monetization goals. We work at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and large-scale systems engineering.

As the Principal Product Manager for Ads Auction and Measurement, you will own the product strategy and execution for Yelp's core ad auction, bidding, pricing, budget pacing mechanisms, and corresponding measurements. This is a highly technical leadership role where you will guide the evolution of algorithms and systems that make real-time decisions maximizing value across multiple stakeholders. You will define how we measure the performance and impact of these complex systems, focusing on both short-term efficiency and long-term impact. You will partner closely with world-class engineering and applied science teams to design, experiment, implement, and iterate on auction dynamics and the metrics that guide our progress.

This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular area in Canada. We welcome applicants from throughout Canada. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

What you'll do:

  • Auction Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the product roadmap for Yelp's ads auction, bidding algorithms, pricing mechanisms, and budget pacing systems, ensuring alignment with business objectives and competitive dynamics. Identify key levers for optimization and innovation.
  • Algorithm & System Optimization: Partner deeply with Engineering and Data Science to design, develop, and refine the auction-based ad selection system. Translate advertiser goals (ROI, leads, conversions), user experience, and monetization considerations into algorithmic requirements, and prioritize initiatives based on concrete data and expected impact.
  • Auction Measurement & Evaluation: Define and own the key metrics framework for evaluating auction health, efficiency, and the business impact. Drive the development of robust measurement for complex trade-offs (e.g., relevance vs. monetization, short-term vs. long-term effects). Design and interpret large-scale A/B tests.
  • Independent Data Analysis: Conduct hands-on analysis of large-scale auction and advertising datasets using tools like SQL and Python to uncover optimization opportunities, validate hypotheses, understand performance drivers, and inform product decisions.
  • Technical Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for auction-related features and improvements, from ideation and requirements definition through launch and iteration.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the product leader for the auction domain, collaborating effectively with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Finance, and other Product teams. Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Drive Business Impact: Directly influence Yelp's revenue and advertiser success by improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the core ad marketplace.

What it takes to succeed:

  • Experience: 8+ years of technical product management experience, preferably focused on auctions, bidding systems, search ranking, or monetization platforms within the online advertising (AdTech) industry.
  • Auction & Optimization Expertise: Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience with auction theory (e.g., VCG, GSP), optimization algorithms, statistical modeling, and machine learning concepts relevant to ad targeting and ranking.
  • Advanced Analytical & Data Skills: Proven ability to independently query, manipulate, and analyze large, complex datasets. Proficiency with SQL and data analysis tools/languages (e.g., Python, R) is required.
  • Statistical Rigor: Deep understanding of applied statistics, experimental design (A/B testing), causal inference, and methods for measuring statistical significance and inferring long-term impact.
  • Educational Background: Strong quantitative background; Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Mathematics, or a related field is highly preferred.
  • Technical Fluency: Ability to engage deeply with engineers and data scientists on technical details of algorithms, system design, and data infrastructure.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across various functions.
  • Problem Solving: Strong structured thinking and problem-solving abilities, capable of breaking down complex problems into actionable components.

What you'll get:

  • The top end of the compensation range for this role exceeds $200,000 annually. There are a variety of factors that go into determining a compensation range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data and years of experience. The actual compensation offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience and skill set. You may also be offered restricted stock units and benefits.

jobs.description:
Deine Rolle in unserem Team

Als erfahrener Senior Sales Manager (m/w/d) im Bereich SAP SCM bei Körber Supply Chain Consulting übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem Vertriebsteam.

  • Deine Hauptaufgabe ist die Identifikation, Qualifizierung und Akquise von Neukunden im nationalen und internationalen Umfeld.
  • Du entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten über das gesamte Leistungsportfolio von Körber Supply Chain Consulting hinweg.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für komplexe Verkaufszyklen vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss und entwickelst kundenspezifischer Vertriebsstrategien und Account-Pläne.
  • Der Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung strategischer Kundenbeziehungen auf Management- und Entscheiderebene und die Steuerung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Bid- und Angebotsprozesse gehört ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben.
  • Du arbeitest dabei eng mit den Kollegen und Kolleginnen aus der Beratung, dem Presales, Delivery und Portfolio-Management zur Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen zusammen.
  • Entwicklung von Cross-Selling- und Upselling-Potenzialen bei Bestandskunden
  • Du repräsentierst Körber auf Branchenveranstaltungen, Messen und Kundenevents und beobachtest dabei Markttrends und identifizierst neue Wachstumsfelder im SAP Supply Chain Umfeld.
  • Mit deiner Arbeit trägst Du zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Go-to-Market-Strategie und Marktpositionierung bei.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige erfolgreiche Vertriebserfahrung im Umfeld SAP, IT-Beratung oder Supply Chain Management mit.
  • Idealerweise hast Du fundierte Kenntnisse im SAP Supply Chain Management Umfeld (z. B. EWM, TM, Logistics Execution oder angrenzende Lösungen).
  • Du kannst nachweisbare Erfolge im Verkauf komplexer Software-, Beratungs- oder Transformationsprojekte vorzeigen.
  • Du hast ein tiefgehendes Verständnis von Logistik-, Lager-, Transport- und Supply-Chain-Prozessen.
  • Du konntest bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Entscheidungsprozessen auf Management- und C-Level-Ebene sammeln.
  • Dich zeichnen starke Verhandlungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie ausgeprägte Abschlussstärke aus und bringst unternehmerisches Denken und hohe Eigeninitiative mit.
  • Strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise, verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie internationale Reisebereitschaft runden Dein Profil ab.

Dein Arbeitsumfeld bei Körber Supply Chain Consulting

Eine reibungslos funktionierende Lieferkette von Waren - end-to-end - ist das, was die Welt von heute am Laufen hält. Hier ist Deine Chance, Teil dieser Herausforderung zu werden. Bei Körber Supply Chain arbeiten wir mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um ihre Lieferketten für morgen zu planen und umzusetzen. Wir arbeiten mit erstklassigen Softwareunternehmen wie SAP zusammen und setzen die Visionen unserer Kunden von einer durchgängigen Lieferkette in die Realität um. Wir bringen Supply-Chain-Intelligenz und fortschrittliches digitales Fachwissen ein, das wir in vielen Projekten erworben haben. Wir sorgen für eine nahtlose Integration in die gesamte IT-Landschaft unserer Kunden, bis hin zur Steuerung von Automatisierungstechnologien auf der Hardware-Ebene.

Wenn Du Software-Engineering und Beratung magst, angewandt auf reale Probleme in der Lagerhaltung, im Transportmanagement, im Yard-Management und in der Produktionsabwicklung, brauchst Du nicht weiter zu suchen.

Deine Vorteile

  • Gemeinsam stark
    Unser Erfolg basiert auf Teamarbeit, gegenseitigem Respekt und einem Umfeld, in dem Unterstützung großgeschrieben wird.
  • Schnelle Entscheidungen, direkte Wege
    Flache Hierarchien und unkomplizierte Kommunikation sorgen für Effizienz und eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre.

    Ob flexible Arbeitszeiten oder mobiles Arbeiten – wir ermöglichen dir die Freiheit, deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinen Bedürfnissen zu gestalten.

  • Eure Gesundheit ist uns wichtig
    Wir bieten dir ein Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – mit vertraulicher Beratung und Unterstützung bei gesundheitlichen, beruflichen und persönlichen Herausforderungen – an.

Wenn Du ein erfahrener Vertriebsexperte mit Leidenschaft für SAP Supply Chain Lösungen bist und Kunden bei ihrer digitalen Transformation begleiten möchten, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen!
