jobs.description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

The Academic Associate Vice President (AAVP) role at Southern New Hampshire University's (SNHU's) online Global Campus (GC), provides strategic, operational, and cultural leadership for academic programs by ensuring the delivery of high-quality, healthy programs and learning experiences; best-in-class learner-focused support; engaged and effective faculty; and high-functioning teams that are prepared to execute on institutional and academic programs priorities. The AAVP serves as an enterprise systems leader who connects people, strategy, and operations across academics and the wider SNHU eco-system to ensure that the institution's vision, mission, and strategic goals are met. They build organizational capability by developing leaders, fostering cross-functional collaboration and partnership, simplifying complexity, and leading strategic transformation that improves learner outcomes and institutional performance. The AAVP operates as an enterprise integrator aligning academic quality, portfolio health, talent capability, learner experience, and organizational effectiveness to position the institution for continued growth and innovation.



The AAVP role provides leadership for multiple academic programs teams, and coordinates and supports cross-unit functions and initiatives that are aligned to institutional and academic priorities. These priorities are primarily learner persistence toward graduation, and the efficient and effective use of team resources. They understand how to implement disciplined change within and across teams, support continuous improvement through optimization, and lead teams toward metric and financial results. In leading this work, the AAVP manages a team of Academic Deans and Executive Directors who are tasked with providing discipline-specific and cross-team leadership within academic programs, toward the goal of driving operational efficiency in a "whole-team" approach. They are well-versed in, and connected to, the national conversation regarding higher education, learning modalities, standards, and the development and assessment of student learning experiences. The AAVP reports to the Vice President of Academic Programs at Global Campus.




What you'll do:

  • Provides strategic and enterprise leadership for assigned academic portfolios, ensuring portfolio strategy, priorities, resources, and performance align with institutional objectives, market needs, and learner outcomes.
  • Leads the development and execution of portfolio strategy, using product health, learner, operational, market, fiscal, and other relevant insights to identify priorities, opportunities, risks, and actions that strengthen portfolio performance and long-term sustainability.
  • Promotes an enterprise and One University mindset, building alignment across Academic Programs and institutional partners, navigating interdependencies, and ensuring decisions optimize outcomes for the institution and learners rather than individual functions or portfolios.
  • Provides enterprise leadership for academic integrity, quality, and governance, ensuring policies, procedures, and practices support consistent academic standards, regulatory, and accreditation requirements, learner success, and institutional expectations.
  • Advances organizational agility and talent fluidity by identifying and mobilizing expertise and capacity across portfolios, disciplines, and teams; enabling flexible team structures and product–focused teams as organizational needs evolve.
  • Leads strategic initiatives and organizational transformation, translating institutional priorities into coordinated action and guiding teams through changes in operating models, technology, processes, policies, and ways of working.
  • Builds leadership and organizational capability by coaching and developing Academic Deans and Executive Directors, identifying and cultivating talent, strengthening succession pipelines, and creating opportunities for people to contribute their strengths and expertise where they can have the greatest impact.
  • Strengthens the flow from data to insight to action, establishing expectations for evidence-informed decision-making, identifying meaningful patterns and opportunities, accelerating experimentation and learning, and ensuring actions produce measurable outcomes.
  • Champions operational and process excellence by challenging unnecessary complexity, identifying opportunities to simplify and standardize work, clarifying decision rights and accountabilities, and partnering across functions to improve effectiveness, capacity, and speed to value.
  • Promotes responsible technology and AI enablement, identifying opportunities to augment or automate work, improve decision-making, and create organizational capacity while ensuring appropriate human judgment, quality, equity, and responsible implementation.
  • Builds trusted enterprise partnerships and influences across the organization, creating shared understanding, and aligning stakeholders around common outcomes without relying solely on positional authority.
  • Creates a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement, establishing clear expectations while fostering an environment where people feel valued, contribute their expertise, experiment responsibly, learn from results, and adapt.
  • Stewards organizational resources and capacity strategically, balancing near-term operational requirements with longer-term priorities.
  • Anticipates emerging opportunities and challenges affecting Academic Programs, maintaining awareness of changes in higher education, workforce and market needs, technology and AI, academic models, and learner expectations and translating relevant developments into strategic implications and action.
  • Measures and communicates organizational and portfolio performance, establishing meaningful indicators of progress, surfacing risks and opportunities, and ensuring leaders and partners understand performance, decisions, outcomes, and required actions.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. Job responsibilities can change at any time, with or without notice



What we're looking for:

  • Equivalent of experience in lieu of degree acceptable

jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: Texas

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision
  • Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes
  • Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation
  • Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment
  • Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive
  • Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply
  • Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles
  • Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win
  • Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity
  • Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed
  • Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly
  • Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization
  • Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required:

  • 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communication
  • Pre-sales or customer-facing technical experience
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers, or the public sector
  • Familiarity with HPC and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation
  • Broad technical depth across two or more of: cloud, HPC, AI and machine learning infrastructure, data management, core infrastructure, analytics, or financial and business applications. A career built entirely inside storage is not what we are looking for
  • A track record of selling on value: uncovering what the customer is trying to accomplish and connecting technology to business, operational, and financial outcomes
  • The ability to hold credible conversations with engineers, architects, executives, data scientists, researchers, finance teams, and procurement, and to adjust the message for each
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to challenge assumptions and help customers think through complicated decisions
  • Curiosity, empathy, an open mind, and a genuine appetite for continuous learning
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS in CS, EE, another technical degree, or equivalent experience

Helpful, but not required:

  • Knowledge of current and emerging storage architectures (FC, iSCSI, NAS, SAN, object) and file systems
  • Linux, NFS, and distributed Linux environments
  • VMware, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and general networking
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP, and hybrid or cloud-native architectures
  • Containers, Kubernetes, and microservices
  • Data-intensive applications such as structured databases (SQL, Oracle) and analytics platforms
  • Experience with grant-funded procurement, consortium purchasing, or public sector contract vehicles
  • Experience with higher education, research computing, academic medical centers
  • Familiarity with HPC, research and AI environments: parallel and distributed file systems, GPU-attached storage, schedulers such as Slurm, and data pipelines for genomics, imaging, or simulation

If you meet most of the required list and few of the second list, we would still like to hear from you.

$141,400—$212,100 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. AI and automation

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Number of Openings: 1

Hiring Priority: Active Hiring


We are looking for a Home-Based Production Scheduler to join a growing U.S.-based food manufacturing company that produces high-quality, clean-label bakery and pastry ingredients for industrial bakeries, in-store bakeries, and cruise lines. In this role, you will build and maintain the Master Production Schedule, create and schedule production orders, monitor inventory and customer demand, and coordinate with operations, warehouse, customer service, sales, and quality teams to keep production flowing efficiently and customer orders delivered on time.


REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES


  • Organizational & Time Management – Effectively manages multiple production priorities, stock orders, and schedule changes while meeting strict deadlines.
  • Attention to Detail – Maintains a high level of accuracy in production orders, inventory data, and the shared production schedule.
  • Communication Skills – Communicates schedule updates and changes clearly and professionally with internal teams across departments.
  • Problem Solving & Analysis – Analyzes inventory, demand, and capacity data to prevent stockouts and resolve scheduling conflicts efficiently.
  • Production Planning Knowledge – Strong understanding of production planning, inventory control, raw materials, and manufacturing processes.

WHAT YOU WILL DO


  • Run and maintain the Master Production Schedule (MPS) using Business Central and internal planning tools, ensuring that production requirements are properly identified and scheduled.
  • Regularly review and reassess production requirements that are not scheduled immediately, particularly stock replenishment production where current inventory levels remain sufficient. Continuously monitor these requirements and progressively schedule them over the upcoming weeks based on inventory levels, demand, customer orders, production capacity, and changing priorities.
  • Use the Power BI MPS Dashboard to monitor inventory levels, production needs, open customer orders, and potential stock shortages across finished products.
  • Determine production requirements based on current inventory, customer demand, existing production orders, and stock replenishment needs.
  • Create and manage production orders in Business Central, identifying whether production is required to fulfill specific customer orders or to replenish inventory.
  • Establish appropriate production dates to ensure customer orders are covered on time while maintaining sufficient inventory levels.
  • Proactively manage the risk of stockouts, particularly for high-volume and best-selling products, by evaluating current inventory, upcoming demand, and production capacity.
  • Prioritize production based on business needs and determine which products can be delayed or rescheduled without creating future inventory shortages or negatively impacting customer orders.
  • Schedule production orders in Business Central according to the appropriate production date, machine, and shift, while considering manufacturing capacity and operational constraints.
  • Transfer and maintain the production schedule in the shared Excel production schedule used across the company, ensuring that production information remains accurate and visible to the appropriate departments.
  • Continuously adjust the production schedule based on last-minute customer requests, changes in priorities, inventory issues, production constraints, or operational needs.
  • Evaluate whether existing production orders can be moved, accelerated, or postponed, to accommodating urgent customer requests while minimizing the impact on other orders and future inventory availability.
  • Coordinate production priorities with relevant departments to maintain a balance between customer service requirements, inventory availability, production capacity, and stock replenishment needs.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR


  • Education: Minimum high school diploma required; additional education in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field is a plus.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in production planning, scheduling, purchasing, or a similar manufacturing role preferred.
  • Language Proficiency: Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Working schedule: Ability to work overnight/graveyard shifts in Philippine time or within US operating hours.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (order management, inventory review, work order processing, and production planning) or a similar ERP platform.
    • Previous experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV is a plus.
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
    • Experience using Power BI to analyze data, build reports, and support operational decision-making.
    • Experience with AI automation tools or process automation techniques is highly desirable.
    • Strong knowledge of raw materials, production processes, inventory control, quality standards, and cost management within a manufacturing environment.
    • Strong organizational, multitasking, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Industry: Food Manufacturing (Bakery & Pastry Ingredients)
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Work Shift: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST (USA)

The Regional Patient Advocacy Lead - Transplant will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to engage Patient Advocacy Groups (PAGs) and support community-based activities that advance kidney donation, transplantation and related policy changes. This role will report to the Head of

Transplant Regional Patient Advocacy and is part of the US General Medicines Public Affairs and Patient Advocacy team. This role partners closely with Sanofi’s Solid Organ Transplant (SOT) cross functional teams and informs strategy and execution with PAGs and other key stakeholders in the external transplant ecosystem. It requires coordination across corporate affairs, commercial, medical, and other Sanofi teams to drive awareness and action at the national, state, and community levels. Key responsibilities include

creating and executing external stakeholder engagement strategy, embedding advocacy programming into community-level strategies to improve public health and patient outcomes.


Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives.

  • Develop deep understanding of the solid organ transplantation landscape across key communities and regions, including barriers to both living and deceased donation
  • Align Public Affairs and Patient Advocacy Strategies to regional strategy
  • Design PAG specific community engagement plans to improve public trust and increase donations and transplantation rates
  • Engage with appropriate local stakeholders to advance state-level policies that support living donation, organ donation, and equitable access to transplantation

  • Serve as the advocacy partner within cross-functional teams to support matrix-driven strategies that require targeted community or PAG engagement
  • Represent Sanofi at advocacy summits, patient forums, and relevant external coalitions; support regulatory-compliant participation in community-based activations

  • B.A. / B.S. degree required
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in healthcare in patient advocacy, market access, publicaffairs, corporate affairs, HEOR, or medical affairs

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Have a valid driver’s license
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time for regional and national events, including field team engagement and community activities

iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

Make the ads that grow a new AI fitness app

We're building an AI-powered fitness app that adapts to each person, and we need a creative who can both decide what to make and make it. You'll turn data into ideas, produce ads with AI tools, and see your work running in front of real audiences every week.

This role is for you if…

  • You've made performance ads, not just brand work, and you can show what won and why.
  • AI tools are part of how you produce every day, not an experiment.
  • You love the loop: idea, ad, result, better idea.
  • You'd rather ship ten good variants this week than one perfect ad next month.
  • You want to build a creative engine from the ground up on a small team.

Why now

The iFIT app is early and growing, and paid acquisition is scaling. We're building a lean, AI-first user acquisition team, and creative is the engine. You'll be one of its first hires and set how it works.

Summary

iFIT's vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health (physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery) into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

We're looking for an AI Creative Strategist to run the creative engine behind paid acquisition for the iFIT app. You'll decide what ads to make, make them yourself with AI tools, read the results, and make the next round better. You'll report to the Director of User Acquisition and work daily with our channel managers on Meta, TikTok, Google and Apple Search Ads.

AI tools have made ad production fast. What's scarce is knowing which ad to make and why, and learning quickly from every test. This role combines both: the strategy of a performance creative strategist and the hands-on output of a producer. It isn't a brand creative role, and it isn't a briefing-only role. You'll ship ads every week.

Role Commitments

Year-one outcomes, each with a measurable target agreed in your first 30 days:

  1. Run a high-volume testing cadence. Launch a steady weekly flow of new concepts and variants across paid channels.
  2. Find and scale winners. Raise the share of spend going to winning creative, and replace fatigued ads before performance drops.
  3. Build the AI production pipeline. Set up the tools, templates and workflows that let one person produce at the volume of a small team.
  4. Turn results into insight. Keep a living record of which audiences, hooks, offers and formats win, and share it with the Director of UA and Brand, Product & Partner Marketing.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Creative strategy (~30%)

  • Turn audience insight, performance data and market trends into hooks, angles, offers and concepts for app acquisition.
  • Own the creative testing roadmap with the Director of UA: what to test, in what order, and what we expect to learn.
  • Write acquisition messaging and copy for ads, app store creative and paid landing pages, within brand guidelines.

AI-assisted production (~40%)

  • Produce static, video and UGC-style ads yourself, using AI image, video, voice and editing tools alongside standard design software.
  • Create variants at volume: formats, lengths, hooks, languages and sizes for each platform.
  • Brief and manage freelancers, UGC creators and vendors when work needs more capacity or higher craft.
  • Use AI within iFIT's policies on AI use, data privacy and intellectual property, including rights to likenesses, music and trainer content.

Testing and analysis (~30%)

  • Work with channel managers to launch, read and iterate on creative tests.
  • Analyze creative performance (hook rate, CTR, CPI, CAC and conversion) and decide what to scale, iterate on or kill.
  • Spot creative fatigue early and keep a pipeline of replacements ready.

Partner

How you work together

Director of User Acquisition

Sets acquisition strategy, budget and priorities; co-owns the testing roadmap with you

Channel managers (search, app stores, social)

Launch and optimize your creative in-platform; share performance reads daily

AI Senior Designer (central creative team)

Builds the AI production tools, prompt libraries and brand guardrails; you use them to produce at test volume and flag what new tools or templates you need

Brand, Product & Partner Marketing

What Success Looks Like

By the end of your first year

  • Winning creative drives a growing share of spend, and fatigued ads are replaced before performance drops.

Education and/or Experience

Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.

As an Account Executive-Legal Vertical, you will help organizations solve critical workforce challenges by partnering with HR, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and Mobility leaders. This is an ideal opportunity for a former attorney who thrives on building trusted relationships, influencing decisions, solving complex problems, and delivering strategic business value.

Why Former Immigration Attorneys Excel in This Role

As an immigration attorney, you've spent your career advising employers on complex workforce challenges, guiding stakeholders through nuanced regulations, managing high-stakes cases, and serving as a trusted advisor. You understand firsthand the business impact of talent immigration and mobility programs, compliance, and employee experience. Envoy Global helps solve these challenges every day through a combination of legal expertise, technology, and world-class service. At Envoy Global, many of the skills that make an exceptional immigration attorney are the same skills that drive success in a consultative Account Executive role.

Your experience has prepared you to:

  • Build credibility and trust with HR, Talent Acquisition, Global Mobility, Legal, and executive leaders.
  • Conduct thoughtful discovery conversations that uncover business objectives, compliance concerns, and workforce challenges.
  • Translate complex immigration regulations into practical business solutions.
  • Advise clients on risk management, process improvement, and strategic workforce planning.
  • Navigate multiple stakeholders with competing priorities and drive consensus.
  • Present confidently to senior executives and decision-makers.
  • Negotiate solutions and influence outcomes through strong communication and business acumen.
  • Develop deep client relationships built on responsiveness, expertise, and trust.

As ourAccount Manager-Legal Vertical, you'll leverage your immigration knowledge in a broader capacity by helping employers evaluate and improve their immigration programs, streamline workflows, enhance employee experience, and achieve their global talent objectives through Envoy Global's technology-enabled solutions and legal services platform. While prior sales experience is welcome, we recognize that successful immigration attorneys often possess the core competencies required to excel in business development: consultative problem solving, client advocacy, executive communication, relationship management, and a strong drive to achieve results.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive new business opportunities by engaging prospective clients and educating them on Envoy Global's immigration and mobility solutions.
  • Manage a consultative sales process from discovery through closing.
  • Partner with HR, Legal, Global Mobility, and executive stakeholders to understand workforce planning and immigration challenges.
  • Conduct compelling presentations, demos, and business discussions.
  • Translate complex immigration-related risks and regulatory considerations into clear business solutions.
  • Develop and maintain a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, referrals, and strategic outreach.
  • Collaborate with our affiliate law office, product, marketing, and customer success teams to create exceptional client experiences.
  • Consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets and key performance indicators.
  • Stay informed on workforce trends, immigration developments, and talent acquisition challenges affecting clients.

What You'll Bring:

  • 3+ years of business immigration law experience supporting corporate clients.
  • Experience advising HR, Talent Acquisition, Mobility, and Legal teams.
  • Knowledge of employment-based immigration programs, including H-1B, L-1, TN, PERM, I-140, adjustment of status, global mobility, and compliance matters.
  • A demonstrated track record of managing client relationships and serving as a trusted advisor.
  • A desire to apply their immigration expertise in a revenue-generating, growth-oriented environment.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and passion for helping organizations solve workforce challenges through innovative solutions.

Salary + Commission

Annual Base Salary Range: $90,000- $100,000 + Commission

Envoy Global is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois; however, this role is open to remote candidates. Up to 20-30% travel is required.

jobs.excerpt: Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche.
jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche. They are seeking a highly experienced professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer opening.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

This is a full-time, remote independent contractor position.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.

jobs.excerpt: About ReapReap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries.
jobs.description:
About Reap

Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong with employees across multiple countries. We enable financial connectivity and access for businesses worldwide by combining traditional finance with stablecoins for efficient money movement.

Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.

Backed by leading investors including Acorn Pacific, Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.

Why Reap?

This is a high-impact, senior individual contributor role at the frontier of stablecoin-powered finance. You'll join a lean, experienced risk team and own strategic projects that directly shape how Reap expands into new markets. You'll be part of building the risk infrastructure that makes growth possible. If you're energised by ownership, complex problem-solving, and working at the intersection of traditional finance and emerging technology, this is where you belong.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead new market expansion risk — own fraud risk management across card issuing products as Reap expands into new APAC markets, ensuring controls, configurations, and scheme policy requirements are aligned from launch and maintained ongoing.

  • Drive BIN sponsorship risk governance — evaluate and onboard new BIN sponsorship clients through structured risk analysis, establish initial risk configurations, and maintain governance oversight of the sponsored portfolio on an ongoing basis.

  • Automate and scale operational risk monitoring — design and implement automated monitoring workflows covering fraud alerts, scheme notifications, and client and merchant-level risk signals, reducing manual intervention and improving response times.

  • Champion fraud incident investigation & response — lead deep-dive fraud investigations, BIN attack incident response, post-mortems, and cross-functional coordination.

  • Build risk intelligence with the data team — own and build the risk dashboards and intelligence the team relies on, partnering with the data team to surface fraud and risk signals. With no dedicated risk data analyst today, you'll shape how risk data is presented and acted on.

  • Deliver client-facing risk advisory — work closely with clients to assess their risk appetite, quantify fraud exposure, and define the controls and thresholds appropriate to their business model, acting as a trusted risk partner throughout the relationship.

  • Elevate the team's data-driven approach — leverage risk metrics, dashboards, and analytical tools to make and communicate evidence-based decisions across stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in risk management within a card issuer or acquirer environment, with deep knowledge of card fraud, disputes, and risk operations

  • Strong fraud and risk management background, ideally in card issuing or payments/acquiring

  • Fintech or tech-company experience strongly preferred — you thrive in lean, fast-moving teams and bring the pace and pragmatism that larger, slower-moving organisations often lack

  • Self-driven ownership — you drive projects from beginning to end without day-to-day guidance, spotting problems and proposing solutions rather than waiting for direction

  • Project management — you set timelines, track progress, and surface blockers proactively

  • Stakeholder management — you communicate clearly and translate complex risk topics for non-technical audiences

  • Outcome-oriented — you frame your work in terms of metrics and business impact, not just activity

  • Risk analytics and presentation — strong risk analytics paired with the ability to present risk clearly to stakeholders; less about deep SQL or modelling, more about turning data into a clear story (SQL is a bonus, not a must)

  • Demonstrated ability to manage strategic projects across multiple functions and geographies simultaneously

Nice to Have

  • Background in a high-growth fintech, payments, or startup environment

  • Experience at a leading modern payments or card platform

  • Familiarity with stablecoin or web3 financial infrastructure

  • Experience with data and BI tools such as Looker, Snowflake, or similar platforms

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Flexible hybrid/remote work environment with a global, collaborative team.

  • Insurance coverage after probation.

  • Use of AI tools at work — and the space to learn, experiment, and grow with them.

  • A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning.

Position Summary

The BIM Manager is responsible for leading the implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Building Information Modeling (BIM) processes across projects and teams. This role ensures consistency, accuracy, and collaboration within BIM environments, supporting project delivery through effective model coordination, standards enforcement, and stakeholder alignment from design through construction and closeout.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of BIM standards, workflows, templates, and best practices.
  • Manage and coordinate BIM models across multiple disciplines, ensuring model integrity, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for BIM-related matters across projects, teams, and external partners.
  • Support project teams with BIM planning, execution strategies, and model coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Oversee clash detection, coordination meetings, and issue resolution processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Designers, and Construction Teams to align BIM deliverables with project goals.
  • Monitor model quality, data consistency, and adherence to BIM execution plans (BEPs).
  • Provide training, guidance, and mentoring to BIM Coordinators, Modelers, and Designers.
  • Support client requirements related to BIM deliverables, data standards, and asset information.
  • Assist with 4D/5D modeling, model-based quantity take-offs, and construction sequencing when required.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to BIM tools, processes, and digital transformation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience as a BIM Manager, BIM Lead, or Senior BIM Coordinator on complex projects.
  • Strong understanding of BIM methodologies, coordination processes, and model-based workflows.
  • Advanced proficiency in BIM and design software such as Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and related collaboration platforms.
  • Experience managing BIM execution plans (BEPs) and multidisciplinary models.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large-scale or complex facilities (commercial, healthcare, industrial, data centers, or infrastructure).
  • Familiarity with ISO 19650 or similar international BIM standards.
  • Experience supporting construction-phase BIM, field coordination, and model-based delivery.
  • Knowledge of data management, asset handover, and digital twin concepts.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience within BIM or digital delivery teams.

jobs.description:
About Brilliant

Brilliant is creating a world of better problem solvers. We deliver learning that's interactive, adaptive, and fun – at scale. You can learn more about our approach, learners, and method on our about page.
We have always prioritized building a real, healthy business, and we make hires very selectively and intentionally. We serve hundreds of thousands of paid subscribers, and want you to help us serve millions.
In our day-to-day, we value adventure, excellence, generosity, and candor. We are optimists in the face of uncertainty, we take pride in our work, we go the extra mile for each other, and we tell it like it is (the good and the bad). We’re here to do the best work of our lives together.
We believe that real-time collaboration and human connection are necessary ingredients in building a high-velocity, high-trust team. We maintain core hours (9:30am - 2:30pm Pacific) when everyone is online, regardless of timezone. About half of us are located near our hubs in SF and NYC.
In addition to what’s below, you can see all open roles and learn more about our culture on our careers page.

The Role

CS Learning Designers at Brilliant design interactive learning games to teach programming and algorithmic thinking. We’re hiring exceptional learning designers who can teach computer science concepts creatively using Python, as well as brainstorm new interactive experiences that bring the principles of algorithm design to life.
You will work in a small, nimble team to redefine the future of education. We especially encourage applicants with a strong background in computer science education to apply.
You will use your pedagogical instincts and taste to expand Brilliant’s library of CS learning games and achieve the best possible outcomes for our learners and our business. You will be joining a passionate and experienced team of entrepreneurial-minded people who are working to make a meaningful impact on the world.
To be considered for this role, please include your best example(s) of how you've taught computer science concepts interactively online.

Responsibilities

  • Develop hands-on programming courses to teach CS concepts using Brilliant’s Python learning game.
  • Design new learning games — visual, puzzle-driven experiences that teach foundational principles in algorithms, data structures, and computational thinking.
  • Decompose complex computer science ideas (e.g., recursion, backtracking, dynamic programming) into approachable, well-sequenced steps that empower learners to reason from first principles.
  • Design content that is clear, creative, and intuitive — using interactivity to help learners build confidence and mastery.
  • Build immersive, interactive learning experiences that guide learners along problem-solving journeys.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to imagine and create new interactive features, visuals, and mechanics that elevate the learning experience on both computers and phones.

You

  • Have an undergraduate degree or above in a STEM field, and you’ve developed a strong grounding through research or teaching that extends beyond traditional curricula.
  • You have used AI agents extensively for coding, and have an opinionated stance on what core concepts are important to teach in the world of agentic coding.
  • Have a knack for teaching complex topics using a progression of clear, simple, hands-on steps.
  • You have experience with building or using interactivity to motivate, engage, and challenge learners, including in asynchronous contexts.
  • Have a way with words, especially when communicating challenging concepts, and your writing skills (in English) are top notch.
  • Are great at context switching and prioritizing among a large workload.
  • Have an openness to change and a willingness to experiment with formats and platforms.
  • Are not afraid to jump into any aspect of a project to fill a vacuum, no matter how big or small.

Compensation and Benefits

We use a systematic compensation framework: salary scales are set each year for each job vertical, managers level folks on their team, and those levels are mapped directly to our compensation scales. A location-based adjustment is applied outside of SF and NYC (typically 5-10%) - feel free to ask us about your location!
Given the systematic approach, we always make First and Best offers - there is no negotiation (for new hires nor our existing teammates). This ensures people are paid based on their expected contribution, not their negotiation skills.
We offer top-notch health care plans, with 100% of the premiums covered for medical, dental, and vision for employees.
We offer flexible PTO, with a norm of taking off about 6 weeks per year (including federal holidays). We also provide home office equipment, a professional development stipend, and free food at our offices.
Our CCPA Privacy Notice can be found here.

Role Purpose

JLL is seeking an experienced Technical Services Manager to lead the delivery of hard services across a Private Finance Initiative (PFI) contract portfolio. This role carries full accountability for the technical performance, compliance, and contractual delivery of mechanical, electrical, and building fabric services within a PFI/PPP environment, ensuring outputs meet the stringent availability and performance standards typical of these agreements.


Key Responsibilities

The Technical Services Manager will take ownership of the day-to-day management of hard services delivery, including HVAC, electrical systems, building management systems, fire and life safety systems, and fabric maintenance, ensuring all works are carried out in line with the Project Agreement, Service Level Agreements, and Payment Mechanism requirements specific to the PFI contract.

A core element of the role involves managing statutory compliance and ensuring all technical documentation, asset registers, and maintenance records are maintained to audit-ready standards, given the heightened scrutiny typical of PFI arrangements. The successful candidate will oversee subcontractor and supply chain performance, including commercial management of hard services subcontracts, variations, and works instructions.

The role requires close liaison with the Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV), funders, and the authority/client representatives to manage performance reporting, deduction and availability calculations, and unitary charge implications arising from technical service failures or non-availability events. The manager will also lead on lifecycle planning and asset replacement programmes, ensuring alignment with the contract's long-term maintenance and lifecycle funding obligations.

Health and safety leadership is central to this position, including management of CDM responsibilities, permit-to-work systems, and risk assessments across the technical services function. The role also involves managing, mentoring, and developing a team of engineers and technicians, ensuring appropriate resourcing, competency, and training levels are maintained.


Candidate Requirements


Technical Qualifications (Essential): A recognised technical qualification is required, such as an HNC/HND, NVQ Level 3 or above, or a degree in Building Services Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Candidates with a trade background (electrical or mechanical) combined with relevant time-served experience and supervisory qualifications will also be considered.


Experience: Demonstrable experience managing hard services delivery within a PFI, PPP, or similarly regulated contractual environment is essential. Candidates should be able to evidence experience with payment mechanisms, availability-based contracts, and performance deduction regimes, along with a strong understanding of statutory compliance frameworks (e.g., L8, F-Gas, Electricity at Work Regulations).

⭐ deine aufgaben

Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen persönlich und in direktem Austausch, in enger Abstimmung mit unserem Projektteam, beim Wechsel von anderen E-Commerce-Plattformen wie Shopware, WooCommerce, Magento & Co. zu Shopify. Ob Migration oder Anbindung externer Systeme: Durch deine Arbeit legst du das Fundament, auf dem starke Marken im E-Commerce erfolgreich skalieren können. Klingt spannend? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und hilf mit, neue Erfolgsstories im E-Commerce zu schreiben!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verstehst die Systemlandschaften unserer Kund:innen, erkennst den Bedarf für Anbindungen an den Shopify-Shop und planst die Integration gemeinsam mit dem Projektmanagement Team

  • Du begleitest unser Projektteam bei der Konzeptionierung von Migrationsprojekten und unterstützt sie mit deiner Expertise

  • Du stehst in direktem Kontakt mit unseren Kund:innen, von technischen Rückfragen bis zu Empfehlungsgesprächen. Dabei bist du Ansprechpartner:in auf Augenhöhe, nicht nur Umsetzer:in im Hintergrund.

  • Du führst Migrationen von E-Commerce-Plattformen wie Shopware, WooCommerce, Magento oder anderen zu Shopify durch.

  • Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam die Anforderungen und Limits der bestehenden Systemlandschaft und leitest daraus die optimale Datenstruktur und Logik für Shopify ab. Dabei sprichst du klare Handlungsempfehlungen aus, um Migrationen reibungslos und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten.

  • Du exportierst Produktdaten, Kund:innendaten, Bestellhistorie, Gutscheine und weitere benötigte Informationen aus dem bestehenden Shopsystem, bereitest diese für die in Shopify benötigten Anforderungen auf und importierst diese anschließend in die dafür vorgesehenen Bereiche.

  • Du führst die geplanten Migrationen eigenverantwortlich durch und informierst unsere Projektmanager:innen proaktiv und unaufgefordert über Fortschritt, Blocker und drohende Verzögerungen, sodass alle rechtzeitig Bescheid wissen.

  • Du entwickelst eigenständig bevorzugte Methodiken, etablierst mit Unterstützung neue Prozesse für Migrationen und bringst dich aktiv beim weiteren Ausbau des Bereichs ein.

  • Du hilfst uns bei tante-e den Bereich der Schnittstellenentwicklung & Anbindung externer Systeme an den Shopify Shop aufzubauen und unterstützt perspektivisch unsere Kund:innen mit deinem Wissen bei der Anbindung ihrer Systeme.

✔️ das bringst du mit

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master).

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1).

  • Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse, mindestens aber B2-Niveau.

  • Du kennst dich bestens mit IT Systemlandschaften im E-Commerce und Online-Shop Systemen aus, speziell mit Shopify.

  • Du hast technische Expertise und keine Scheu vor Shopify APIs, Schnittstellen Dokumentation oder größeren Datenmengen

  • Du hast mit deiner Expertise bereits Systeme, die Produktdaten beinhalten, an Shopify angebunden und dabei alle vorhandenen Produktinformationen übergeben

  • Du verfügst über eine äußerst präzise Arbeitsweise und reportest zuverlässig an unsere Projektmanager:innen.

  • Du zeigst Initiative und bist proaktiv. Du wartest nicht darauf, bis andere dir sagen, was du zu tun hast.

  • Du schätzt deine eigenen Kapazitäten und die Machbarkeit von Aufgaben realistisch ein, sprichst Zweifel frühzeitig an und nimmst Feedback als Chance zur Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du kannst komplexe Informationen gut verständlich an Personen weitergeben, von denen du weißt, dass sie diese Informationen brauchen.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, kannst Prioritäten setzen und behältst auch bei mehreren laufenden Projekten den Überblick.

  • Du hast Lust unsere Dienstleistungen mit deiner Expertise auf ein neues Level zu heben, arbeitest dich gerne in neue Bereiche ein und bist motiviert einen neuen Bereich bei tante-e mit aufzubauen.

✨ das bieten wir dir

  • Direkten Impact & spannende Kunden → Du arbeitest mit aufstrebenden und etablierten Marken aus verschiedenen Branchen und gestaltest ihre Shop-Performance aktiv mit.

  • Gutes Onboarding & Weiterentwicklung → Wir machen dich fit für Shopify, zeigen dir die wichtigsten Tools & Methoden und geben dir die Möglichkeit, dein Wissen kontinuierlich zu vertiefen.

  • Eigenverantwortung & Wachstum → Du bekommst von Anfang an Verantwortung, kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und dich durch regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions und Trainings weiterentwickeln.

  • Gemeinsam Zukunft gestalten → Wir sind eine der führenden Shopify-Agenturen weltweit und du hast die Chance, unser Wachstum aktiv mitzugestalten und dich mit uns weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Remote-First mit echtem Teamspirit → Du arbeitest komplett remote, deutschlandweit – wenn du lieber vor Ort arbeitest, stehen dir unsere Büros in Köln und Berlin jederzeit offen. Wir leben eine offene, wertschätzende Teamkultur - durch regelmäßige Team-Events, gemeinsame Teamtrips und engen Austausch schaffen wir echte Verbundenheit, egal von wo du aus arbeitest.

  • Homeoffice- & Tech-Support → Wir unterstützen dich mit einem monatlichen Netto-Zuschuss fürs Homeoffice und stellen dir neueste Apple-Hardware sowie eine Ausstattungspauschale für dein optimales Setup bereit.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 25 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss, damit du langfristig abgesichert bist.

ℹ️ Geplante Übernahme: Die Rolle ist zunächst auf 12 Monate befristet mit geplanter, fester Übernahme.

About the RoleLitify is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Time & Billing team. The code you ship decides how firms capture their time, bill their clients, and get paid. AI-assisted development is how this team works. We use AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code. AI makes each of us faster, but the team still designs, reviews, and decides together.

  • We are a team of four engineers, part of a team of nine with an engineering manager, a product manager, a UX designer, and two QA engineers

  • We track what we complete each week and look at how AI helps us deliver more
  • Features start from Figma designs and go through full QA and a package regression pass before each release

  • Help shape the team’s AI practices and grow into leading them
  • Build toward a senior role at a company that likes to promote from within

jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

As an Analytics Engineer (Finance & Modeling), you'll own the metrics, reporting and reconciliation our financial decisions rest on, turning subscription and transaction data across OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall and Custody Navigator into numbers the business can defend. As that foundation becomes automatic, the work shifts toward forecasting and modeling.

You won't start from scratch. Our dbt project is live on Databricks with a star-schema finance mart in production and documented in Unity Catalog. What's missing is the layer on top, and that layer is yours. We also run an internal AI agent that answers business questions in Slack off the semantic layer, so every metric you define and test becomes a question Finance can ask directly rather than queue.

What you'll accomplish:

  • Governed metrics. Add the definitions the finance mart doesn't have yet (ARR, renewal rate, churn, CAC), versioned in dbt and documented in Unity Catalog, with the tests that make each one defensible, and wired into the agent so Finance can ask them directly.
  • Reporting Finance can run without you. Move the recurring finance pack into marimo, retire the Tableau views behind it, and turn a monthly hand-build into something that runs on a schedule.
  • Numbers that reconcile. Reconcile transactions across the app stores, payment processors, subscription systems and the ledger, with automated checks that alert rather than surface at close. Route discrepancies upstream with the evidence attached and turn each one into a test. You build the checks and escalate. Accounting owns the treatment.
  • Forecasting for Finance. Cohort subscriber and revenue projection, and aggregate renewal and retention forecasting, feeding the CFO's forecast and board reporting. LTV by acquisition source, feeding paid spend allocation with Growth. Pricing and promo impact, modeled before we ship rather than measured after. Individual churn propensity and uplift follow once there's a retention motion ready to act on the scores.
  • Models ship as scored tables in dbt and Unity Catalog, with tests, lineage and a definition the agent can answer from. Not as notebooks.

Who you are:

  • Statistically rigorous. You know why a cohort curve is the wrong shape, what a model is leaking, and when a result is noise.
  • Fluent in finance, and unwilling to let a number you can't explain go out the door. When two systems disagree, you find out why and tell the people upstream.
  • An engineer who owns the number end to end, from a CFO's question through the model, the test, the report and the conversation that follows. A spreadsheet nobody can reproduce reads to you as a liability.
  • AI-proficient in practice, not in theory. Claude Code, coding agents and agent SDKs are part of our daily loop, and we expect you to already work this way. A lot of what used to be a week of modeling work is now an afternoon, and we're hiring for people who have internalized that.
  • Willing to wear several hats. This is a small team supporting four brands. Some weeks you're deep in a retention model, some weeks you're chasing an app store discrepancy or unblocking someone else's dashboard. The scope above is the center of the role, not a fence around it.
  • Motivated by work that matters. Families rely on these products during real moments in their lives.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data science, BI engineering or advanced analytics.
  • Statistical modeling shipped into a business process: forecasting, survival or cohort analysis, or propensity.
  • Measuring the lift from a price change or a growth experiment. You don't need to have designed the test, but you need to be able to read the result honestly and say what it's worth.
  • Subscription metrics you've built and defended to a finance stakeholder: ARR/MRR, renewal, churn, LTV/CAC, or cohort revenue.
  • Strong SQL and real dimensional modeling. You've designed marts, not just queried them.
  • Python and Git as daily habits.
Nice to have, not a dealbreaker:
  • dbt, Databricks and Unity Catalog, or a comparable lakehouse.
  • Reconciling transactional data to a financial system of record.
  • Code-first notebook reporting (marimo, Hex, Streamlit, Quarto).

Job Title: Account Operations Executive

We are seeking an energetic, dynamic and confident individual to join our Business Operations team. In this role, you will manage scheduling and support onboarding and reporting for global clients, ensuring efficient operations and successful client engagements.
This role requires strong engagement, organization and collaboration skills to ensure our resources are optimized across our high volume of clients which is continually increasing.
While the Service Delivery Manager (SDM) has overall accountability for the client relationship, our Business Operations team need to be sufficiently confident and competent in dealing with customers, to support both the clients and the SDM through the processes of onboarding, scheduling and reporting.
This role is ideal for individuals who like working in fast paced environments, and are deeply passionate about customer success, enhancing organizational effectiveness, and driving successful execution at an operational level.

Scheduling
  • Manage the day-to-day scheduling of group activities for our clients.

  • Support teams in adopting and optimizing new scheduling and workforce planning systems.
  • Gather all client requirements for workshops and group events at the outset.
  • Engage the appropriate clinician as assigned by the Clinical team, working with the client to schedule the sessions based on both the client and clinician availability.
  • Ensure the Clinicians’ availability is captured on the Digital Therapy platform back-end, for counselling sessions for our clients, across our global pool of clinicians.
  • Send appropriate communication, workshop details and meeting links to the client point of contact.
  • Assist clinicians and the client with any group booking logistics challenges and escalate any issues to the Service Delivery Manager immediately.
  • Managing requests from the client within the terms of our contracts, balancing flexibility with firm boundaries where requests are outside of our service level agreements.
  • Tracking all schedule details in a standard shared document, ensuring the Service Delivery Manager and Business Operations team members can provide cover and additional support where required.
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy in scheduling practices across the organization
Reporting
  • Run reports from our Digital Therapy platform, collect data from our clinical teams and prepare regular reports on operational performance and productivity.
  • Collaborate with the Clinical team and the client Service Delivery Manager to produce the monthly and quarterly business reports for our clients.
  • Recording the production of reports on the central client database as they are prepared and delivered to clients.
  • Translate complex workforce data into clear insights that drive operational efficiency and business performance
Onboarding
  • Support onboarding for both large-scale programs and smaller, agile engagements, ensuring efficient implementation of new client services.
  • Ensure the service information for each new client is captured for the establishment of the client.
  • Provide first line support for customer enquiries regarding scheduling and scheduling communications.
  • Configure the back-end system for the set-up of new client companies and new clinicians
  • Collaborate with the onsite and corporate clinical teams and our clients to schedule group sessions and support days based on clinician availability and aligned to customer requirements.
  • Collaborate with our clinical teams and the Service Delivery Manager to prepare Launch days for our clients, including marketing and communication packages, user guides and clinician information.
  • Our goal is to have a team that can work equally effectively on small engagements that need to be implemented with nimble efficiency over a period of weeks, as they do with the large-scale, structured onboarding projects that can take up to three months.
Client Support
  • Responding to client queries received on Hubspot, engaging the relevant internal stakeholders as required.
  • Recording details of client communications, clinicians assigned and important account activities.
Teamwork
  • Work collaboratively within the team, supporting each other to ensure clients consistently receive excellent service.
  • Embrace Zevo’s values of accountability, innovation, and teamwork, always putting our customers first.

Qualification & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in business support roles, with a strong focus on customer success, communications and working with data.
  • Proven experience in workforce planning and the effective use or implementation of scheduling tools and best practices.
  • Strong experience working with AI Tools.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and provide actionable workforce insights.
  • Confident engaging and communicating with clients, both oral and written, with the ability to lead meetings both with clients and internal teams.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Demonstrated excellent team working experience with the ability to take ownership of individual responsibilities, that feed into the accountabilities of key internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within a team environment, fostering innovation, accountability, and excellent client service.
  • Experience with scheduling and/or event management is a bonus.
  • Strong capability with Excel is a must, PowerBI capability is a bonus.

jobs.excerpt: K2 Integrity is seeking an experienced compliance professional with deep subject matter expertise in transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and blockchain analytics program design (rule setting, governance, pre/post implementation testing) and model risk management/ validation.
jobs.description:
K2 Integrity is seeking an experienced compliance professional with deep subject matter expertise in transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and blockchain analytics program design (rule setting, governance, pre/post implementation testing) and model risk management/ validation. Sitting within FCRM Advisory, this individual will serve as the practice’s go-to subject-matter expert and project execution lead across several cross-functional areas (traditional finance, fintech, crypto verticals). This individual will be responsible for designing and optimizing detection rules, validating model performance, documenting methodologies, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, including the New York Department of Financial Services (NYDFS) Part 504 annual certification requirements and other applicable U.S. AML/BSA, OFAC, FinCEN, FFIEC, and industry best practices.

This is a rare seat for a practitioner who is genuinely bilingual across traditional finance (tradfi) and crypto. You will validate the analytics that banks, stablecoin issuers, and payments firms rely on to detect financial crime — from Actimize and Oracle Mantas to Chainalysis, TRM Labs, and Elliptic — and translate a fragmented set of client needs into a consistent, defensible, and scalable methodology that the firm can deploy at speed and at margin.

What sets this role apart: we are looking for someone who can do both tradfi and crypto — not one or the other. The ideal hire pairs deep, hands-on experience validating blockchain-analytics rule settings with rigorous TM rule design and coverage assessment discipline, has already built a scalable methodology, and actively leverages AI to deliver better, faster, and more defensible outcomes.

This is a remote role in the USA.

Responsibilities

Model Risk Management & Model Validation
  • Own MRM and model validation engagements end-to-end — pre- and post-implementation testing, ongoing validation, and periodic re-validation — aligned to current interagency guidance, including OCC Bulletin 2026-13 and state standards such as NY-DFS Part 504
  • Apply a risk-based, materiality-driven approach consistent with OCC Bulletin 2026-13, tailoring the depth of validation and effective challenge to the complexity and materiality of each model and the client’s risk profile
  • Develop and maintain model governance documentation, validation reports, and audit-ready workpapers
Blockchain-Analytics Tool Validation (priority focus)
  • Hands-on validation, configuration, and tuning of tools such as Chainalysis (KYT), TRM Labs, Elliptic (Lens), and Merkle Science, including rule library configuration, exposure/typology thresholds, risk-scoring logic, and integration into TM and case-management workflows
  • Serve as the firm’s credible SME on validating crypto models and blockchain-analytics settings
Transaction Monitoring Program Design & Tuning
  • Design and calibrate rule sets and perform coverage assessments that map TM/sanctions coverage to the client’s specific business activity, products, customers, and geographies (never a one-size template)
  • Lead threshold calibration, above-/below-the-line (ATL/BTL) testing, and pre- and post-implementation validation, through to ongoing monitoring
  • Translate risk assessments into defensible detection scenarios and document the rationale for coverage decisions
  • Partner with Compliance, Financial Crimes, Risk, Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to implement and enhance monitoring and screening capabilities
Sanctions Screening Validation
  • Validate and tune sanctions screening systems — list management, fuzzy-matching parameters, threshold tuning, filter logic testing, and name-matching algorithm review (ideally with experience across a variety of vendors)
Methodology, AI Enablement, and Cross-Training Expertise
  • Scalable methodology ownership: build, maintain, and continuously improve a consistent, repeatable methodology across MRM, validation, TM design, and sanctions tuning
  • AI-enabled delivery: leverage AI to improve the speed, consistency, and defensibility of testing, sampling, and documentation, positioning the practice for the emerging AI model-validation adjacency
  • Team development and cross-training: upskill existing resources to scale delivery
  • Client-facing polish: present findings with authority to CCO/BSAO stakeholders, boards, and regulators
  • Market Eminence: Monitor emerging financial crime typologies, regulatory guidance, and industry practices to continuously enhance detection capabilities, and contribute to firm thought leadership as needed

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in AML model validation, transaction monitoring rule design, sanctions screening, model risk management, and financial crimes compliance, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience in blockchain-analytics settings/model review, including validating and configuring blockchain-analytics rule settings (Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, or comparable)
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or international equivalent
  • Strong knowledge of model risk management standards / regulatory methodological fluency including:
    • OCC Bulletin 2026-13 (Model Risk Management: Revised Guidance) and its risk-based, principles-based approach (and SR 11-7 / OCC 2011-12)
    • DFS Part 504
    • FFIEC BSA/AML Examination Manual
    • OFAC “Framework for OFAC Compliance Commitments” and sanctions screening expectations
  • A mixture of consulting and in-house expertise, with hands-on experience across both crypto/digital-asset firms and traditional financial institutions
  • Demonstrated experience performing coverage assessments tailored to a client’s risk profile, designing transaction monitoring scenarios, rule implementation, and alert optimization methodologies
  • Demonstrated experience in sanctions screening rule tuning and list governance
  • Experience supporting regulatory examinations and annual compliance certifications
  • Excellent analytical, documentation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Hands-on platform experience across traditional TM, sanctions screening, and blockchain analytics systems
  • Strong technical and data skills, including ability to independently write and review queries to support ATL/BTL testing, rule replication, and data-lineage validation
  • Strong understanding of statistical validation techniques, data analysis, and model performance metrics
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable warehouses; Tableau/Power BI for outcomes analysis and reporting
  • AI governance mindset: thinks about AI governance and is comfortable reasoning about how model-risk principles apply to AI/ML systems preferred
  • Prior experience with fraud risk models and graph analytics preferred
  • AI/ML literacy sufficient to validate ML-based TM or fraud models under model-risk principles (bias, drift, explainability) preferred
  • A portable book of work or referral relationships from a prior industry or consulting seat preferred
