jobs.description:
Why SalesApe?

Join SalesApe, one of the fastest-growing AI companies, recognised as a leader in cutting-edge AI technology and backed by over $20 million from top VCs.

With AI agents and our natural language interface technology, we’re unlocking huge productivity gains for our clients. It’s deeply rewarding to see firsthand the transformation in businesses as they embrace their agent—not just as a tool, but as a trusted, hard-working member of their team. The emotional bond our clients feel toward their agent is undeniable—they often tell us their ‘Ape’ has become part of the family. Our vision is to become the ‘ brain’ of a business spinning out agent worker, freeing up time and simplifying operations, to ensure humans spend more time in real-life interaction.

If you’re ready for intense, high-energy, meaningful work, come make a real impact with us at SalesApe


Founder Elevator Pitch on our Mission and Purpose:

As we started building with large language models and AI-powered natural language interfaces, I had an aha moment. It hit me just how significant this inflection point is: compute—the raw power of computers—is now accessible to people who don’t use computers."

"And when I thought about that, I realized the closest invention humanity has seen to this shift was electricity. When electricity arrived, it didn’t just light up homes—it transformed industries, democratized wealth, and empowered everyone, from factory owners to farmers, to grow and thrive. Today, with AI, we have the opportunity to do the same for the real economy."

"For the last two decades, the tech industry has had an incredible advantage. Computers have been like co-pilots for us, quietly amplifying our productivity and enabling us to grow faster than ever before. But 95% of businesses—builders, plumbers, and real estate agents—have been technically starved. These businesses make up 50% of GDP, five times larger than the entire tech industry, but they’ve never had access to the tools they need to compete."

"This is the inequality we’re solving. APE AI is democratizing technology, bringing the power of compute to businesses that have been left behind. And what’s so rewarding is that we’re not just helping faceless corporations—we’re empowering real people. People whose success directly impacts their families, their communities, and society at large. It’s deeply rewarding to see firsthand the transformation in small businesses as they embrace their agent—not just as a tool, but as a trusted, hard-working member of their team."

"For me, this mission is personal. I’ve spent my career building companies that encourage people to connect in real life, to be physically active, and to engage with their communities. This isn’t just about productivity—it’s about health, happiness, and thriving societies. Humans weren’t built to spend their lives staring at screens. We’re wired to interact, to move, to be part of the real world. And what excites me is that Ape AI is helping to make this possible—empowering businesses that create real-world value to thrive at the same pace as the tech giants."

"This isn’t just about technology. It’s about fairness. It’s about giving the power of compute to the people who need it most, so they can grow, thrive, and make a difference. That’s our mission, and it’s something we can all be proud of.

Role Overview:

SalesAPE.ai is looking for a dynamic B2B T1 FS Enterprise Sales Executive to drive growth among Banks by selling our cutting-edge inbound lead qualification bot. This role goes beyond traditional sales—it requires a consultative advisor who can strategically guide clients on conversion rate optimization, go-to-market funnels, and intelligent lead funnel analysis. If you’re a self-driven, growth-oriented sales expert with a proven track record and a passion for technology, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Consultative Selling: Engage with Banks using a consultative approach, diagnosing their sales development challenges and advising on conversion rate optimization and effective lead funnel strategies.
  • End-to-End Sales Management: Oversee the full sales cycle—from prospecting and lead generation to closing—ensuring efficiency and a strong customer relationship throughout.
  • Product Expertise: Demonstrate deep understanding of our inbound lead qualification bot and AI SDR capabilities, showcasing its ability to transform lead qualification processes.
  • Advisory Role: Act as a trusted advisor by consulting on go-to-market funnels, conversion optimization, and strategies for sourcing and nurturing leads.
  • Continuous Self-Development: Proactively enhance your sales techniques and industry knowledge through ongoing self-learning and engagement with digital sales platforms (including video calls and virtual demos).
  • Top Closer: Utilize your exceptional closing skills to consistently be a top performer within the sales team.

Requirements:

  • Proven B2B SaaS sales experience, particularly with Banks.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with an ability to discuss and optimize conversion rates, lead funnels, and market strategies.
  • Demonstrated history of self-learning via books, courses, and other resources to refine sales acumen.
  • Renowned as a top closer in previous roles.
  • Highly self-motivated with the ability to manage your own workload and drive results independently.
  • Excellent communication skills, adept at digital interactions and virtual presentations.

What We Offer:

  • A pivotal role in a fast-growing AI startup, working with a unique product that revolutionizes inbound lead qualification.
  • Competitive compensation structure, including performance-driven incentives.
  • Opportunities for career advancement, including potential leadership roles within the sales team.
  • A collaborative, innovative, and supportive work environment that values autonomy and creativity.
  • Continuous professional development in the rapidly evolving field of AI-driven sales solutions.

jobs.description:
We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.

Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more.

We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.

ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with all-remote teams.
  • Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.
  • Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.
  • That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

  • Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.
  • Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.
  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.
  • A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)
  • Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

jobs.description:
Description

The Financial Project Analyst has for objective to track and report on the profitability of projects. This role involves collaboration with project teams, clients and internal departments to ensure the financial performance and high quality of clinical research project management services.

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You have a solid understanding of complex enterprise processes and wish to help shape a growing finance and accounting department.
  • Working with internal and external stakeholders comes easily to you.
  • You want to learn all about the life science industry and clinical trials operations

RESPONSABILITIES

More specifically, the Project Financial Analyst must:

Project and budget set-up

  • Review and understand the client agreements and convert them into the Innovaderm internal cost structure
  • Create and configure projects in the project management and financial systems
  • Prepare and upload the project budget and related amendments impacting scope and/or timeline in the project management tool
  • Participate in the identification and the price assessment of the out-of-scope services.

Revenue / Expenses recognition and project reconciliation

As per month end schedule:

  • Ensure revenue and expenses are recognized based on Canadian GAAP and contractual requirements (including creation of journal entries for accruals and project allocation)
  • Review actual project revenues and costs compared to budget and forecast, identifying variances and their causes
  • Prepare and present detailed project financial reports, including but not limited to; profit and loss statement, financial projections (ETC and accrual report), invoicing status for internal and external stakeholders
  • Monitor and ensure accuracy of projects balance sheet accounts
  • Maintain accurate and organized financial records of project data

Invoice management

  • Review project invoicing and provide expertise as needed
  • At the end of the study, ensure all invoices were produced and paid
  • Act as the main point of contact for clients on any questions related to the invoicing

Collaboration with project team

  • Work closely with project managers to understand project requirements and financial implications
  • Provide financial guidance and support to project teams, helping them manage budgets and control costs
  • Facilitate regular financial review meetings with project managers and clients to discuss budget status, invoicing and other financial items

Internal presentations and special projects

  • Support internal and external audits by providing necessary financial documentation
  • Identify opportunities for process enhancements to increase efficiency and accuracy
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of improved financial processes and tools

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting of related field
  • CPA certification, an asset

Experience

  • minimum of 4 years of experience in project accounting

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of spoken and written English
  • Professional judgment and proven interpersonal skills
  • Excellent analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Critical thinking and proactive problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines
  • Proficiency with financial management tools and office software (Excel, Power BI, ERP)
  • Comfortable working in an environment in constant evolution

Our company

﻿The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Company benefits package
  • Ongoing learning and development

﻿About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale..

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Poland.

jobs.title: Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives
jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 4+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.
Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How We Support You:
  • Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting
  • Paid leave for all new parents
  • Learning & Development stipend for employees
  • Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays + Winter Break (3 Days) + Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) + Floating Holiday (1 Day)
  • Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0-1 years of employment + 20 days for 1-3 years of employment
  • Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!
Come As You Are!
In Tandem provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

About WebEngage:

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.
  • We are built for outcomes.
At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

Life at WebEngage:

We are seeking an experienced Sr Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate the Cloud infrastructure underpinning HealthEdge's next generation of digital health platforms. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on cloud engineering expertise with a security-first mindset, and can operate independently across a large, multi-account cloud environment.

Cloud Infrastructure & Architecture

  • Design, build, and maintain AWS and Azure infrastructure across a multi-account, multi-region environment supporting multiple product lines.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code with reusable, auditable modules.
  • Design and implement cross-account IAM patterns, including assume-role trust policies, least-privilege enforcement, and SCP/tagging governance.
  • Contribute to capability, scalability, and cost-efficiency planning for current and forecasted infrastructure needs.

CI/CD, Automation, and Delivery

  • Build, maintain, and evolve CI/CD pipelines enabling automated, secure, and reproducible IaC deployments across HealthEdge.
  • Develop custom automation and scripting to reduce manual toil and enforce operational standards.
  • Operationalize solutions from proof-of-concept through production, prioritizing repeatability and maintainability.

Reliability, Monitoring, and Incident Response

  • Monitor, scale, and maintain production resources with availability, performance, and security as top priorities.
  • Participate in on-call rotation; troubleshoot production issues, drive root cause analysis, and contribute to incident retrospectives.
  • Establish and maintain observability practices and related tooling including metrics, dashboards, and alerting that surface issues before they become incidents.

Security & Compliance

  • Maintain and strengthen security program controls in accordance with HealthEdge's FedRAMP and HIPAA obligations.
  • Build automated security checks into CI/CD pipelines and cloud environments.
  • Partner with SecOps on IAM role design, trust policy reviews, and audit evidence for compliance assessments.

Cost & Operational Efficiency

  • Contribute to FinOps initiatives: identify, diagnose, and remediate cost anomalies.
  • Make pragmatic tradeoffs between infrastructure cost, performance, and resource utilization.

AI Enabled Engineering

  • Use AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate IaC development, scripting, and troubleshooting.
  • Use AI tooling to draft first-pass documentation, runbooks, and incident retrospectives; validate and refine before publishing.
  • Evaluate emerging AI-assisted operations patterns for applicability to HealthEdge's platform, balancing velocity gains against the compliance and audit requirements.

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Design and document cloud best practices, guardrails, and reference architectures for use across engineering teams.
  • Provide technical expertise to product teams delivering on AWS; recommend and implement process/tooling improvements.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging cloud technologies and assess applicability to HealthEdge's platform roadmap.

  • Experience leveraging AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) as part of daily engineering workflow.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity; thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

The Pharmacist, Population Health will be responsible to perform duties related to the development, implementation, outcomes reporting, and ongoing administration and support of Navitus Clinical Programs including Drug Utilization Review (i.e., RDUR, CDUR), Health Management (i.e., clinical edits, Asthma Management, COPD Management, Pharmacogenomics, Pharmacoadherence, Prescriber Insights, MTM), and other strategic clinical initiatives (i.e., Residency Program) across all lines of business. The Pharmacist, Population Health will also provide support to other clinical areas including Account Management, Lumicera, Drug Information and Pipeline, and the Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) Committee.

Additionally, the Pharmacist, Population Health is responsible for reviewing, evaluating, and sharing the health outcomes and utilization data for program management and development. The Pharmacist, Population Health will develop and maintain appropriate clinical, evidence-based documentation that supports PBM programs. The primary functions involve ensuring that Navitus can provide clinically sound programs (including products, edits, and reports) in the most cost-effective manner and utilize technology to implement clinical programs. This utilization of technology frequently involves translation between technical guidelines and clinical program business requirements as well as program testing.

  • Lead the development of new clinical programs and manage the maintenance of existing programs

  • Provide clinical expertise related to formulary decisions made by the P&T Committee and Formulary Advisory Committee
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy or PharmD required.
  • Current, unrestricted licensure as a Registered Pharmacist in the state of residence, or the ability to gain reciprocity within 4 months.
  • 2+ years of clinical experience, or clinical or managed care pharmacy practice residency and 1-year clinical experience.
  • Knowledge of PBM industry, formulary management, pharmacy claims and managed care principles and practices desired.
  • Proficiency in drug literature and clinical trial evaluation, including proficiency with electronic databases (e.g., Micromedex, Medline, Facts & Comparisons) preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint including tables, charts and figures preferred
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives

jobs.excerpt: Opportunity is not evenly distributed.  Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business.
jobs.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)

  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience.

The Difference You Will Make:

As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

About the Role

CENSUS is looking for a iOS Vulnerability Researcher to join our security research team, focused on vulnerability discovery and exploitation across the iOS userland attack surface.

You’ll spend your time reverse engineering proprietary Apple software, identifying security boundaries and interesting attack surfaces, developing fuzzers and instrumentation, and turning promising primitives into reliable vulnerability research.

This is a hands-on research role for someone who enjoys working close to the metal, understands Apple's ecosystem and is comfortable operating without complete documentation.

  • Develop custom tooling for binary analysis, instrumentation, tracing, fuzzing, and vulnerability research.

  • Experience debugging with lldb.

Previous iOS or macOS vulnerability research.

Public vulnerability disclosures, CVEs, security advisories, conference talks, or substantial private research experience.

Familiarity with arm64e Apple specific internals

Familiarity with jailbreak-era or modern iOS research tooling is useful, but not required.

Experience adapting research techniques between iOS releases and dealing with

undocumented platform changes.

Experience with reversing Objective-C binaries.

Experience with iOS/macOS IPC mechanisms, such as mach messages, MIG, and XPC

jobs.description:
Sr Director, Product Management, Dealer Marketing Solutions (Autopoint)

Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms, and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

AutoPoint is how thousands of dealerships stay connected to their customers between visits. Today that means On Demand and Journey, proven owner marketing programs that drive service revenue and retention. Tomorrow it means a modern, omni-channel dealer marketing platform that follows the customer across the full relationship, from first lead through sale, service, and repurchase.

As Senior Director, Product Management for Dealer Marketing Solutions, you will own both. You will run and grow the current business while discovering, defining, and delivering the platform that replaces it. This is a hands-on product management role: customer discovery, problem definition, requirements, prioritization, and the discipline to say no. You will work shoulder to shoulder with development and marketing operations, and you will pull the AutoPoint roadmap across the entire Dealer Solutions portfolio so dealers get one connected customer experience from lead marketing to sales marketing to service marketing.

What You’ll Do

Current Portfolio Ownership

  • Own the roadmap, performance, pricing, and customer outcomes for On Demand and Journey, the live owner marketing programs that generate revenue and serve dealers today.
  • Manage the P&L for the dealer marketing portfolio, including program economics, campaign margin, and the levers that move retention and service revenue for dealer customers.
  • Protect and improve the running business while the next platform is being built; no degradation in service levels, campaign performance, or dealer satisfaction during the transition.
  • Serve as the executive product point of contact for strategic dealer groups and the escalation path for product performance issues.

Discovery and Customer Insight

  • Lead structured discovery with dealers, dealer groups, marketing agencies, OEM programs, and internal fulfillment teams to understand what actually drives service and sales conversion at the store level.
  • Spend meaningful time in dealerships observing how marketing is planned, executed, and measured, and translate what you see into validated problem statements backed by evidence.
  • Size opportunities with data, separating what dealers ask for from what they will pay for, and build the business cases that justify platform investment.
  • Establish an always-on voice of customer motion including advisory councils, design partners, and win/loss analysis that feeds the roadmap continuously.
  • Maintain a rigorous view of the competitive landscape across dealer marketing, CRM-attached marketing, and agency service providers.

Platform Definition and Roadmap

  • Define the target state for the next generation dealer marketing platform: campaign orchestration across email, SMS, direct mail, digital, and in-store, plus audience management, segmentation, automation, and measurement dealers trust.
  • Write clear, testable product requirements and acceptance criteria; own the backlog, the prioritization framework, and the tradeoff decisions behind both.
  • Decide what carries forward from today, what gets rebuilt, and what gets retired, and sequence the build so value ships incrementally rather than in one large release.
  • Define the migration path for existing On Demand and Journey dealers, including packaging, pricing, communication, and the operational plan to move them without disruption.
  • Define success metrics up front for every major release and hold the product accountable to them after launch.

Delivery with Development and Marketing Operations

  • Partner daily with engineering on scope, architecture tradeoffs, estimation, and release sequencing; be present in the details rather than handing off documents.
  • Work directly with marketing operations and fulfillment teams on the execution realities that make or break a campaign, including data hygiene, deliverability, print and mail production, creative workflow, and compliance review.
  • Drive the operating cadence for the product: roadmap reviews, release planning, launch readiness, and post-launch performance reviews.
  • Partner with sales, customer success, and enablement to ensure every release lands with the field and reaches dealers.

Cross-Portfolio Customer 360

  • Work across the Dealer Solutions portfolio (DealerSocket CRM, iDMS, Automate, DealerFire, RedCap) to unify the customer record and connect lead marketing to sales marketing to service marketing.
  • Define the data, identity, and consent requirements needed to deliver one customer profile and one coordinated set of conversations across the dealership.
  • Collaborate with peer product leaders to build joint solutions that are more valuable together than apart, and quantify that value for dealers and for Solera.
  • Influence platform and data investment decisions so dealer marketing needs are represented in shared roadmap priorities.

Leadership

jobs.excerpt: Department: Finance and Operations Engagement type: Independent contractor (1099), part-time, hourly Reports to: Chief of Staff, with priorities set by the CEO Work arrangement: RemoteSummary of RoleThe Data and Reporting Analyst gives Ultra's leadership direct, reliable access to the numbers that run the business.
jobs.description:
Department: Finance and Operations
Engagement type: Independent contractor (1099), part-time, hourly
Reports to: Chief of Staff, with priorities set by the CEO
Work arrangement: Remote

Summary of Role

The Data and Reporting Analyst gives Ultra's leadership direct, reliable access to the numbers that run the business. The analyst turns payroll, accounting, Salesforce, and Projector PSA data into structured Excel datasets, pivot tables, and reports that leadership can use, refresh, and trust, replacing static snapshots and one-time extracts with live, documented reporting. This is an independent contractor (1099) engagement, with an initial build followed by ongoing maintenance and analysis.
The analyst works with Ultra's leadership to decide what the business needs to see, defines the underlying structure (the dimensions, such as department, GL account, date, client, and sales executive, and the facts, such as hours, quantities, and dollar amounts), and builds reporting on top of it. Initial priorities are lead and bookings reporting from Salesforce, a payroll compendium built from payroll register data, and finance and forecast reporting that combines accounting data with Projector PSA data. The role requires comfort analyzing data, spotting what does not add up, and explaining what the numbers mean in plain language.

Primary Responsibilities

Data Foundation and Reporting Design

  • Meet with leadership to understand the questions they need answered, and define the dimensions (such as department, GL account, date, client, project, and sales executive) and facts (such as hours, quantities, and dollar amounts) that each report will use. Document the definitions so that everyone reads the numbers the same way.
  • Extract data from source systems and organize it into clean, structured Excel datasets that refresh reliably and feed pivot tables, so that reporting no longer depends on manual rework or one-time extracts.
  • Build and maintain pivot tables that let leadership analyze results by period, department, client, person, and other dimensions without requesting a new report each time.
  • Document data sources, refresh steps, formulas, and report logic so that reporting can be maintained and, if needed, handed to someone else.
  • Validate reports against source totals before they are shared, and note any differences, assumptions, or data limitations.

Payroll Reporting

  • Extract payroll data from the payroll provider's reports, including the payroll register, into a structured format, and build and maintain a payroll compendium that leadership can analyze year to date and by pay period.
  • Report gross pay, net pay, and earnings types (regular earnings, bonus, commission, incentive, and other) by employee, department, and period, and reconcile totals to the payroll provider's company-level summary.
  • Support compensation and cost analysis requested by leadership, handling the data with strict confidentiality.

Finance Reporting

  • Convert accounting data and projections from the outsourced accounting team into pivot-ready form, and build finance reports such as profit and loss by period, expense by function, and actual versus projected results.
  • Build and maintain expense and projection models that separate fixed and variable costs by function, and update them as periods close.
  • Support the periodic forecasting process by assembling revenue and cost views from Projector and accounting data, comparing forecast to actual, and explaining variances.
  • Identify cost, margin, and cash trends and bring them to leadership's attention with a view of what is driving them.

Sales and Lead Reporting (Salesforce)

  • Build and maintain Salesforce reports and extracts covering leads, MQLs, SALs, and SQLs, conversion by lead source and type, and the history of lead assignments by sales executive.
  • Report bookings by period, client, and sales executive, separating new logos, follow-on work, and change orders, and track average deal size and win rates over time.
  • Report pipeline by stage and expected close period, and highlight data gaps (such as missing stages, dates, or sources) to Revenue Strategy and Operations so that records are corrected.
  • Support Salesforce data cleanup so that reports are based on complete, consistent records.

Projector PSA Reporting

  • Build reports and extracts from Projector PSA on revenue by client, project, resource, and week or period; hours; budgets versus actuals; utilization; and project stage and pipeline category.
  • Maintain the Excel workbooks that use Projector data, including revenue forecasts and by-client views, keep their pivot tables and totals accurate, and investigate unexpected changes.
  • Work with Revenue Strategy and Operations and Service Delivery leadership to understand how projects are set up and scheduled in Projector so that reports reflect how the business actually works.

Analysis and Communication

  • Analyze trends and explain their drivers, such as changes in lead volume and conversion, average deal size, follow-on work, utilization, margin, and cost.
  • Summarize findings in clear written notes and simple visuals that a business leader can read quickly, and answer follow-up questions.
  • Use AI tools approved by Ultra, such as Microsoft Copilot, to speed up analysis where appropriate, and verify the results before sharing them.
  • Respond to ad hoc requests, meet reporting deadlines tied to the company's weekly and period cycles, and tell leadership early when data is late, incomplete, or unreliable.

Reporting Scope

The analyst owns the accuracy, documentation, and usability of the reports and datasets assigned to the role. Source systems remain with their business owners: Revenue Strategy and Operations for Salesforce data and sales reporting definitions, Revenue Strategy and Operations and Service Delivery leadership for Projector PSA, the outsourced accounting team for accounting records, and Ultra's HR and operations team for payroll. The analyst does not make accounting entries, change payroll, or approve financial decisions; the role provides the reporting and analysis that informs them.

Required Knowledge and Qualifications

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, structured tables, Power Query or other data connections, lookup functions (such as XLOOKUP or INDEX and MATCH), conditional formulas (such as SUMIFS), data cleaning, and charts.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize large data sets (tens of thousands of rows) into structured, refreshable models and to keep them accurate over time.
  • Experience analyzing business data and presenting findings to executives, including explaining what changed and why.
  • Working knowledge of financial data, including profit and loss reporting, general ledger accounts, and payroll data, and the ability to reconcile reports to source totals. Familiarity with QuickBooks reports is helpful.
  • Experience building reports and dashboards in Salesforce and extracting lead, opportunity, and booking data, with an understanding of the lead-to-opportunity sales funnel.
  • Familiarity with reporting in Projector PSA, including revenue, hours, budget, and utilization reports. Experience with a comparable professional services automation tool may be considered for a candidate who can demonstrate the ability to learn Projector quickly.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the habit of checking numbers against the source and questioning results that look wrong.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to translate business questions into data requirements.
  • Ability to work independently as a contractor, manage time and priorities, and deliver on agreed dates.
  • Discretion and integrity with confidential payroll, compensation, financial, and client information.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in professional services or consulting, where utilization and project revenue are tracked closely.
  • Experience with Power BI or a similar analytics tool, and basic SQL.
  • Experience with payroll provider reports (for example, TriNet) and QuickBooks.
  • Experience with FP&A work, such as budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Experience using AI assistants such as Microsoft Copilot for analysis, with careful validation of the results.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

Performance Expectations

Performance is assessed through the accuracy of reports against source data; delivery by agreed dates; whether datasets refresh reliably and are documented well enough for others to maintain; how well leadership can use the reports on its own; responsiveness to requests; and the quality of the insight that explains the results. Priorities, deliverables, and timelines are agreed with Ultra leadership in the statement of work, beginning with an initial build phase.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None. This role has no direct reports.

Work Environment and Expectations

Ultra is a remote organization. Contractors are expected to maintain a reliable internet connection, be available during agreed working hours with reasonable response times, and comply with Ultra's requirements for confidentiality, conduct, and data privacy and security. A signed subcontractor agreement and nondisclosure agreement and completed onboarding are required before system access is granted.
This role has access to payroll, compensation, and financial information, so access is limited to the systems and reports needed for the work. Company and client data may be used only with tools approved by Ultra and may not be placed in unapproved external or AI tools. No client travel is expected, although occasional participation in virtual company meetings may be requested. Occasional work outside regular hours may be needed around period close or for urgent reporting deadlines.

About Ultra Consultants

Founded in 1994, Ultra Consultants is an independent, vendor-agnostic consulting firm serving mid-market manufacturing and distribution companies. Ultra helps clients improve business performance through business process improvement, ERP and technology selection, implementation management, project management, and organizational change management.

Engagement and Compensation

Ultra's remote team collaborates through virtual company meetings. The company values high-quality client service, professional expertise, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Independent contractor (1099) engagement. The contractor is not an employee and is responsible for their own taxes and insurance; employee benefits do not apply.
  • Hourly rate based on experience and scope, with hours and deliverables agreed in the statement of work: a defined initial build, followed by an ongoing maintenance cadence.
  • Part-time, flexible schedule with agreed deadlines tied to the company's reporting cycles.
  • Direct work with company leadership and a meaningful role in how the business is measured. The engagement may continue or expand based on business needs and performance.

Work Authorization and Engagement Information

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States. Ultra does not sponsor individual work visas. Security clearance is not required.
Classification: Independent contractor (1099)
Ultra is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All applicants will be considered for engagement without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Presales Director

We are continually growing and are always interested in connecting with exceptional talent. Interested in a career that bridges the gap between Supply Chain and Technology?

Elemica, a global leader in digital supply chain automation, is seeking experienced Presales Director to grow our business and strengthen our partnerships with existing top enterprise clients. This is an opportunity to join a growing company of talented and committed individuals, unified in the common goal of exceeding our client’s expectations.

This role will have a competitive total compensation package and recognition for overachievement of sales goals.

Our Values

At Elemica, we believe that embodying our values is essential for all team members. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community:


  • Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them
  • Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners
  • Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently.
  • Passion – We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chain

What’s In It For You?

  • Industry impact: Help Fortune 1000 companies digitize over $1 trillion in annual commerce
  • End-to-end solutions: work across procurement, order automation, and logistics on a single SaaS platform
  • Collaborative team: join a highly experienced, globally connected commercial organization
  • Flexibility & exposure: remote-first role with global client interactions and cross-functional partnerships
  • Customer-centric work
  • Cutting-edge supply chain technology and innovation

Role & Responsibilities

Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Presales, the Presales Director is the primary presales contact for opportunities, primarily in EMEA. You’ll engage directly with enterprise clients to understand their business goals, uncover process challenges, and design tailored solutions that drive digital transformation.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the lead presales consultant for new client opportunities and expansions, supporting account executives across industries
  • Collaborate with clients to understand supply chain pain points and demonstrate how Elemica’s solutions address them through procurement, order-to-cash, and logistics operations
  • Deliver high-impact workshops, solution walkthroughs, and value-aligned presentations for stakeholders across IT, supply chain, and business functions

  • Translate solution strategies into implementation scopes in collaboration with the Services team
  • Stay informed on industry trends, ERP ecosystems (e.g., SAP), and surrounding supply chain platforms (e.g., TMS, P2P, order automation, planning) to influence solution design and product feedback loops

What You’ll Need

  • 10–15+ years of experience in presales, solution consulting, or business analysis for enterprise supply chain or SaaS platforms
  • Proven expertise in at least one area: procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, or transportation/logistics with broad understanding of end-to-end supply chain operations
  • Strong familiarity with ERP systems (especially SAP) and complementary supply chain software such as Blue Yonder, Coupa, Esker, Conexiom, Oracle, or Kinaxis
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage senior business and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to lead strategic client conversations, facilitate discovery, and shape solution roadmaps
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and comfortable in an individual contributor role with cross-functional influence
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related discipline

Who We Are

Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually.

It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Using best practices in these areas, all Elemica employees will observe a ‘security first’ approach to their daily responsibilities. All employees are accountable for securing their work devices, work areas, and communications in the execution of their daily duties.

Role Title: Principal Engineer / Professor — Technical Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay:$80- $185/hour

Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: Master’s or PhD in an engineering or physical science field, plus principal-level industry experience or a faculty appointment

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

micro1 is engaging principal-level engineers, scientists, and faculty to design the technical problems that measure what AI systems can actually do. Your domain expertise is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

We’re building this across four areas: aerospace, semiconductors, manufacturing and industrial engineering, and materials science. If your work sits in one of those — or across two of them — this is for you.

The work draws on what you already know: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong.

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area, with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in engineering, physics, materials, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major engineering organization, a national lab, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one area, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another expert could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.

How the selection process works

  2. Complete the AI interview for this role
  3. Profile review

About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

jobs.description:
Earn placements in the publications that already know you

We are hiring a Digital PR Manager who can get Single Grain and our clients placed in 20–30+ business, AI, and marketing publications every month. You should already have working relationships with those outlets — been there, done that. This is not a seat to learn digital PR from zero.

Include “AI-first PR is cool” in the subject line. Otherwise, your application will be disqualified.

About Single Grain

Single Grain is a revenue marketing agency. We build pipeline-focused systems that compound, not campaigns that expire. We have helped more than 500 companies, from venture-backed startups to the Fortune 500, drive measurable growth.

We operate as an AI-native team. Every role uses AI to improve speed, quality, judgment, and leverage. AI output still requires source control, brand accuracy, and human judgment — especially with journalists.

Your mission

Activate an existing media graph to earn 20–30+ placements per month in business, AI, and marketing publications through a repeatable, AI-assisted pitching system — publication quality and relationships intact.

Primary KPI: monthly placement count in approved publication tiers. Compensation is DOE.

What you will own

  • Bring and expand a warm list of business, AI, and marketing publications and journalists you can already reach.
  • Package founder and client stories into pitchable angles with evidence, quotes, and assets.
  • Run personalized outreach at volume without spam — track opens, replies, and placement conversion.
  • Use AI to research, draft, personalize, and follow up; keep voice, facts, and relationships human-owned.
  • Coordinate with SEO/AEO, content, and client teams so placements reinforce organic and answer-engine goals.
  • Report weekly: pitches sent, reply rate, placements landed, publication tier mix, and blockers.
  • Document the system so another operator can run and improve it.

What success looks like

  • 30 days: Warm contact list live; AI pitch workflow live; first placements from existing relationships; baseline measured.
  • 60 days: On pace toward 20+/month with a defendable tier mix.
  • 90 days: Sustained 20–30+ placements/month; system documented.

Evidence we need to see

  • Existing relationships with business, AI, and/or marketing publications.
  • Two recent placements with links and your exact ownership.
  • One quantified monthly or campaign placement result.
  • A concrete AI-assisted pitching workflow with QA and what stays human.
  • Judgment on publication tier — not spray-and-pray.

This role is not

  • A first digital-PR job or cold-only outreach seat.
  • Social-only / wire blast / AM-only / AI spam.

Work model and compensation

Fully remote, full-time. Compensation is DOE (depends on experience).

Subject line must include “AI-first PR is cool”.
