jobs.description:
Description

Ledgebrook is an AI-native specialty insurance platform. When a business needs coverage that is custom and complex, its broker comes to us, and our underwriters give them an answer, often in hours rather than weeks.

We built our technology from scratch, with AI in it from the first line of code. The technology helps price the risk; the underwriter uses their judgment to decide. There are always two hands on the wheel. We are insurance industry insiders, and we eat our own cooking: Ledgebrook writes the policy and shares the risk through our own carrier, Ledgebrook Specialty, rated A- (Excellent) by AM Best. We work exclusively through wholesale brokers.

Our vision: to make the wheels of insurance spin faster.

At Ledgebrook, everything we do is driven by our culture: Care, Strive, Thrive Together. To succeed in modernizing the industry, we must first succeed in changing the way we do business. Talent density is our north star—fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages—we play as a team, we win as a team. Everyone benefits handsomely from Ledgebrook’s success.

About the Role

Ledgebrook is seeking experienced E&S Underwriting Assistant who has experience supporting General Liability lines talent to join our growing team, whose mission is to build a profitable book of E&S business across expanding lines of business and coverages. Ledgebrook’s vision is to deliver market-relevant solutions to our key wholesale trading partners in a more frictionless environment that places an emphasis on efficiencies and quality to meet or exceed our broker’s overall needs in a risk-differentiated manner. If you possess an entrepreneurial passion with a proven track history of delivering high-quality underwriting support and seek an opportunity to break out of the traditional insurance company mold, we’re looking for you!

As a member of the Ledgebrook Underwriting Support team, you will regularly interact with Ledgebrook’s underwriters and wholesale trading partners over the phone, virtually, or in-person to facilitate various transactions independently or with limited guidance. We are looking for candidates with a strong overall E&S support background across various lines of business, including a curiosity to gain a deeper knowledge of our business.

We currently operate in a fully remote work environment, so we’re more focused on your experience and cultural fit than where you physically sit!

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame—you immediately focus on how to fix it.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements

As a future Ledgebrook E&S Underwriting Assistant, your experience and qualifications should include:

  • Prior E&S underwriting support experience across the General Liability/Casualty lines of business and coverages
  • Experience in submission process management, including review for completeness to handle or facilitate account clearance and set-up.
  • Understanding of basic underwriting data analysis to execute submission triage activities, i.e. review submission information in relation to underwriting appetite and guidelines to assist underwriting staff with eligibility determination and prioritization of opportunities.
  • Ability to obtain required information from brokers, organizing/maintaining file documentation and facilitating transactions with other underwriting support resources.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple tasks/projects to focus on key priorities and deadline achievement.
  • Understanding of company appetites and delegated underwriting authorities.

Benefits

US Benefits

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture.
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options.
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage.

For Candidates Applying From The U.S.:

Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

Ledgebrook may use Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) as part of the job application process, including to assist us in evaluating your application. AI is used as a support tool, and hiring decisions are made by human recruiters. By submitting your information, you acknowledge that the company may use AI tools as part of our evaluation. If you need a reasonable accommodation or alternative review process because of a disability or other legally protected basis, contact . Requesting an accommodation will not negatively affect your application.

Compensation

  • The base salary range for this position is [$65,000 - $85,000 USD] This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location.

jobs.excerpt: About CogstateAt Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
jobs.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- BAYLEY and VABS Administration Experience
- English Fluency Required
-PST Location Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent
  • ≥25 administrations of study scales or similar semi-structured clinical interviews
  • Experience working with pediatric populations with neurodevelopmental delays
    • Rare disease experience is a plus, including Angelman syndrome, Phelan-McDermid syndrome, Fragile X syndrome, or similar disorders
  • BAYLEY administration experience
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment, including experience working with pediatric populations and caregivers
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • English Fluency

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

jobs.description:
What are we looking for?

We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer for weekend coverage (Thursday to Monday) to help our top customers successfully build and scale their apps.

What will you do?

  • Help resolve issues with customer apps: Our customers are non-technical. When Hercules' AI agent fails them, they are stuck. Your job is to help fully resolve issues for customers in the app whether it is fixing bugs, advising on architecture, helping with integrations and more

  • Improve our product/platform: Every time we fix a customer app, you will update our underlying platform or AI agent to make sure the issue never happens again

  • Maintain our knowledge base: Keep our public and internal documents up to date, including any known issues

  • Build automations: Automate your support workflow so you can theoretically help hundreds of customers a day

  • Help handle/resolve platform incidents: Be the first point of call for platform incidents during your working hours. Manage public status and customer communication.

What skills will you have?

  • Strong TypeScript and React background

  • Modern web app fundamentals (HTTP, APIs, auth, databases)

  • Proven ability to debug production issues (logs, traces, repros, minimal test cases)

  • Strong systems/architecture thinking (scalability, reliability, performance, security basics)

  • Excellent written communication (clear, simple, concise, audience specific)

  • Prior experience working in a customer facing role (sales, pre-sales, customer support, etc)

  • A track record closing 50+ tickets a day

What timezone will you work?

This role is specifically for people living in Europe, the middle east, or Africa and/or willing to work GMT+2 hours. This is a weekend coverage role: you'll work Thursday through Monday, including Saturday and Sunday, with Tuesday and Wednesday off. Please apply to our other Technical Customer Support Engineer roles if you're looking for a Monday to Friday schedule.

What’s Hercules’ stack?

  • Technologies: TypeScript, React, AI SDK, Postgres, Redis, Clickhouse, Tailwind, IaC (CDK, Terraform), Docker, Otel, Hono, Drizzle ORM, Temporal

  • Clouds: Cloudflare, AWS

  • AI Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google

Will you always be a technical support engineer?

You are welcome to stay as a technical support engineer for as long as you'd like. However, we are open to working with you to transition you to a full time software engineering, pre-sales, or post-sales engineering role after 6-12 months.

What are Hercules’ operating principles?

Hercules’ operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of the principles can be learned on the job, however, we do specifically filter for the following principles in our hiring process:

  1. We ship. We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds up our learning and delights our customers.

  2. We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We’re proud of our work.

  3. We are hungry. We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done.

Is Hercules in-office or remote?

Hercules founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates who are willing to 1) work in US time zones and 2) travel to the office regularly.

What are Hercules’ benefits?

  • Unlimited AI token budget

  • Take what you need vacation policy

  • Healthcare, vision, and dental

  • Daily lunches, dinners and snacks in the office

  • We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here

What’s the compensation?

$60k-$120k + equity (variable based on seniority, equity, and location)

SEO Specialist / Digital Marketing Specialist

Location: Remote (Preferred U.S.-Based)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Company:Performacentric

About Performacentric

Performacentric helps small and mid-market organizations improve profitability, efficiency, employee performance, customer satisfaction, and business visibility through custom AI agents, automation, and intelligent business solutions. Our mission is to help organizations eliminate manual processes, connect disconnected systems, and make better decisions through AI-powered business transformation.

We are seeking an SEO Specialist / Digital Marketing Specialist who can drive organic growth, improve search visibility, and execute modern digital marketing initiatives that generate qualified leads and measurable business outcomes.

Position Overview

The SEO Specialist / Digital Marketing Specialist will be responsible for developing and executing Performacentric's search engine optimization, answer engine optimization, and AI-driven search visibility strategies. This individual will play a critical role in increasing website traffic, improving search rankings, generating qualified leads, and strengthening Performacentric's digital presence.

The ideal candidate understands that modern search extends beyond traditional SEO and includes AI search experiences, large language models, answer engines, and emerging search technologies. They are analytical, technically proficient, and capable of translating data into actionable marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

  • Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies.
  • Conduct keyword research and search intent analysis.
  • Perform on-page optimization for website pages, landing pages, blogs, and resource content.
  • Manage technical SEO initiatives including:
    • Site architecture
    • Internal linking
    • Crawlability
    • Indexation
    • Schema markup
    • Core Web Vitals
  • Conduct competitor and market analysis.
  • Monitor search rankings and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Improve organic traffic, domain authority, and search visibility.

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

  • Optimize content for AI-generated search results and answer engines.
  • Develop content structures that improve visibility within AI-powered search experiences.
  • Implement schema and structured data strategies that enhance machine readability.
  • Improve content discoverability across emerging search platforms.
  • Analyze AI search trends and recommend optimization opportunities.

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AGO)

  • Develop strategies that increase visibility within generative AI platforms and large language models.
  • Optimize content for AI citation and retrieval.
  • Create content frameworks that improve AI comprehension and relevance.
  • Monitor emerging AI search technologies and adapt optimization strategies accordingly.
  • Support Performacentric's thought leadership initiatives through AI-optimized content development.

Digital Marketing

  • Develop and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns.
  • Support lead generation initiatives across multiple channels.
  • Collaborate with content creators on:
    • Blog articles
    • White papers
    • Datasheets
    • Case studies
    • Website content
  • Optimize landing pages for conversion.
  • Assist with email marketing initiatives.
  • Measure and report campaign performance.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Track and report on:
    • Organic traffic
    • Keyword rankings
    • Lead generation
    • Conversion rates
    • Engagement metrics
    • Search visibility
  • Build dashboards and performance reports.
  • Provide recommendations based on data analysis.
  • Present findings and optimization opportunities to leadership.

Required Qualifications

Search & Marketing Expertise

  • 3+ years of experience in SEO, digital marketing, content marketing, or related roles.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • SEO
    • AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
    • GEO/AGO (Generative Engine Optimization)
    • Content marketing
    • Digital marketing strategy
  • Experience conducting keyword research and competitive analysis.
  • Understanding of search ranking factors and technical SEO principles.
  • Familiarity with search algorithm updates and industry trends.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • Website architecture
    • Structured data/schema markup
  • Ability to identify and communicate technical SEO issues.
  • Experience with website analytics and reporting tools.
  • Understanding of website performance optimization principles.

Content & Communication

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with content creators, designers, and developers.
  • Experience creating SEO-focused content strategies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

  • SERanking
  • Google Search Console
  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Schema implementation
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • AI content optimization platforms
  • B2B SaaS marketing
  • AI and machine learning technologies

Desired Traits

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Curious and data-driven
  • Results-oriented
  • Analytical and strategic
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Passionate about emerging AI technologies
  • Continuously learning and staying ahead of industry trends
  • Able to balance technical optimization with business objectives

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Organic traffic growth
  • Qualified lead generation
  • Search ranking improvements
  • AI search visibility improvements
  • Website conversion rates
  • Content performance metrics
  • Domain authority growth
  • Marketing campaign performance

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Implement quick-win technical and content improvements.
  • Establish performance dashboards and reporting processes.

How to Apply

  • Case studies demonstrating measurable results
  • Certifications (if applicable)

Join Performacentric and help shape the future of AI-powered business transformation by building a search and marketing engine that drives measurable growth.

jobs.description:
Marketing Lead

Role type: 1099 independent contractor, full time Location: Fully remote, LATAM

About First Principles

First Principles is a product consultancy founded by startup and enterprise product leaders. Our focus is AI-first product management training. We help enterprise product and technology teams put AI to work in the jobs they already do, responsibly and productively. Almost every large company is trying to solve this problem right now.

Our programs are customizable, not custom. Clients choose from a catalog of practitioner-led classes across AI foundations, AI-first product management, and building AI products. We shape the program around their budget, goals, timeline, approved tools, and governance rules. A program can be a few focused sessions or a full 12 to 16 week certification. It can run virtually, on-site, or as a mix of both, for cohorts ranging from dozens of people to a couple hundred.

So far we have run three cohorts for Elsevier Health and a product and design focused program for another enterprise client. We also just launched a hybrid program with a national healthcare company. Healthcare is where we started, not where we plan to stop.

The Role

You will be our first dedicated marketer, and you will own marketing for the training business from strategy through execution.

The job starts with making us look like the firm we actually are. That means a website, materials, and proof that hold up in front of senior enterprise buyers. From there, you build a top of funnel that gives our sales team real conversations to work with. You keep a steady rhythm going, measure what works, and cut what does not.

We want a brand that stands on the firm itself, not on any single person's voice. That brand rests on three things: our client results, our program, and the many practitioners who design and teach it.

We teach AI-first product work, so our marketing has to show that we practice it. We expect you to use AI heavily to research, produce, and adapt content, and to keep messaging consistent across channels. But our website, content, and strategy cannot read like AI slop. AI can do a lot of the heavy lifting on production. You make the calls on the story, the positioning, and what ships.

This is not a role where someone hands you a plan. You tell us what success looks like, how you will get there, and then you get it done.

Responsibilities

Website. Own our website end to end. It is a modern code-based site, not a drag-and-drop builder, and you will maintain it yourself using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. Your first big project is to:

  • pivot the site to be training-first
  • bring it up to date with how our programs work now: flexible length; virtual, on-site, or hybrid delivery; and the "customizable, not custom" framing
  • own conversion paths, forms, page speed, SEO basics, and analytics

Positioning and packaging. Work with the people who design and deliver our programs to turn a broad catalog into a few clear program shapes that are easy to describe, compare, and buy. Then write the language that goes with them.

Proof. Build a library of case studies, outcome data, and testimonials from the programs we run, within what our client agreements allow. Proof is our strongest marketing asset, and today we have published far less of it than we have earned.

Sales enablement and lead magnets. Partner with sales on the materials they use and the offers that start conversations. That includes the pitch deck, one-pagers, sample curricula, proposal templates, and lead magnets that give a product leader something genuinely useful. Sales brings what buyers are asking for. You bring the craft to make it sharp.

Channel mix. Define which channels we invest in and why, then execute. Shift the mix as the data comes in.

Measurement. Own our signal metrics, such as website traffic, engagement, followers, email list growth, inbound leads, and meetings sourced. Share a short weekly report. Run small, fast experiments and tell us plainly what is and is not working.

Budget. Own a monthly budget in the four to low five figures for tools, ads, materials, events, and outside specialists when you truly need them. Within that budget, you decide how to spend it. You do not need sign-off on every line item.

Partnership with sales. Work side by side with sales on target accounts, campaigns, follow-up, and messaging. They will tell you what they hear from buyers, and you will turn that into material that helps them close.

Know the space. Build and keep current your understanding of three things:

  • how product teams work
  • how AI is changing their work
  • where enterprises are getting stuck on AI adoption

Our team will help you get up to speed.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

A marketer who builds and ships. Five or more years in B2B marketing. That includes time as a first or only marketer, or on a small team where you owned both strategy and execution. You have marketed high-consideration services or software to enterprise buyers.

An excellent writer with taste. You write clearly, cut filler, and can tell when something sounds generic. Please come ready to share strong marketing writing you have produced.

Hands-on with AI tools, including coding agents. You are comfortable using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools to make real changes to a website. You use AI across your work to move faster on research and production. You also know where AI makes the work worse, and you catch it.

Comfortable with measurement. You can set up analytics, tracking links, and a basic CRM pipeline, and you can build a simple dashboard that shows whether something is working.

Self-directed. There is no marketing manager above you. Experienced product leaders on our team will give you context, feedback, and hands-on support. But you set the plan and drive it.

Understands enterprise buyers. Our buyers are senior product and technology leaders at large companies, and they expect polish as a baseline. As a small firm, we need to be noticeably better than that baseline to stand out.

Near-native English, C2 minimum. Written and spoken. Senior US enterprise leaders will read everything you produce.

Available for US-aligned hours. You need consistent overlap with US business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Marketing experience in professional education, corporate training, learning and development, or consulting
  • Familiarity with how product management and software teams work
  • Design skills (Figma or similar) and basic video editing
  • Account-based marketing experience
  • Experience with modern static site frameworks such as Astro, Next.js, or similar
  • Experience marketing to healthcare or other regulated industries

Benefits

Compensation and Logistics

  • Engagement type: 1099 contractor

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect (Databricks)
jobs.excerpt: Company overview:Blue Orange Digital is a data engineering and AI consultancy that builds production-grade data platforms, ML systems, and analytics solutions for companies that take their data seriously.
jobs.description:
Company overview:

Blue Orange Digital is a data engineering and AI consultancy that builds production-grade data platforms, ML systems, and analytics solutions for companies that take their data seriously. We are not a staff augmentation shop or a slide-deck consultancy. We are builders. Our teams embed directly into client engineering organizations, shipping code alongside their engineers to accelerate delivery and build lasting capability.

Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises and high-growth startups across industries. We partner with Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, GCP, and Azure to deliver battle-tested solutions that drive measurable ROI.

About the Role

We are hiring the person who owns Databricks at Blue Orange Digital. Not a portion of it. All of it.

This role sits at the intersection of three things most companies split across three people. You architect the solution in the room with the prospect, you lead the build on the accounts that matter most, and you own the relationship with Databricks itself. That combination is deliberate. Clients buy from the architect who will actually be on their engagement, and Databricks field teams co-sell with partners whose technical leads they trust. One person carrying all three closes the gap between what we promise in the sales cycle and what we ship in production.

Day to day, you sit in discovery calls and technical deep-dives translating messy business problems into Lakehouse architectures that hold up under scrutiny. You write the architecture sections of our proposals and defend them to client CTOs and platform teams. When a deal closes on a major account, you stay on it as lead architect through design and into production, then hand off a system the client’s team can run without us.

The partnership half of the job puts you in front of Databricks account executives, solutions architects, and partner managers across regions. You build the co-sell motion, drive our tier and specialization roadmap, and make Blue Orange Digital the partner Databricks reps call first when an account needs implementation help. You will also raise the Databricks bar across our engineering org through internal enablement, certification paths, and reusable architecture patterns.

You will report to our Head of Delivery and work directly with the CEO and Head of Sales on partnership strategy. This is a senior seat with real authority over a growing part of the business.

What You Will Do

Pre-Sales Solutions Architecture

  • Lead technical discovery on Databricks opportunities, running architecture sessions with client engineering and data leadership

  • Design Lakehouse reference architectures covering Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, workflow orchestration, and Mosaic AI, sized to the client’s data volume, governance posture, and cost constraints

  • Own the technical content in proposals and SOWs, including architecture diagrams, migration approach, team composition, and effort estimates

  • Run proof-of-concept builds and technical bake-offs that demonstrate working code, not slideware

  • Serve as the technical authority in competitive evaluations against Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and in-house Spark platforms, presenting trade-offs honestly rather than selling past the truth

  • Partner with Sales on qualification, flagging deals where Databricks is the wrong answer before we invest in a proposal

Delivery Leadership on Key Accounts

  • Act as lead architect on our largest Databricks engagements, staying accountable from kickoff through production handoff

  • Set the technical direction for engagement teams of three to six engineers, reviewing designs and code against Blue Orange Digital delivery standards

  • Resolve the hard problems: Spark performance tuning, Delta Lake optimization, Unity Catalog migration and governance design, cost runaway, and streaming architectures under real SLAs

  • Drive knowledge transfer so client teams operate what we build independently after handoff

  • Own escalations on strategic accounts and keep executive stakeholders informed with direct, unvarnished status

Databricks Channel Partnership Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical relationship owner with Databricks field, partner, and product teams

  • Build and run the co-sell motion, generating partner-sourced pipeline and supporting Databricks-sourced opportunities end to end

  • Drive our partner tier advancement and Brickbuilder specialization roadmap, including the certification coverage and validated customer references each level requires

  • Represent Blue Orange Digital at Data + AI Summit, partner enablement sessions, and regional Databricks events

  • Produce technical marketing that earns credibility with the Databricks field: reference architectures, benchmarks, case studies, and conference talks

  • Build internal enablement so our engineers reach and maintain Databricks certification, and so every engagement team starts from proven patterns instead of a blank page

What You Bring

  • Eight or more years in data engineering, data architecture, or platform engineering, with at least four years architecting on Databricks in production environments

  • Solutions Architect level depth on the Databricks platform. You can whiteboard a multi-workspace Unity Catalog governance model, explain when Photon earns its cost, diagnose a skewed join from a Spark UI screenshot, and reason about Delta Lake file layout and liquid clustering under real workloads

  • Hands-on command of Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, Delta Live Tables, MLflow, and Mosaic AI, plus fluency in at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and infrastructure as code

  • Demonstrated pre-sales experience. You have led technical discovery, authored proposal architecture, and won deals against credible competition

  • Delivery track record on enterprise engagements, including at least one large-scale migration to Databricks from a legacy warehouse, Hadoop, or a homegrown Spark platform

  • Executive communication skills. You hold your own with a CTO on strategy in one meeting and pair with a platform engineer on a notebook in the next

  • Experience working with or inside a technology partner ecosystem, whether at a consultancy, an SI, or a cloud or data platform vendor

  • Willingness to travel roughly 25 percent for client work, partner meetings, and industry events

Nice to Haves

  • Databricks Solutions Architect Champion accreditation, or the Data Engineer Professional, ML Engineer Professional, or Platform Architect certifications

  • Prior experience at Databricks, or at a Gold or Platinum tier Databricks consulting partner

  • Track record building a partner practice from early stage to a named tier or specialization

  • Production GenAI and agent work on Databricks, including RAG systems, Vector Search, Model Serving, and agent evaluation

  • Snowflake depth alongside Databricks, so you can advise clients running both platforms

  • Public technical presence: conference talks, published reference architectures, open source contributions, or a following in the Databricks community

  • Vertical depth in PE, financial services, healthcare, retail, or manufacturing

How We Measure Success

  • First 90 days: Ramped on our active Databricks engagements, introduced to the Databricks partner team, leading technical discovery on live opportunities

  • First 6 months: Owning the architecture on our largest Databricks account, running a defined co-sell motion, internal certification program underway

  • First 12 months: Measurable partner-sourced pipeline, a documented advance on tier or specialization, and a Databricks practice that scales past any single person

Compensation

Base salary plus a partnership performance bonus tied to Databricks-sourced pipeline and closed revenue. We benchmark Principal-level architect compensation against the top of the consulting market and pay for the credential, not the title.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base plus a bonus directly tied to the partnership you build

  • Full ownership of a growing practice, with executive support and no layers between you and the decision-makers

  • Work on production Databricks problems at real enterprise scale, across industries

  • Builder culture where engineers lead and ship, and where architecture decisions are made by people who write code

  • Professional development budget with certification support, conference attendance, and speaking opportunities

  • Flexible remote work environment

  • Collaborative team that values production-grade craftsmanship over billable theater

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • Paid parental/bereavement leave

Background checks may be required for certain positions/projects.

Blue Orange Digital is an equal-opportunity employer.

JOB TITLE: Coder - Outpatient

SUMMARY

Review clinical documentation and diagnostic results to extract data and apply appropriate ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes for billing, internal and external reporting, research, and regulatory compliance. Demonstrate knowledge of reimbursement methodologies and apply these to assigned charts to optimize reimbursement and/or resolve regulatory edits. Resolve error reports associated with the billing process, identify and report error patterns, and, when necessary, assist in the design and implementation of workflow changes to reduce billing errors.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), adheres to official coding guidelines, and keeps abreast of coding changes and interpretation of codes.
  • Performs detailed review of Inpatient record documentation to identify & assign diagnosis & procedure codes using ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS.
  • Meets established departmental productivity guidelines with 95% accuracy on a consistent basis.
  • Utilizes Care Connect, UDS, and Clintegrity systems proficiently to obtain ICD10 codes and DRG assignment.
  • Formulates compliant Physician Coding Queries when documentation is inadequate, ambiguous, or unclear for coding purposes.
  • Corrects failed claim errors to billing edits, accounts misclassified and/or other errors identified through various auditing processes in a timely manner.
  • Provide assistance to customers (physicians, clinical quality staff) regarding clinical documentation opportunities, coding reimbursement issues, and quality improvement review process.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • One of the following certifications is required: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist - Physician Based (CCS-P), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Professional Coder Hospital Based (CPC-H), Certified Medical Coder (CMC), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), Certified Professional Coder Apprentice CPC-A, or a specialty coding certification.
  • Candidates with an Associate degree from an accredited American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) are required to sit for the Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) exam within 1 year of hire.
  • At least 2 years of progressive coding experience in a hospital or multi-specialty physician practice setting preferred.
  • Full CPC certification must be obtained within 24 months if employee holds CPC-A from the American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC) at time of hire.
  • For HOMECARE: Homecare Diagnosis Coding Specialist (HCS-D) certification required within 16 months of hire.

Grandfather Clause: If hired on or before September 30, 2018, 2 years of relevant work experience and one of the following coding certification credentials: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist - Physician Based (CCS-P), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Professional Coder - Hospital Based (CPC-H), Certified Medical Coder (CMC), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), or a specialty coding certification and Associate’s degree in Health Information Management are required.

EDUCATION:

AS: Health Information Management (Required)

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

For disease specific care programs refer to the program specific requirements of the department for further specifications on experience and educational expectations, including continuing education requirements.

IT Operations & Employee Support

Systems Administration & Identity Management

IT Infrastructure & Scalability

Security & Risk Management

  • Implement and maintain practical security controls across endpoints, accounts, applications, and company systems.

  • Help develop and maintain business continuity, backup, recovery, and technology resilience practices.
  • Support security and compliance readiness appropriate to an aerospace and defense environment.

SaaS & Business Systems Administration

Vendor & Technology Management

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical issues across hardware, software, networking, accounts, and applications.
  • Experience documenting systems, establishing repeatable procedures, and improving immature or highly manual IT processes.
  • Strong vendor-management and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to support employees with varying levels of technical proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or scaling the IT function within a startup, growth-stage company, or similarly dynamic environment.

Personal Attributes

Solution Engineering:

  • You will develop, test, and deploy production-ready AI applications that integrate graph databases with LLMs and orchestration frameworks. This involves writing production-level code, optimizing for performance and scalability, and ensuring seamless integration with customer systems.

Education & Enablement:

  • You will work with other teams at Neo4j (Product and Marketing) to influence the roadmap and provide insights from the field, and package approaches, best practices, and lessons learned into thought leadership, methodologies, and published assets.

Required Qualifications:

  • Enterprise Application Architecture: 10+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise-grade applications, with a deep understanding of the full software development lifecycle and the ability to guide teams through complex design and implementation decisions.
  • LLM Proficiency: 5+ years of Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and integrating LLMs into applications. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of different LLM providers and their strengths and limitations, as well as open-source ones).

Hands-on experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Hive) and database systems (SQL and NoSQL)
  • Graph Database Authority: Deep expertise in graph data modeling and query languages (e.g., Cypher), along with practical experience working with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph) or triple stores (e.g., Ontotext, Stardog), enabling advanced knowledge graph applications
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills: Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and align technical decisions with business goals.

jobs.excerpt: Royal Voluntary Servicehas an opportunity available for aCommercial Finance Managerto join our team, working remotely from within the UK.
jobs.description:
Royal Voluntary Servicehas an opportunity available for aCommercial Finance Managerto join our team, working remotely from within the UK.You will join us on a Full-time, Permanent basis, and in return, you will receive a salary up to£58,215 per annum, dependant upon experience.

Royal Voluntary Service mobilises volunteers to build a stronger, more connected Britain. We believe in volunteering for all and work to grow participation across all backgrounds, ages and abilities.

Our volunteer-powered services provide practical help and human connection to people who need it most. GoVo, our digital volunteering platform, helps people find causes they care about and supports charities across the country.

About the Commercial Finance Manager role:

The Commercial Finance Manager is responsible for leading Royal Voluntary Service's (RVS) commercial finance, investment appraisal and business partnering activities, ensuring that strategic investment decisions are underpinned by robust financial analysis and deliver maximum value for the organisation.

Reporting to the Head of Finance Business Partnering, the role provides commercial finance leadership across the organisation, partnering closely with Executive Directors and operational leaders to improve financial performance, strengthen investment decision-making and maximise return on investment.

The role will lead Finance Business Partnering for Retail whilst also acting as the organisation's centre of excellence for investment appraisal, pricing strategy, treasury optimisation and commercial financial modelling.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong commercial acumen, analytical capability and the ability to influence strategic decisions across the organisation.

Hours:35 hours a week, Monday to Friday
Location: Home based within the UK, with occasional national travel

What you'll bring as our Commercial Finance Manager:

We are looking for someone who combines strong commercial finance expertise with excellent business partnering skills.

  • Outstanding commercial acumen.
  • Strong financial modelling capability.
  • Excellent influencing skills.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong analytical capability.
  • A collaborative approach.
  • Commercial curiosity.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively.
  • A focus on value creation and return on investment.

This is what you'll be doing:


Commercial Business Partnering
  • Partner with Executive Directors and senior leaders to improve financial performance across their portfolios.
  • Provide commercial insight and challenge to support strategic decision-making.
  • Develop trusted relationships with operational leaders.
  • Drive financial accountability across the organisation.

Investment Appraisal
  • Lead the development and review of investment business cases across RVS.
  • Establish consistent investment appraisal methodologies and financial hurdle rates.
  • Review and challenge business case assumptions.
  • Support the formal Finance approval for investment business cases before governance approval.
  • Monitor post-investment performance through structured benefits realisation reviews.

Retail Finance Business Partnering
  • Act as Finance Business Partner for the Retail portfolio.
  • Analyse site profitability and commercial performance.
  • Support investment decisions for new stores and refurbishments.
  • Develop portfolio performance metrics including gross profit, net profit and ROI.
  • Establish structured monthly performance reviews for underperforming sites.
  • Support turnaround planning and commercial improvement initiatives.

Pricing and Commercial Strategy
  • Develop pricing methodologies across commercial activities.
  • Ensure pricing reflects organisational objectives, cost recovery and market conditions.
  • Review pricing models regularly to maximise value and sustainability.
  • Support commercial contract negotiations.

Sales Enablement
  • Provide commercial financial support to sales activity.
  • Develop financial models supporting bids and proposals.
  • Analyse customer profitability.
  • Support commercial negotiations with financial insight.
  • Develop sales dashboards and commercial KPIs.

Treasury and Cash Management
  • Support the CFO in treasury management and cash investment strategy.
  • Analyse cash flows and investment opportunities.
  • Review banking arrangements and investment returns.
  • Provide recommendations to maximise return whilst managing risk.

Financial Modelling
  • Develop financial models supporting strategic decisions.
  • Undertake scenario analysis and sensitivity modelling.
  • Support long-term financial planning.
  • Develop commercial forecasting models.

Performance Improvement
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability and financial sustainability.
  • Review commercial performance across income-generating activities.
  • Analyse return on investment.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives.

This is how you'll be doing it:

Equity, Diversity and InclusionSets a positive example through inclusive behaviours in all interactions. Values diverse perspectives and experiences, promotes equity, diversity, and inclusion, and contributes to a culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to thrive. Actively supports our commitment to reflecting the diversity of the communities we exist for.

Environment and Sustainability
Sets a positive example through environmentally responsible behaviours in day-to-day activities. Supports actions that reduce environmental impact, use resources responsibly and contribute to a more sustainable RVS. Actively supports Royal Voluntary Service's commitment to continuously improving environmental performance.

Analysing Information
Enjoys analysing data and seeks to identify and explores the key elements in information before making rational judgements and commitments. Utilises facts and figures when planning and reporting and is concerned about accuracy and detail.

Strategic Awareness
Maintains a strong awareness of long-term goals and plans, keeping the future eventualities and possibilities in mind. Is likely to make impact on future direction and outcomes by seeing the bigger picture.

Commercial Awareness
Likes to work with facts and figures to evaluate things properly. Uses commercial and financial factors when making decisions. Looks at the wider implications and is likely to try to assess the long-term impact.

Planning and Organising
Thinks things through well in advance and maps out future activities and resources, taking the key stages, requirements, and timescales into account. Likes to monitor to ensure that things are implemented and delivered effectively.

Decision Making
Generates and promotes solutions. Sees clearly which is the best way forward and makes decisions and commitments within appropriate time frames. Influences others to reach conclusions and gain agreements.

Networking
Is able to relate to people and build effective relationships. Likes talking things over with others and works well in an environment of mutual support and information sharing. Is not afraid to direct people or ask for their help.

Persuading Others
Works with others in a convincing way that leads to gaining agreement. Is prepared to negotiate to get what they want. Persevering in the face of opinions that differ from their own. Upbeat and motivational in style.

This is what we're looking for:


Knowledge
  • Investment appraisal methodologies.
  • Discounted cash flow and NPV analysis.
  • Pricing strategy.
  • Commercial finance.
  • Treasury management.
  • Financial modelling.
  • Business partnering.
  • Performance management.
  • Sales and commercial finance.
  • Financial planning and forecasting.

Skills
  • Commercial analysis.
  • Financial modelling.
  • Investment appraisal.
  • Business partnering.
  • Pricing analysis.
  • Presentation and influencing.
  • Commercial negotiation support.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Problem solving.
  • Data analysis.

Experience
  • Professionally qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
  • Significant experience in commercial finance or finance business partnering.
  • Experience developing investment business cases.
  • Experience supporting commercial decision-making.
  • Experience in pricing and financial modelling.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience driving commercial performance improvements.
  • Experience supporting strategic projects.
  • Charity or commercial sector experience would be advantageous but is not essential.

This is all the other great stuff you'll be getting:


  • A salary up to £58,215 per annum, dependant upon experience
  • 26 days’ holiday (pro rata) plus paid statutory Bank Holidays (pro rata)
  • Up to 2 days paid volunteer leave a year, through our employer supported volunteer scheme
  • Ten weeks’ company sick pay following successful completion of probation
  • A great pension scheme
  • 2 x Salary Death in Service Benefit, subject to qualification
  • Enhanced Family Leave schemes
  • An employee benefits package that gives access to an exclusive rewards website to get discounts and cashback online
  • A 24-hour doctor line, financial support with dental/optical and other therapies
  • A free and confidential employee assistance programme with up to six face-to-face counselling sessions included
  • Extensive online and on the job training to ensure you will succeed in your role
  • Opportunities to discuss flexible working
  • Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
  • The chance to make a positive, lasting impact that changes lives, communities and society
If you feel have the skills and experience to become our Commercial Finance Managerplease click ‘apply’ today, we’d love to hear from you!

The closing date for this role is25 November2026.However, we reserve the right to close this vacancy early should sufficient applications be received.

Please do not delay your application we often get a lot!

Join the Team Modernizing Medicine

At ModMed, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: we hired doctors and taught them how to code. This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

A Culture of Excellence

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

  • Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work

  • 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”

  • 2025 Black Book Awards: Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties

  • Florida Venture Forum: Venture-Backed Company of the Year

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

Ready to modernize medicine with us?

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Director, CS Enablement & Strategy is responsible for defining and driving the strategic vision, operational execution, and digital transformation of ModMed’s Customer Success Shared Services organization. This leader oversees four core functional pillars: CS Transformation & Operating Model Design, CS Technology & AI/Automation, Internal Enablement & Workforce Readiness, and the CS PMO.

In this role, the Senior Director will architect scalable customer operating models, govern enterprise CS technology platforms (e.g., Gainsight, SFDC, Genesys, WalkMe, LMS), and drive AI/automation adoption across the entire customer lifecycle. Additionally, the Senior Director leads through influence across executive partners in Product, Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Marketing to align digital experience (DX) requirements, accelerate product launch delivery, and ensure total organizational readiness.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Operating Model Transformation & Service Innovation:Lead end-to-end customer operating model redesigns, workflow optimization, service innovation, process excellence, and M&A operational integrations across all Customer Success business units.

  • Technology Stack & AI Strategy:Direct enterprise CS tech stack governance and multi-year roadmap (Gainsight, SFDC, Genesys, WalkMe, LMS); pioneer AI, LLM, agent assist, predictive analytics, and RPA solutions to drive operational efficiency and support deflection.

  • PMO Governance & Program Delivery:Oversee the CS PMO to enforce disciplined program governance, resource coordination, release/product launch delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives across cross-functional projects.

  • Internal Enablement & Workforce Readiness:Direct internal learning & development strategies, new hire onboarding, release & role readiness, leadership enablement, and enterprise change management communications to empower CS teams.

  • Cross-Functional Executive Leadership:Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Marketing leaders to prioritize digital experience (DX) enhancements, align content roadmaps, and support major product launches.

  • Data-Driven Performance & Telemetry:Establish enterprise-wide operational metrics, business process analytics, and performance telemetry to measure CS efficiency, tool adoption, churn risk reduction, and ROI on technology investments.

  • Team Leadership & Scale:Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing 30+ person CS Shared Services team, leading through four direct reports (Directors/Sr. Managers) and fostering a culture of operational rigor, innovation, and accountability.

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree, Advanced Degree Preferred

  • 12+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Enablement, Business Transformation, or Technology Strategy in SaaS, with at least 7+ years in a senior leadership role managing managers/directors

  • Proven track record leading CS Operations, Enablement, PMO, and Technology teams in a fast-paced SaaS or enterprise tech environment.

  • Deep expertise in CS tech stacks (Gainsight, Salesforce, Contact Center platforms, LMS, WalkMe).

  • Hands-on experience driving AI/automation, RPA implementation, and workflow optimization.

  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing $3M+ operating budgets and software vendors.

  • Superior executive presence and cross-functional negotiation skills.

  • PMP, Agile/Scrum, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification.

  • Expertise in Healthcare IT / HealthTech workflows.

  • Proven experience architecting multi-pillar shared services organizations through rapid scale or M&A integration.

ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

United States

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
  • 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
  • Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,
  • Company-sponsored Business Resource & Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,
  • Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning,
  • Global presence and in-person collaboration opportunities; dog-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office-based roles and remote availability for some roles,
  • Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

We don’t just build technology. We build hope for everyone dealing with Cancer.


Elekta is shaping the standard of care, together with healthcare providers, by developing precision radiation medicine that brings advanced radiotherapy into routine clinical practice. Elekta is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with over 4,000 employees and offices in more than 40 countries. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information, visit elekta.com.

Customer Growth & Success Director – Cancer Registry

What You’ll Do At Elekta

As Customer Growth & Success Director – Cancer Registry, you will lead customer success across Elekta’s Cancer Registry business area, helping strengthen customer relationships, retention, adoption, growth and long-term value.

Reporting to the Head of Cancer Registry and working as part of the Cancer Registry management team, you will serve as a key voice of the customer within the business. You will build trusted relationships across our customer base, develop a deep understanding of customer priorities and challenges, and translate those insights into practical solutions, commercial opportunities and actionable product feedback.

This is a highly customer-facing role for someone who combines deep Cancer Registry expertise with a proactive approach to problem-solving and strong commercial judgment. You will work closely with customers and collaborate across Sales, Application Support, Service, Product Management, Engineering and Marketing to improve customer outcomes and help shape the continued development of our Cancer Registry business.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute a customer success strategy focused on customer relationships, retention, win-back, expansion, adoption and long-term customer value.
  • Build trusted relationships through frequent and proactive engagement with customers, developing a current understanding of their priorities, satisfaction, risks, adoption barriers and opportunities.
  • Establish effective customer health and engagement practices and use customer insights to identify emerging needs, risks and opportunities.
  • Gather and assess feedback from customers and customer-facing teams, distinguishing individual requests from broader patterns and prioritizing opportunities based on urgency, business impact and strategic relevance.
  • Work directly with customers to understand operational, workflow, product and data challenges, identify root causes and develop practical solutions.

jobs.description:
About Turing

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at .

Role: Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer

Location: Brazil

Experience Level: 5+ years in cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering

Work Model: Remote within Brazil, with regular working-hour overlap with U.S. Pacific Time and participation in a global on-call rotation

Why Join Turing?

Join Turing's global Infrastructure Engineering team and help build the cloud infrastructure and developer platform that power our business. You will make the systems engineers rely on more reliable, secure, scalable, and efficient as the company grows.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys turning manual work into durable automation, solving difficult production problems, and raising the bar for operational excellence. You will work across cloud infrastructure, reliability, developer tooling, and security in close partnership with application and security teams.

You will have meaningful ownership in a globally distributed team: working regularly with colleagues in U.S. Pacific Time, participating in the shared on-call rotation, and building systems that allow engineers to ship faster with confidence.

As the Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer, You Will

Own Multi-Cloud Reliability

Operate and continuously improve production infrastructure across GCP, AWS, and Azure. Lead incident response, troubleshoot complex issues, drive root-cause remediation, and improve monitoring, logging, alerting, performance, capacity, and cloud-cost efficiency.

Build the Developer Platform

Build and support engineering platforms, release pipelines, and deployment automation using GitHub Actions, Google Cloud Build, Jenkins, and related tooling. Develop reusable Terraform modules and automate workflows with Python, Go, Shell, or similar technologies.

Operate Production Kubernetes

Run production Kubernetes and GKE environments across deployment, scaling, networking, security, observability, and troubleshooting. Build infrastructure that is secure and scalable without making engineering teams slower.

Secure Infrastructure by Default

Design and troubleshoot cloud networking, including VPCs, firewalls, load balancers, routing, DNS, and WAFs. Partner with security and engineering teams on identity and access management, secrets management, network security, and broader infrastructure-security controls.

Raise the Operating Standard

Use AI-assisted engineering tools to improve log analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, and optimization. Collaborate on scalable architectures and production best practices, mentor engineers, and lead initiatives that improve reliability, security, and developer productivity.

The Anti-Sell

On-call is part of the job: You will participate in a shared global on-call rotation, respond to production incidents, and carry work through root-cause analysis and durable remediation.

Broad infrastructure ownership: This is not a narrow CI/CD or cloud-administration role. You will work across GCP, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, developer tooling, networking, security, and reliability.

Hands-on engineering required: The role is for a builder who can write automation, develop Terraform modules, troubleshoot production systems, and make technical decisions directly.

Global-team cadence: Regular working-hour overlap with U.S. Pacific Time is expected. Clear communication and dependable collaboration across time zones are core to the role.

Our Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineers Typically Have

Production GCP experience: Typically 5+ years in cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including hands-on ownership of GCP production environments.

Infrastructure-as-code and delivery fluency: Independent experience with Terraform, CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Cloud Deploy, or equivalents, and production Kubernetes.

Cloud and networking depth: Strong knowledge of cloud architecture, distributed systems, VPCs, firewalls, load balancers, WAFs, and securing cloud environments.

Automation capability: Strong scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, Shell, or equivalent technologies, with a bias toward replacing manual work with repeatable systems.

Operational ownership: Experience handling complex incidents, conducting root-cause analysis, communicating clearly, and following through on improvements that prevent recurrence.

Top-Tier Candidates Will Have

  • Independent operational experience in AWS or Azure alongside GCP.
  • Experience with configuration-management tooling such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.
  • Experience securing containers across Docker, Kubernetes, or GKE.
  • Experience with advanced GCP controls, including Organization Policies, VPC Service Controls, Access Context Manager, and Binary Authorization.
  • Google Cloud Professional certifications or comparable cloud credentials.

Values

  • We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Work at the frontier of AI, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
  • Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
  • Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
  • Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
  • Move at the pace of AI innovation, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
