jobs.description:
COMPANY:

At BioCryst, we share a deep commitment to improving the lives of people living with hereditary angioedema (HAE) and other rare diseases. We leverage our expertise in structure-guided drug design to develop first-in-class or best-in-class oral small-molecule and injectable protein therapeutics. Our global headquarters is in Durham, North Carolina, we have a regional office in Boston, Massachusetts, and our employees span the globe across sites in multiple countries. We are proud of our culture of engagement and accountability that rewards people for innovative thinking and achievement of key objectives. For more information, please visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.


JOB SUMMARY:


The Director, Scientific Communications serves as a senior leader responsible for developing and executing scientific engagement priorities across assigned therapeutic areas, assets, and lifecycle stages, including launch execution in highly competitive environments. This role requires deep Medical Affairs experience and the ability to translate clinical evidence, disease-state expertise, external insights, and business priorities into strategic scientific direction.

Working across Medical Affairs and in close partnership with Medical Education & Communication and other cross-functional partners, this leader will drive external expert engagement, advisory board planning, stakeholder strategies, insight-generation activities, and scientific input to launch and lifecycle planning. The role ensures alignment between external scientific engagement, Medical Affairs objectives, communication planning, and organizational priorities while supporting compliant scientific exchange.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Lead scientific engagement priorities for assigned assets, indications, or therapeutic areas across disease-state strategy, launch planning, lifecycle management, and evidence dissemination.
  • Interpret clinical, translational, real-world, and competitive evidence into strategic scientific direction that informs Medical Affairs planning and priorities along with external engagement.
  • Lead external expert engagement, advisory board planning, KOL and stakeholder strategies, and insight-generation activities to inform scientific and medical priorities.
  • Lead Medical Education and Communications direct reports and related activities to ensure scientific engagement insights, external expert perspectives, and Medical Affairs priorities are reflected in communication planning and related deliverables.
  • Provide strategic scientific input to congress planning, medical education, field medical resources, and external communication planning in collaboration with Medical Education and Communications and cross-functional partners.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Publications, Regulatory, Commercial, Market Access, Field Medical, and Patient Advocacy to ensure scientific alignment and coordinated execution.
  • Advance launch readiness and lifecycle excellence in highly competitive environments by aligning external insights, stakeholder engagement priorities, scientific direction, field medical enablement, congress strategy, and Medical Affairs planning.
  • Monitor the scientific, clinical, regulatory, and competitive landscape to identify implications for scientific engagement, education, stakeholder planning, and lifecycle priorities.
  • Ensure scientific engagement activities and related inputs are accurate, balanced, evidence-based, strategically aligned, and compliant with applicable policies and review processes.
  • Oversee agency and vendor partners supporting scientific engagement activities, including scope development, budget stewardship, timeline management, quality oversight, and performance feedback.
  • Ensure finance & governance discipline to scientific engagement and medical education and communication activities, including budget forecasting, resource prioritization, compliant review processes, and responsible management of project spend.
  • Serve as a scientific advisor and subject matter expert, supporting leadership decision-making and executive-level communication of complex scientific topics.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:


Basic Qualifications and Experience:

  • Advanced scientific or clinical degree required, such as PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Medical Affairs, scientific engagement, field medical, medical education, publications, Clinical Development, or related pharmaceutical/biotechnology functions.
  • Demonstrated success leading scientific engagement initiatives that support disease-state education, external expert engagement, launch readiness, evidence dissemination, and lifecycle priorities.
  • Advanced scientific acumen, with the ability to interpret complex clinical, translational, real-world, and competitive evidence and translate data into strategic scientific direction.
  • Experience developing and executing KOL, external expert, advisory board, stakeholder engagement, and insight-generation plans within a compliant Medical Affairs environment.
  • Substantial experience supporting launch readiness, launch execution in highly competitive environments, or lifecycle optimization through external insights, stakeholder engagement, field medical enablement, congress input, and Medical Affairs planning.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with Medical Education and Communications and collaborate across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Publications, Regulatory, Commercial, Market Access, Field Medical, external experts, and agency partners.
  • Comprehensive understanding of pharmaceutical industry compliance requirements, medical/legal/regulatory review processes, and ethical standards governing scientific exchange.
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, project leadership, and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence effectively in a matrixed environment.
  • Ability to operate with executive presence, strategic agility, and rigorous attention to scientific accuracy, operational excellence, compliance, and business priorities.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience:

  • Experience in rare disease, immunology, or other relevant therapeutic areas; preferred experience across multiple therapeutic areas with the ability to quickly develop disease-state fluency and apply scientific engagement approaches across diverse clinical landscapes.
  • Prior leadership experience in Medical Affairs roles focused on scientific engagement, external expert engagement, advisory board planning, insight generation, or field medical enablement.
  • Experience partnering with Medical Education and Communications, Publications, or agency partners to translate scientific insights and Medical Affairs priorities into aligned communication planning.
  • Experience working in matrix environments, including collaboration with priority markets and cross-functional launch teams.
  • Experience with evidence generation planning, real-world evidence interpretation, advisory board planning, or investigator-sponsored research processes.
  • Demonstrated success providing oversight of agency partners, managing budgets, and delivering high-quality scientific engagement activities within established timelines.

Serving the People Who Serve the People

With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

The Director of Business Development (BDR) is a senior go‑to‑market leader accountable for building, scaling, and optimizing a global inbound and outbound BDR organization. This role owns top‑of‑funnel strategy and execution, delivering predictable, high‑quality pipeline through improved conversion, velocity, and tight alignment with Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Communications, and Revenue Operations.

The Director leverages AI, data, and modern enablement platforms to increase BDR productivity and quality, effectiveness, and insight and ensure consistent, high‑quality execution across public sector (SLED/SMG), Enterprise, and Destination Marketing segments. The mandate is to power revenue growth through a disciplined, scalable, insight‑driven pipeline engine while developing a high‑performing team and strengthening cross‑functional GTM cohesion. That includes:

  • Driving pipeline creation across new and existing accounts
  • Ensuring deep account penetration and qualification prior to Sales engagement
  • Multi‑threading outreach across buying groups and decision‑makers
  • Accelerating pipeline by re‑engaging stalled or at‑risk opportunities
  • Routing buyers into compounding marketing motions, including events, demand generation, and ABM programs across multiple segments.
  • Building an amazing team culture focused on collaboration and shared accountability.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Strategy, Pipeline & Market Development

  • Execution Quality & Operational Excellence
    • Own and improve playbooks, call scripts, persona‑based sequences for Executives (C-Suite) vs. Functional leaders, automation vs. manual operating models, qualification standards, and handoff processes.
    • Ensure execution quality through coaching, QA reviews, speed‑to‑lead adherence, and segment specific messaging alignment.
    • Oversee technology adoption (Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo) and partner with RevOps on data integrity and analytics
  • Cross‑Functional GTM Alignment
    • Partner with Sales leadership on coverage models, ICP alignment, AE handoff, MEDDPICC and Challenger methodologies, and early‑stage deal progression.
    • Collaborate with Marketing and PMM to develop integrated campaigns, sequences, and feedback loops that improve relevance and ROI.
    • Translate market and customer insights into actionable GTM improvements and executive‑ready reporting.

    You Will Love This Job If You Have

    • 10+ years in business development, sales development, or revenue leadership within SaaS or technology
    • Demonstrated success leading large, distributed BDR/SDR teams and delivering measurable pipeline growth
    • Strong command of outbound, inbound, ABM/ABS motions, pipeline analytics, and conversion optimization
    • Experience implementing AI‑driven or data‑driven tools to enhance prospecting, prioritization, and coaching.
    • Expertise with Salesforce and modern sales engagement platforms.
    • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and cross‑functional collaboration skills
    • Direct experience in public sector, GovTech, or regulated markets, including Federal, State, and Local government

Role Title: Semiconductor Engineering Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay:$80- $185/hour

Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, materials, physics, or a closely related field, plus principal-level industry experience or a faculty appointment

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

You'll be working on

The problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong. You’ll build those problems, provide the correct analysis, and define what separates a right answer from one that only looks righ

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area — device physics, process integration, circuit design, lithography, packaging, yield and reliability — with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, materials science, applied physics, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major semiconductor company, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one semiconductor subdomain, with hands-on ownership of the work.

Role Title: Aerospace Engineering Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay:$80- $185/hour

Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: Master’s or PhD in aerospace or a closely related field, plus principal-level industry experience or a faculty appointment

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

You'll be working on

The work draws on what you already know: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong. You’ll build those problems, provide the correct analysis, and define what separates a right answer from one that only looks right.

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area — aerodynamics, propulsion, structures, GNC, orbital mechanics, systems engineering — with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major aerospace organization, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one aerospace subdomain, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another engineer could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.
  6. AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

As a Principal SOC Performance Analysis Engineer on the ASIC Engineering SOC Team, you will own performance analysis for a satellite communication System on Chip (SOC) supporting the TeraWave program. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership scope and no direct reports. You will set the performance analysis methodology from pre-silicon modeling through emulation based verification and post-silicon validation, and your results will directly shape architectural decisions across hardware, firmware, and software teams.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop pre-silicon performance models for satellite communication PHY IP and Arm core subsystem workloads

jobs.description:
Braincube est spécialisée dans l'optimisation des processus en temps réel qui aide les fabricants à améliorer leurs performances opérationnelles grâce à l'intelligence artificielle, à des capacités avancées en matière de données et à une expertise industrielle approfondie. Notre plateforme permet aux industriels d'augmenter leur rendement, d'améliorer la qualité, d'optimiser leur consommation d'énergie et d'accroître leur débit, à grande échelle et en temps réel, dans le cadre d'opérations complexes impliquant plusieurs sites.

Pour faire évoluer ces solutions, nous recherchons un·e Senior Back-End Software Engineer autonome, capable de prendre le lead sur un sujet et de le mener jusqu’à son aboutissement.

Le poste

Votre rôle : prendre un sujet et le mener à son terme

Vous travaillez au sein d’une équipe de développement et intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle, du besoin initial au suivi des résultats. Avec vos collègues et le produit, vous clarifiez les objectifs, challengez les options et construisez une solution adaptée. La collaboration au quotidien est essentielle : partager l’avancement, s’entraider, accueillir les retours et prendre les décisions ensemble pour réussir collectivement.

Au quotidien, vous serez amené·e à :

  • Porter des sujets de bout en bout : cadrage, conception, développement, tests, déploiement et suivi en production.

  • Prendre le lead technique : proposer une direction, expliquer les compromis, coordonner les contributions et faire avancer les décisions.

  • Développer des services backend en Java et concevoir des modèles de données et des requêtes SQL performants.

  • Faire fonctionner vos applications dans un environnement Kubernetes et contribuer à leur observabilité, leur fiabilité et leur diagnostic.

  • Anticiper les difficultés, rendre les risques visibles et chercher de l’aide au bon moment.

  • Faire progresser le collectif par les revues de code, le partage de connaissances et l’amélioration des pratiques.

Pour nous, l’ownership signifie rester impliqué·e jusqu’à ce que la solution soit utilisable, observable et réponde au besoin. L’autonomie s’appuie sur la collaboration et une communication claire.

L’IA fait partie de notre façon de développer

Nous construisons un environnement de développement dans lequel les assistants et les agents IA prennent une place croissante. Nous attendons de vous une pratique active de ces outils et la capacité à en tirer un bénéfice concret.

Cela signifie savoir :

  • Utiliser l’IA pour explorer un code existant, préparer une implémentation, développer, tester, refactorer ou documenter.

  • Structurer le contexte et découper un sujet pour déléguer efficacement certaines étapes à des agents.

  • Vérifier les résultats : comprendre le code proposé, tester les comportements et évaluer les conséquences sur la sécurité, les performances et la maintenance.

  • Identifier les usages qui améliorent réellement le travail et partager ces pratiques avec l’équipe.

Votre jugement d’ingénieur reste central : vous êtes responsable de ce que vous livrez, y compris lorsque l’IA contribue à sa réalisation.

Les technologies clés du poste : Java, SQL, Kubernetes, IA Tooling.

Votre expérience sera réussie chez nous si…

  • Vous savez prendre en charge un sujet, clarifier le résultat attendu et l’amener jusqu’en production, en coordonnant les contributions nécessaires.

  • vous comprenez les usages des clients et savez proposer des solutions techniques adaptées, en expliquant les compromis ;

  • vous livrez des évolutions testées et maintenables, et mettez en place les métriques et alertes nécessaires pour suivre leur fonctionnement et leurs performances ;

  • vous portez la qualité et l’adoption de vos développements, partagez vos connaissances et faites progresser les pratiques de l’équipe, notamment avec l’IA.

Vous serez accompagné·e dans votre réussite grâce à :

  • Un collectif de travail inspirant

  • Une intégration technique complète pour comprendre notre environnement de prod et y trouver rapidement votre place

  • Une communication transparente : nous apportons le contexte et le sens nécessaire pour aborder les projets sereinement

  • Une culture managériale du BEEER (Bienveillance, Exigence, Écoute, Empathie & Respect)

Lieu

Vous êtes rattaché·e au siège social, campus R&D de la société, situé à Issoire (63 - Puy-de-Dôme)

Télétravail : ce poste est ouvert en full remote.

A quoi ressemble le·a Senior Software Engineer idéal·e ? 🤩

Si vous :

  • Cherchez à comprendre les enjeux des clients et de l’entreprise pour concentrer vos efforts sur ce qui compte vraiment ;

  • apportez du recul : posez les bonnes questions, challengez les évidences et proposez des solutions pragmatiques ;

  • êtes une personne sur qui l’on peut compter : vous prenez des initiatives, assumez vos engagements et alertez quand c’est nécessaire ;

  • savez construire avec les autres : écouter, confronter les idées avec respect et avancer vers une décision commune ;

  • faites grandir l’équipe en partageant votre expérience, en accompagnant vos collègues et en leur permettant de gagner en autonomie ;

  • restez curieux·se et ouvert·e au changement : vous expérimentez, apprenez de vos erreurs et faites évoluer vos façons de travailler.

… alors ce poste est fait pour vous, rejoignez-nous en proposant votre candidature !

Notre process de recrutement

Étape 1 ✅ : Un premier contact téléphonique d’une quinzaine de minutes avec l’équipe RH 📞

Étape 2 ✅ : Deux entretiens avec nos équipes

  • Entretien avec les RH

  • Entretien avec Simon, VP Engineering

  • Entretien avec des membres de l’équipe Engineering : échange sur vos réalisations, vos choix techniques, votre ownership et vos usages de l’IA

Étape 3 ✅ : Un temps d’échange avec Amaury, CTO

Le bien-être des Braincubers passe avant tout. Si vous nous rejoignez, nous vous proposons :

  • Un poste de travail récent et performant (Macbook Pro ou Dell selon les besoins des projets) 💻

  • Un incroyable cadre de travail dans un château 🏰

  • De nombreux événements internes avec les collègues (garden party🎸, pots et moments de convivialité)

  • Un contexte de travail international

  • De la flexibilité dans les horaires et un poste ouvert en full remote

  • Une mutuelle prise en charge à 100% en isolé

  • Un CSE d’entreprise avec de nombreux avantages et réductions 😉

  • Des cours de yoga et des cours de X-Fit 🧘

  • Des actions en faveur des parents (prime de naissance, accompagnement du retour de maternité…) 👶

  • La possibilité de réaliser un projet de vie personnel tout en conservant votre poste 🤩

  • Du café et du thé mis à disposition dans les locaux ☕

  • Un processus d’intégration complet

  • … et de “beaux” goodies ! 😉

Processus d’intégration

Nous sommes soucieux de l’intégration de nos collaborateurs et nous ferons tout pour que vous vous sentiez bien avec nous dès le début. 🤗

Des personnes en interne sont dédiées à la formation. 🎓

jobs.title: Senior Website Implementation Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, you will join a growing multifamily real estate firm supporting a nationwide portfolio of residential properties. You will take hands-on technical ownership of the client’s Drupal CMS ecosystem hosted on Acquia, translating project briefs, visual assets, and content into robust, fully functioning property websites. Because the client’s web infrastructure requires customized configurations rather than simple drag-and-drop templates, you will balance custom backend coding with disciplined content management to deliver reliable digital experiences.

This is a high-ownership, execution-driven role for a disciplined technical specialist. You will become a core pillar of a nimble, high-focus web team, driving new website implementations from scratch, managing ticket queues against strict SLAs, replicating established configurations across expanding property portfolios, and ensuring rigorous quality assurance before handoff. If you excel at autonomous troubleshooting, structured file management, and leveraging modern AI workflows to accelerate backend development, this role will offer direct ownership and substantial impact.

Accountability

As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, your success will be defined by your ability to accurately build, maintain,and expand property websites within a customized Drupal and Acquia environment while independently managing ticket queues against SLAs and maintaining flawless QA readiness.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Drupal Implementation & Custom Backend Development

  • Build, configure, and maintain residential property websites within the client's Acquia-hosted Drupal architecture.
  • Implement and adapt website templates and structured CMS components using supplied briefs and creative assets.
  • Perform custom backend coding and manual configuration when native CMS functionality or standard modules are insufficient.
  • Troubleshoot technical limitations, backend blockers, and implementation bugs, ensuring strict compatibility with existing environments.
    Follow established Acquia Cloud deployment, staging, and hosting workflows while maintaining clean technical documentation.

New Website Builds, Replication & Portfolio Expansion

  • Execute end-to-end new property website implementations based on briefs provided by project management.
  • Replicate established web architectures across expanding portfolio properties, efficiently reusing templates while customizing property-specific data and content.
  • Configure components, verify asset mappings, and ensure visual and functional consistency across all portfolio sites.
  • Prepare and stage newly built and replicated sites for formal testing, ensuring all features execute seamlessly prior to launch.

Website Ticket Queue & SLA Management

  • Serve as the primary owner of the incoming website support and maintenance ticket queue.
  • Triage, prioritize, and resolve change requests, content updates, and technical adjustments in accordance with established SLAs.
  • Maintain real-time, accurate ticket statuses, track resolution deadlines, and proactively flag potential service-level delays.
  • Balance daily maintenance tickets and recurring support requests alongside active, high-priority website builds.

Quality Assurance, Testing & Asset Governance

  • Conduct thorough functional and visual testing on all website builds and updates prior to QA handoff.
  • Validate content placement, responsiveness, cross-browser performance, and template consistency to eliminate avoidable rework.
  • Address QA feedback systematically, resolving defects and verifying that all technical requirements are fulfilled.
  • Maintain rigorous file and asset organization across repositories, following strict naming conventions and directory standards to ensure zero asset misplacement.

AI-Enabled Engineering & Continuous Process Improvement

  • Incorporate AI tools (such as Claude) into daily technical workflows to investigate code, troubleshoot bugs, and accelerate repetitive implementation tasks.
  • Rigorously review, test, and validate all AI-assisted code suggestions to ensure technical integrity, security, and performance.
  • Identify recurring implementation bottlenecks and propose structured improvements to standardize builds.
  • Develop and update technical setup checklists, SOPs, and repeatable documentation to improve team efficiency as the web platform evolves.

Colleagues

You will work directly with the Website Project Manager as your primary day-to-day operational lead, while collaborating with existing website developers and cross-functional technical stakeholders during standups, testing cycles, and deployments.

At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, your vertical strength will be hands-on Drupal backend development and CMS implementation, while your horizontal capabilities should span ticket queue prioritization, QA discipline, AI-assisted development, and structured technical communication.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional web development and CMS implementation experience, with dedicated,hands-on expertise building and maintaining customized Drupal websites.
  • Tools & Systems: Extensive proficiency with Drupal backend architecture, modules, and configurations; hands-on experience operating within the Acquia Cloud ecosystem; familiarity with project management platforms (Notion or similar) and ticketing systems (Jira or similar).
  • Analytics & Process: Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume ticketing queues, monitor SLA commitments,and execute rigorous QA testing protocols. Strong track record of following disciplined documentation, checklist-driven workflows, and standardized file structures.
  • Mindset & Approach: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and disciplined execution style; comfortable operating with low to moderate extraversion in an autonomous, heads-down technical role. Proactive in asking clarifying questions before building rather than relying on unverified assumptions.
  • AI Fluency: Practical comfort integrating AI tools (e.g., Claude) to streamline code investigation, debugging, and task automation, paired with the engineering judgment to validate and test all outputs manually.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Drupal Architecture & Custom Backend Coding: How do you navigate, customize, and write backend logic within an established, non-productized Drupal CMS environment?
  • Acquia & Environment Troubleshooting: How do you diagnose and resolve hosting, deployment, or environment-specific issues across connected web infrastructure?
  • Ticket Ownership & SLA Prioritization: How do you balance active, multi-week website builds with incoming,time-sensitive maintenance tickets without missing delivery targets?
  • Quality Assurance & Attention to Detail: What systematic steps and checklists do you employ to ensure builds and asset placements are completely defect-free before QA handoff?
  • AI-Assisted Workflow & Verification: How do you safely leverage tools like Claude to accelerate technical problem-solving while validating accuracy and maintainability?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

jobs.description:
Location: UK, remote, with regular overlap with US East Coast hours. Travel to customer sites in the US and Europe, to international conferences, and occasionally to London and Manchester.

About the Role

You'll own a portfolio of mostly US accounts using Biorelate's Galactic AI platform, from large pharma companies to smaller biotech teams. Your job is to make sure their researchers get measurable scientific value from Galactic Data, Web, API, MCP and Co-Scientist, and to build the evidence for renewal and expansion.
This is a hands-on role between science and technology. You'll run workshops and QBRs, and you'll also set up API access, build and test prompts and workflows, and own support for your accounts.

What We Do

Research and Development in the pharmaceutical industry is time-consuming, expensive, and often overlooks valuable data insights. We’re changing that with AI-powered data science solutions that uncover hidden insights to support more efficient and informed drug discovery. Using AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP), our technology extracts and structures data from millions of scientific documents, identifying causal biological relationships and organising them into knowledge graphs. This advanced data science empowers bioinformaticians and biologists with a deeper understanding of the connections between diseases, proteins, and drugs.

Our team consists of biomedical and data science experts with real-world lab and pharmaceutical experience. These specialists ensure that our solutions are scientifically grounded, delivering accurate, reliable data to our customers.

The Company
Biorelate is a venture backed Series A startup (supported by established Tech investors). If you’re eager to collaborate with exceptional scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts from various fields in a supportive, ego-free environment, Biorelate is the place for you.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Adoption and Value

  • Own each account from kickoff and onboarding through to measurable scientific outcomes, with an adoption plan for each team and use case.
  • Run use case workshops that turn research problems (target identification, safety assessment, competitive intelligence, literature synthesis) into prioritised use cases.
  • Grow active and chargeable users by developing champions, reaching new teams, and getting researchers to their first real result quickly.

Renewals and Account Health

  • Own renewals and gross revenue retention (GRR), starting renewal planning at least 120 days before each renewal date.
  • Run QBRs and regular check-ins, and keep account plans and health scores current using usage data.
  • Spot declining usage early and lead the recovery plan when an account is at risk.

Technical Enablement and Support

  • Set up and troubleshoot API, MCP and Web deployments, and build prompts and example workflows around customers' own research questions.
  • Check the quality of outputs, and escalate issues to Engineering with clear reproduction details.
  • Answer security and governance questions, and route non-standard work to Forward Deployed Engineering.

Working Across Biorelate

  • Partner with the Account Manager, who owns contracting and expansion deals, by supplying adoption data, ROI evidence and expansion signals.
  • Feed customer feedback to Product, and help roll out betas, launches and training materials.
  • Support technical pre-sales conversations and represent Biorelate at conferences.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What You'll Bring

  • A PhD in biological or life sciences, or a related field.
  • Experience in a client-facing, post-sale role with pharma, biotech or life sciences customers, ideally in SaaS or data.
  • Familiarity with at least one of: target identification and validation, pharmacovigilance and drug safety, competitive intelligence, or literature synthesis.
  • Comfort working hands-on with APIs, LLM tools and prompt design, and the judgement to tell whether an AI-generated scientific answer holds up.
  • Confidence running workshops and training sessions with scientists and department leads.
  • A track record of moving usage numbers through structured plans, not only managing relationships.

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning renewals or GRR targets with enterprise customers.
  • Experience running QBRs with senior stakeholders.
  • Scripting experience, for example in Python.

How You'll Work

  • You own the plan for your accounts and drive it. Tasks aren't handed down.
  • You're curious about drug discovery, and happy to switch between customer meetings and focused technical work in the same day.
  • You're comfortable in a growth-stage company where processes are still being built, and keen to help build them.

Benefits

This is a rare opportunity to join Biorelate at an inflection point in our growth – and to genuinely shape how the company is seen and heard in the market. You'll work in a supportive team but you will have real autonomy to make this new role your own.
We offer competitive salaries, enhanced family leave, sick leave and significant opportunities for professional development. You’ll work alongside some of the brightest individuals, contributing to meaningful work that has a direct impact on global healthcare.
In addition, you can expect:
  • Genuine Flexibility: We are a fully remote business with colleagues across the globe: manage your schedule, save time and money on commuting, and do your best work from the comfort of your home.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: You’ll work with the latest software tools and technologies; we’ll push you to genuinely be innovative and find new ways to solve the newest challenges.

About Veriff

Veriff is building trust infrastructure for the internet. Our AI-powered identity verification and fraud prevention platform helps businesses across fintech, crypto, gaming, mobility and marketplaces know who their users are, and whether they can be trusted, in 230+ countries and territories. We build our own technology end to end, and every verification we run teaches us something about how fraud really works.

The role

Veriff sees fraud at a scale and breadth that no single platform can see on its own. Our job now is to turn that advantage into products customers can see, measure and act on, and to build the network that makes it compound.

As Lead Product Manager for Fraud on the Veriff Network team, you will make the fraud detection, prevention and accuracy strengths of our product legible to customers. You will own the concrete product experiences that do this, such as a Feedback API that lets customers tell us what happened after a decision, fraud insights inside Station (our customer portal), and automated fraud reporting. You will also lead the customer engagement that turns those experiences into a feedback loop: customers share outcomes and signals, our detection gets sharper, and every platform on the network benefits.

This is one of the first roles on the Veriff Network, and it directly shapes how we package, sell and grow our fraud offering.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you will have assessed our fraud product roadmap and packaging and agreed a revised version with product and fraud leadership. You will have identified the top three to five fraud product improvements, with the highest-priority items shaped and in development.

By six months, the first updated fraud product offering is live with a group of design and beta partners.

By nine to twelve months, a shared-signal pilot is running with a set of platforms, as the first step toward a cross-platform fraud network.

By twelve months, the improved fraud products are generally available and are measurably helping us attract and close deals with our core customer segments.

What you'll bring
  • Fraud and risk expertise. You have shipped fraud or risk products, or you have been responsible for fighting fraud and managing risk at a scaled, digital-native company. You understand attack patterns, how fraud teams actually work day to day, and how the precision/recall trade-off plays out in the real world.
  • Network product experience. You have worked on network-effect or marketplace data products, where aligning incentives between participants and building feedback loops are central to the product.
  • Data and ML product craft. You can specify a signal, read a model evaluation, and ship and manage a rules engine. You know what to build yourself and what to leave to data science.
  • Customer discovery with fraud teams. You can get fraud and trust leaders at platforms talking openly, and you turn what you learn into a clear roadmap.

Nice to have

  • Experience building with operations teams. Our fraud operations experts are the source of truth on what fraud looks like in practice, and the right person turns their judgment into product. If you haven't worked closely with an operations team before, you'll need to show strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Commercial packaging. You have shaped how a product is priced and sold, and worked deals alongside Sales.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career whilst looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. jobs.excerpt: Lead Concept Artist (Stylized Games | Art Direction)Location: Remote | International Team Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term Position OverviewWe are looking for an experienced Lead Concept Artist with exceptional artistic taste, strong creative leadership skills, and a passion for establishing compelling visual identities for game worlds and characters.
jobs.description:
Lead Concept Artist (Stylized Games | Art Direction)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Lead Concept Artist with exceptional artistic taste, strong creative leadership skills, and a passion for establishing compelling visual identities for game worlds and characters.

We believe great concept art is more than producing beautiful images. It is about solving design challenges, communicating ideas clearly, and defining a visual direction that inspires the entire production team.

As part of our creative team, you will work closely with Art Directors and artists to shape artistic direction, establish visual benchmarks, and ensure that concepts translate effectively into production.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines outstanding concept art skills with the ability to guide artists, make confident artistic decisions, and elevate the overall quality of the team's work.

Key Responsibilities

Concept Art & Visual Direction

  • Lead concept art development across characters, environments, props, and other game content.

  • Translate creative briefs, narrative ideas, and gameplay requirements into compelling visual concepts.

  • Establish clear visual language, shape design, composition, color palettes, and artistic consistency.

  • Create key art explorations, sketches, paintovers, and production-ready concept designs.

  • Develop visual references and artistic benchmarks to guide 2D and 3D production.

Hands-On Artistic Leadership

  • Actively contribute to concept production while supporting and mentoring other artists.

  • Provide high-quality paintovers, design explorations, and actionable artistic feedback.

  • Review concept work and identify opportunities to improve appeal, readability, originality, and design quality.

  • Guide artists through visual exploration, iteration, and production challenges.

  • Help establish art guidelines, workflows, and quality standards across the concept team.

Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Art Directors, Game Designers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, and Technical Artists.

  • Ensure concept designs consider production feasibility, gameplay readability, and technical requirements.

  • Maintain consistency between early visual exploration and final in-game presentation.

  • Communicate artistic decisions clearly and proactively across distributed teams.

  • Take ownership of concept quality and contribute solutions to creative challenges.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional experience in concept art for game development.

  • Proven experience as a Lead Concept Artist, Senior Concept Artist with leadership responsibilities, or equivalent.

  • Experience contributing to commercially released game productions.

  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating outstanding artistic fundamentals, design thinking, and visual storytelling.

  • Strong understanding of composition, color, lighting, perspective, anatomy, and shape language.

  • Ability to establish and maintain a cohesive artistic style across different content types.

  • Excellent hands-on painting, sketching, and visual exploration skills.

  • Experience mentoring artists and providing clear, actionable feedback.

  • Ability to translate abstract ideas into production-ready designs.

  • Strong communication skills and experience working with multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Strong background in stylized game art and visual development.

  • Experience creating characters with distinctive personalities and emotional appeal.

  • Experience with simplified, pixel-inspired, or highly stylized aesthetics.

  • Understanding of Unity3D or Unreal Engine production pipelines.

  • Experience with Blender or other 3D tools for concept exploration.

  • Experience supporting Art Directors on large, multidisciplinary productions.

  • Previous experience in cross-studio co-development.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful influence over the artistic direction and visual identity of game projects.

  • Opportunity to lead and develop a talented concept art team.

  • A hands-on creative role with high artistic ownership.

  • Collaboration with experienced artists and international creative leadership.

  • Remote-friendly working environment.

  • Competitive compensation and flexible contract options.

  • Long-term collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Annual Beffio team retreats and a supportive studio culture.

Ready to Shape the Next Visual Direction?

Send us your portfolio and a short introduction. We would love to see work that demonstrates exceptional concept art quality, design leadership, and your ability to turn creative ideas into memorable visual experiences.

Job title - Principal Engineer, Water/Wastewater

Stanley Consultants is seeking a Principal Water/Wastewater Engineer to support the continued growth and delivery of municipal and industrial water and wastewater projects throughout the United States.

This remote position will provide technical and project leadership throughout the complete infrastructure lifecycle, including capital planning, engineering design, design-build delivery, construction administration, startup, commissioning, operations, maintenance, and asset optimization. The successful candidate will have experience with municipal and industrial water and wastewater systems, capital improvement programs, treatment-process evaluation, operational performance, regulatory compliance, and owner-side representation.

Although the position is remote, the Principal Water/Wastewater Engineer will be expected to maintain regular communication with clients and project teams, travel to client and project locations, and collaborate effectively across multiple Stanley Consultants offices and disciplines.

What You Will Be Doing:

    Project and Technical Leadership

  • Lead the planning, analysis, design, construction, startup, operation, rehabilitation, and optimization of municipal, federal, and industrial water and wastewater systems.
  • Serve as Project Manager, Technical Lead, Engineer of Record, or Principal-in-Charge, as appropriate for individual assignments.
  • Develop facility master plans, capital improvement recommendations, lifecycle evaluations, budgets, schedules, and implementation strategies.
  • Lead design-build, design-build-operate-maintain, retrofit, rehabilitation, and conventional design-bid-build projects.
  • Perform or direct process analysis, treatment optimization, technology evaluation, chemical trials, equipment selection, and value engineering.
  • Lead projects involving:
    • Municipal, commercial, and industrial water and wastewater systems
    • Wastewater collection, pumping, treatment, and biosolids management
    • Treatment-plant rehabilitation, retrofit, and operational optimization
    • Industrial wastewater characterization, pretreatment, treatment, reuse, and discharge
    • Physical, chemical, and biological treatment processes, controls, and chemical-feed systems
    • Asset management, CMMS, condition assessment, resilience, and capital planning
    • System testing, startup, commissioning, and operational transition
    • Environmental permitting, NPDES compliance, and federal infrastructure contracts
    • High-strength wastewater, water reuse, recovery, and zero-liquid-discharge applications
    • Review project requirements following award and confirm scope, work procedures, schedule, budget, staffing, quality-management requirements, vendor needs, and project risks.
    • Prepare or oversee project work plans, project initiation documents, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and project closeout activities.
    • Lead preparation and review of calculations, technical reports, plans, specifications, cost estimates, permit applications, and construction documents.
    • Coordinate technical work across civil, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and controls, structural, architectural, environmental, and CADD disciplines.
    • Provide technical oversight during construction, including submittal and shop-drawing reviews, requests for information, change evaluations, progress meetings, site observations, startup, commissioning, and project closeout.
    • Apply Stanley Consultants’ quality-management procedures and applicable standards, including AWWA, WEF, Ten States Standards, state regulatory requirements, and client-specific design criteria.

      • Project Management

    • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, communications, resources, procurement, and risk.
    • Establish clear assignments, deliverable dates, review responsibilities, and communication protocols for geographically distributed project teams.
    • Monitor project performance and take timely corrective action when scope, schedule, budget, staffing, or quality concerns arise.
    • Maintain consistent communication with clients, project teams, subcontractors, and Stanley Consultants leadership.
    • Support contract negotiations, amendments, scope development, fee preparation, and project financial management.
    • Deliver projects in accordance with client expectations and Stanley Consultants’ project-management and quality requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Environmental, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering from an accredited institution.
  • At least 20 years of progressive experience in water, wastewater, environmental, industrial, or public infrastructure.
  • Professional Engineer license in a U.S. jurisdiction, or ability to obtain one within six months; ability to obtain additional registrations as needed.
  • Experience delivering municipal and industrial water and wastewater projects through planning, design, construction, startup, operations, and rehabilitation.
  • Experience evaluating industrial wastewater characteristics, treatment, discharge, permitting, and water-reuse requirements.
  • Knowledge of industrial treatment technologies, including clarification, filtration, membranes, biological treatment, ion exchange, reverse osmosis, demineralization, and advanced reuse.
  • Ability to integrate water and wastewater systems with industrial processes, utilities, equipment, and site infrastructure.
  • Experience with alternative delivery methods such as design-build, progressive design-build, construction manager at risk, or engineer-procure-construct.
  • Experience collaborating with owners, contractors, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Project-management experience overseeing scope, schedule, budget, quality, staffing, communications, and risk.
  • Strong communication and technical-writing skills, with proficiency in Microsoft 365.
  • Ability to work effectively and remotely and travel as needed, including overnight.
  • Participation in AWWA, WEF, or related state and regional organizations is desirable.

Remote-Work Expectations

The position is remote, but success will require active participation with clients and Stanley Consultants teams. The selected candidate will be expected to:

  • Maintain a professional and reliable home-office environment.
  • Be available for client and team meetings during established core working hours.
  • Use Microsoft Teams and other approved collaboration platforms for regular communication.
  • Travel to Stanley Consultants offices when needed for project workshops, training, interviews, and team-development activities.
  • Travel to client facilities and project sites to maintain relationships and support project delivery.

We’re looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to help build brand awareness, create qualified demand, and engage the accounts and buying groups that matter most to Navan. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn strategy into campaigns—from audience planning and platform setup to creative testing, budget management, and optimization. You’ll help expand our paid media programs across paid social, video, programmatic, and merging channels, connecting brand building with long-term pipeline growth.

You’ll work closely with Creative, Content, Campaigns, Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Sales. You’ll also manage media vendors and partners to ensure campaigns reach the right audiences, deliver quality placements, and produce measurable results. The ideal candidate combines deep channel expertise, a strong understanding of account-based marketing (ABM), and sound creative judgment. You understand that different campaigns serve different purposes and know how to measure success at each stage of the buyer journey.

What You’ll Do:

  • Execute campaigns that build awareness and create demand
    • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, X, Reddit, YouTube, Google Demand Gen,programmatic display and emerging channels, including audience setup, bidding, budget pacing, tracking, and reporting.
    • Support major brand moments that build awareness, credibility, and consideration among relevant audiences in priority markets.
    • Activate demand-creation programs through content syndication, industry publishers, newsletters, and sponsored email, with clear audience requirements and lead-quality standards.
  • Put ABM strategy into practice
    • Translate priority account lists, engagement signals, and buying-group needs into actionable paid media audiences.
    • Build distinct campaigns to introduce Navan to unengaged accounts, reach missing buying roles within engaged accounts, and support progression where paid media can add value.
    • Partner with Marketing Operations to maintain audience syncs, exclusions, and suppression rules, and troubleshoot match rates and delivery issues.
    • Support one-to-one and one-to-few customer expansion campaigns in partnership with Customer Marketing and account teams, validating audience size and reach before launch.
    • Familiarity with 6Sense, Demandbase, StackAdapt or comparable programmatic and account-targeting platforms.
  • Partner with Creative and Content
    • Develop clear creative briefs that connect the campaign objective, audience, message, offer, and channel requirements.
    • Work with Creative, Content, and Product Marketing to produce paid social, display, and sponsored-content assets.
    • Run structured tests across messaging, concepts, formats, and landing pages, and turn results into clear recommendations for the next creative iteration.
    • Manage production timelines and asset refreshes so campaigns launch on time and stay relevant.
  • Measure, learn, and improve
    • Set campaign KPIs that match the objective, from qualified reach and consideration lift to account engagement, buying-group coverage, opportunities, and pipeline.
    • Partner with Analytics to design controlled tests, establish baselines, and evaluate incremental impact over appropriate measurement windows.
    • Validate account matching, placement quality, viewability, reach, and frequency, and resolve delivery issues before increasing investment.
    • Work with Marketing Operations and Sales to connect meaningful campaign responses with clear follow-up and feedback.
    • Communicate what is working, what remains uncertain, and where to scale, adjust, or stop investment.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, including meaningful experience in B2B marketing.
  • Deep, recent hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads and multiple channels across paid social, YouTube, Google Demand Gen, and programmatic display.
  • Practical knowledge of ABM, including account segmentation, buying committees, audience activation, and long B2B buying cycles.
  • Experience executing both brand-awareness and demand-creation campaigns, with a clear understanding of how their objectives, creative, and measurement differ.
  • A track record of managing budgets, optimizing campaigns directly, and making thoughtful investment decisions.
  • Experience partnering with creative teams to develop briefs, test concepts, and improve campaign assets.
  • Strong vendor management skills and experience working with media partners, publishers, or agencies.
  • Confidence using campaign, CRM, and analytics data to assess audience quality and downstream performance.
  • Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns and cross-functional partners.

jobs.title: VP, Revenue Marketing
jobs.excerpt: At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose.
jobs.description:
At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose. Our powerful giving platform and stellar support enable tens of thousands of nonprofits to raise more, recruit more, and retain more, fueling maximum impact and raising the bar on what’s possible for the nonprofit sector. That's why, even as the nonprofit sector sees declines in giving, Bloomerang customers raise more year over year.

We're also in the business of creating thriving employees. Join a mission-driven culture built on our core values of Simplify, Care and Act. We know our people are the key to our success, and we're proud to be home to some of the most innovative and skilled individuals in the workforce today. Come feel invigorated and unstoppable with us!

The Role

The VP of Revenue Marketing reports to the Chief Marketing Officer and is accountable for how Bloomerang generates new business demand and revenue. Buyer journeys, integrated campaigns, account-based sales and marketing plays, search and AI visibility, paid search, the website, and conversion optimization are your pillars for growth.

Success in the role is driving month-over-month and year-over-year new account acquisition, pipeline, and bookings growth in partnership with Business Development, Sales, and Marketing leadership. You are responsible for the complete demand and conversion engine that takes nonprofits on their journey with Bloomerang.

You lead through the leaders on your team, you influence how the wider Marketing Team works, and you are a visible, trusted leader with your peers across the business.

Key Outcomes

Success in this role is not a set of responsibilities and checking boxes. These are strategic outcomes tied to nonprofit success and ultimately, Bloomerang’s success.

Our volume keeps growing, and it comes from more places than it has before. Paid search, organic and direct have served us well and they keep compounding. You get us (and the team) ahead of where volume will be next. By partnering with demand leaders, you enable our innovation in visibility via a multi-year view of where our volume comes from, and a funded plan to build it.

We win in market segments we have not pursued yet, while the core engine continues to expand. You identify, size, and build the go-to-market account-based marketing and sales playbooks for those segments with your team and GTM leadership. Your integrated campaigns team keeps Marketing in lockstep with the Sales and Business Development motions; activating and opting-in target accounts while the engine that carries the number keeps pacing to beat the plan.

Buyers get an experience built for where they actually are. Much of our funnel is built to catch buyers who arrive ready. You and the team build the next buyer journey layer that meets everyone else via modern integrated campaigns, nurtures, and personalization at scale; using the best tooling available. The results are seen via conversion and velocity performance through the funnel, not just volume at the top.

Marketing, Business Development and Sales run one plan, and together we drive it. You help build, refine and hold the reverse waterfall with your GTM peers as genuine partners and collaborators. It is one goal, one set of numbers, co-signed, that survives even if it is not perfect. When something needs attention, GTM leaders come to you because you will dig in and solve it with them.

Every bet we make has evidence. You know the channels, sources and run-rates cold. You continually run experiments with your team (and cross-functionally) to prove a play at a small scale, then execute what works. And just as important, cut what does not perform. When we fund a program, you show the work so GTM and Executive Leadership can support the reasoning, not just the idea.

Growth investment goes where it compounds, and everyone can see why. You are responsible for the full programmatic, demand software and demand campaign budget. Smart investment allocation is the primary growth lever to scale the business. You and the team decide where it goes, including moving it between channels and sources (even sometimes teams), and you align leadership before any significant shift.

Marketing produces higher quality outcomes next year than this year, with the same number of people. You help drive the AI agenda for the whole department, not just your team. Which workflows agents run, how much autonomy each earns, who stays accountable for the output. You help set the standard and the pace, and you inspire the other functions to come with you.

Your team grows, and your influence reaches beyond marketing. You are a leader first. The leaders on your team design the strategy and run the day-to-day, and you put your energy where it strengthens the team most. You earn the respect across the business that gets your team’s innovations backed. People grow under you, and the best marketers want to join your team.

The sector knows who you are. You present, you speak, and you take the stage. Your regular conversations with fundraising and nonprofit leaders bring insight back into the revenue marketing and product teams. At this level you shape how the market sees Bloomerang, not only how the business runs.

What You Will Do

  • You are both halves of the brain: an operator and a strategist. You are deep enough in the core engine that drives growth performance (GEO, organic, paid, website experiences, and campaigns) to refine it with the team, and creative enough to see quarters in advance and know what comes next. You have grown a demand engine through a channel shift: you spotted the change in the mix, worked through it, and got your team ahead of it. You can tell us the before, the after, and what you would do differently.
  • You lead leaders, and you are an energizer. You grew your leaders into stronger cross-functional leaders than when you found them. You have inherited a team, raised the bar, and had people follow you to the next thing. You bring pace and optimism, you stay level-headed when things are difficult, and people dig in and do their best work with you.
  • You have delivered growth at this rate before. You know what breaks at that pace, and you have built through it rather than around it.
  • You cannot imagine working without AI anymore. You have redesigned real marketing workflows with agents rather than attended a training. You can tell the difference between output that is good and output that is merely fast, and you get genuinely energized by what this makes possible for a team.
  • You prove it before you scale it. You make decisions from completed tests, not personal wants or conviction. You have cancelled your own good idea because the data did not support it, and you can tell us about it without flinching.
  • GTM leaders want you in the room. You have carried a shared number with a sales leader, and neither of you needed a mediator. Your Sales, Marketing, and Business Development peers would tell us you made their number easier to hit.
  • You are comfortable in front of the market. You can carry a stage, a webinar, a discussion with nonprofit executives and industry influencers. You are credible with the Senior Leadership Team and the Executive Team.
  • You respect a buyer who may not be a technologist. Our buyers are fundraisers and nonprofit leaders. They are passionate, time-constrained, mission-driven people who do not have time to decode jargon. Marketing should make them feel confident, hopeful and excited to learn from Bloomerang.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 12+ years in B2B SaaS growth, demand or revenue marketing, including 5+ years leading other leaders
  • Scaled a high-volume, high-velocity inbound engine where marketing sourced the majority of pipeline
  • Carried a number through sustained 30%+ YoY bookings growth and helped scale a business toward $200M or beyond
  • Owned a marketing-sourced pipeline number and delivered against it, under pressure
  • Built and held a reverse waterfall or equivalent funnel plan with Sales, Business Development and Revenue Operations leadership
  • Have hands-on depth across paid, website and conversion optimization, and organic and AI-driven discovery
  • Translated deep product knowledge and hands-on product experience into high-impact buyer journeys that convert
  • Owned a meaningful program, agency and software budget and made real allocation calls with it
  • Experience with a modern demand stack — CRM, marketing automation, ABM and intent, analytics, A/B testing, and AI tooling

Benefits

Health + Wellness

You’ll have access to generous health, vision, and dental insurance options as well as HealthiestYou, a healthcare service that offers convenient, confidential access to quality doctors 24/7, anytime, anywhere.

Time Off

You’ll get a competitive PTO package that includes 20 PTO days, 3 flex days, 4 optional volunteer days, 12 paid holidays, as well as paid parental leave. More is more!

401k

You’ll receive a 401k match to help invest in your future.

Equipment

Everything you need to be successful, shipped right to your door. You got this. We got you.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is: $175,500 - $292,500. You may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, as well as applicable employment laws.

Location

This is a permanent, full-time, fully remote position. Employees living in Indianapolis, IN are welcome to work from our company headquarters. We do not offer Visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

Accommodations

Applicants who require accommodations may contact to request an accommodation in completing an application.

Bloomerang is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Individuals seeking employment at Bloomerang are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

jobs.description:
Senior Technical Animator (Unreal Engine | Remote)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Project-Based / Contract

Open Positions: 2

Position Overview

We are looking for experienced Senior Technical Animators with strong Unreal Engine expertise and a passion for solving complex animation challenges for an unannounced game project with one of our partners.

We believe exceptional technical animation is about more than creating character rigs. It's about building reliable systems, developing efficient workflows, and empowering animators to bring characters to life with the highest level of quality and technical precision.

As part of our co-development team, you will work closely with animators, technical artists, and gameplay programmers to develop, integrate, and optimize character rigs, animation systems, and production pipelines directly in Unreal Engine.

This is a hands-on senior role for someone with strong technical animation fundamentals, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership of complex animation systems within an established production environment.

Responsibilities

Character Rigging & Technical Animation

  • Create, maintain, and optimize character rigs for bipedal, non-bipedal, and mechanical characters.

  • Develop robust rigging and skinning solutions that support high-quality character performances.

  • Ensure character rigs are efficient, scalable, and suitable for real-time game production.

  • Collaborate with animators to resolve deformation issues and improve animation workflows.

  • Maintain technical consistency across character setups and animation assets.

Unreal Engine Animation Systems

  • Implement and maintain character animation systems directly in Unreal Engine.

  • Work with Animation Blueprints, State Machines, Blend Spaces, and Motion Matching workflows.

  • Support animation logic and integration involving Behavior Trees and State Trees.

  • Collaborate with gameplay programmers to develop reliable character animation behavior.

  • Investigate, debug, and resolve animation-related issues across in-game systems.

  • Optimize animation systems to meet real-time performance requirements.

Animation Pipelines & Tools

  • Develop and improve workflows connecting Maya, Blender, and Unreal Engine.

  • Build efficient processes for animation export, import, retargeting, and character integration.

  • Create reusable tools and technical solutions that improve animator productivity.

  • Identify pipeline bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation and share knowledge across teams.

Collaboration & Co-Development

  • Work closely with our partner's animation, technical art, and engineering teams.

  • Integrate into existing production pipelines and contribute to established technical standards.

  • Translate animation requirements into practical, production-ready solutions.

  • Take ownership of assigned systems and proactively identify technical risks.

  • Communicate technical challenges, progress, and solutions clearly across distributed teams.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional experience in game animation or technical animation.

  • Proven experience working on commercially released game productions.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5 and real-time character animation systems.

  • Excellent technical skills in character rigging, skinning, and deformation.

  • Strong understanding of animation principles, character mechanics, and real-time animation workflows.

  • Professional proficiency with Maya and Blender, including their integration with Unreal Engine.

  • Practical experience with Animation Blueprints, State Machines, Blend Spaces, and Motion Matching.

  • Understanding of Behavior Trees, State Trees, and their interaction with character animation systems.

  • Experience developing and maintaining DCC-to-engine animation pipelines.

  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex animation integration and performance issues.

  • Strong understanding of technical constraints, performance optimization, and scalable production workflows.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with animators, technical artists, and programmers.

  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Strong experience with Unreal Engine Control Rig and procedural animation systems.

  • Knowledge of IK Rig, IK Retargeter, Full Body IK, and runtime animation solutions.

  • Experience with Python, MEL, or mGear for rigging and pipeline automation.

  • Experience creating custom animation tools and editor utilities.

  • Familiarity with high-fidelity character systems and complex character deformation.

  • Experience with procedural animation, physics-driven animation, or runtime rigging.

  • Experience optimizing animation systems for demanding real-time applications.

  • Previous experience working in a co-development environment with international teams.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to contribute to an unannounced game project with one of our partners.

  • Direct collaboration with experienced animation and engineering teams.

  • Meaningful technical ownership over character animation systems and production workflows.

  • Fully remote collaboration within an international development environment.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and contract arrangements.

  • Potential opportunities for continued collaboration on future projects.

  • Supportive and experienced Beffio Studios team.

Ready to Bring Characters to Life Through Technology?

Send us your portfolio, technical breakdowns, or examples of animation systems you have developed.

We are especially interested in seeing Unreal Engine animation implementations, character rigs, technical tools, and production workflows that demonstrate your ability to solve complex animation challenges in real game development environments.
